tei:div.tei:p: ṭwāṃdī dotwe ༷༷ shā ṭī ༷/ /ṭwāṃ ༷༷sdu baX ༷/ sdio/ ṭwāṃ6 'ibaba'i ཿ 0btsārngu
༄khya/ / nges don phyag rgya chen po'i rnam bzhag bstan pa'i sgron me bzhugs so/ /mkhan tshulakhrimasarinapochesagasungs/ngagadabang mkhyenaragekyisayeger phab/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/nges don phyag rgya chen po'i rnam bzhas bstan pa'i sgron me bzhugs so zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni nye ba'i char malan chen tshul khrims rin po ches bka' rdorsha kṇinākā kā ṭwāṃ shākā sngu~X /bu ngag dbang mkhyen rab nas ji bzhin sgra phab kyis de'i nang karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung phyas chon smon lam gyi 'grel ba dang / rje btsun mi la ras pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rnam sazhag mdor bstan gyi 'grel bshad/ de bzhin lo ston dge 'dun la sogs pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig la rje mi las gdams pa'i tshis drug gi gnas bsdus kyi 'grel ba'ad bcas phal skad rang gi rnam pa'i thog nas kha gsal zhing go bde la yis tshogs nyung nyung 'is gsungs 'dus pa 'dis go ba lon dka' ba'i chos sbya~Xdī / /nga tshig mi nyung ba zhig gi go don rtogs rgyur phan pa chen po yong brtsams chos 'di nyid ni phal skad rang gi rnam pa'i thog nas yig thog tu phab pa zhig yin stabs das 'bri'i thad brda sprod kyi lugs dang mi mthun pa mang po 'ig 'dug kyang ma bcos na ma 'grig pa ltar du snang ba dag brda sprod kyi lugs ji bzhin bcos khul zhus yod pa las de byings rgo bde ba'i ched du phal skad kyi sgra gang thon gyis bris pa rnams sor 'jos bgyis yod/ 1

brtsams chos 'di nyid kyi dag don gang ci'i thad khyad chos mngon gsal dod tsam yod 'dug pas rgya che'i klog pa po dang / zhib 'jug pa lhan rgyasanas ngang pas chu dang 'o ma 'byed pa ji bzhin snyigs dor bcud len dang skyon sel dge spel la sman pa'i phyag len dang bka' bzang gi dgongs rgyan sbyi bo'i mdzes rgyan du 'ong ba'i re smon dang bcas/rtsom sgrig pas/

dkar chagaṭwāṃtram̐ kāṭwāsdod/ / // ṭwāṃsngon 'gro'i chos kyi rim pa'i rnam gzhag (4)karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung phyag chen smon lam gyi 'grel pa/ (26)rje mi la~Xgre rdo sdim/ spyod 'bras kyi rna ma gzhag ma do ra ba sta na gyi (75)lo ston dge 'dun la sogs pa'i slob ma 'ga' 'ig la rje mi las mjug kāṭwāṃm/ sa pa'i tshig drug gi gnas ba sdu sa kyi 'a gre la pa / (/snyikhroṭwāṃ

mchod brjod/blta bas mi ngoms yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i skyu/brjod med brjod pa kun gyi rgyur gyur gsung /mi g.yo spros bral lhan skyes bde ba'i thugus/thub mchog lha mi'i bla ma skyabs kyi gnas/mdo sngags zab rgyas legs bshad smra ba'i dasdung /dasdung byug yon tan srid zhi yongs kyi dpāl/dasdul lda na khyod ni rang byung rdo rjer 'asdud/'asdud pa bzhin du tshe rabs phreng bar dgongs/tshul re'i yon tan rgyal ba dang mnyam yang /sku drin rgyal ba kun las ches lhag pa/thugs rje che ldan dngos brgyud bla ma rnams/byang chub bar du 'bral med spyi bos btud/

gleng brjod/spyir shākya thub pa'i bstan pa snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus yin la khyad par da lta snyigs ma lnga las kyang ches cher snyigs mar gyur pa lnga brgya tha ma'i dus bya ba yin pas sems can rnams ni bsam rgyu nyon mongs dang bya rgyu sdig pa las med pa yin/ ma zad thog med nas rang cag sems can rnams ma ris nyon mongs dang grogs yun ring pa'i stobs kyis rang bde kho na'i don la brtson pa 'bu srin dud 'gro dang mtshungs pa'i bsam sbyor la gnas te gzhan bzang yang rang la zug gzer che bas lus ngag yid gsum gyis ga'an la gnod pa 'ba' zhig spyod pa'i sems can rnams tshogs nas 'dug pa 'dir dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mi ma yin rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir yongs su dag pa'i jing khams su song ba dang / nag phyogs la dga' ba rnams ni mthu dang nus pa rgyas pas sems can rnams la spyir yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i rkyen mang la khyad par du bstan pa nyams su len pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du mchis na'ang de dag rnams la bar chad sna tshogs 'byung bas de ltar rkyen ngan du ma'i ru 'dzings pa'i dus 'dir gnas lugs yang dag pa bstan pa'i chos bzang po 'di lta bu la ma bslab na chos gzhan gang gis kyang mgo 'don par mi 'gyur la/ 'di'i chos sgor zhugs nas 'bad padī rang gzhan bde blag tu sdug bsngal las bsgral nus pa dang phan yon yang

bsdus na yongs su dag pa'i zhing khams su bskal ba brgyar dge sbyong byas pa bas da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dag pa'i kun nas blangs te sems rgyud bzang po'i ngang thos bsam sgom pas tshogs rdzogs stobs che ba gdon mi za snyam ste shākya'i dge spyong dman bu ngag dbang mkhyen rab bdag gis bla ma mkhan chen tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i drung nas phyag chen smon lam dang rje mi la'i lta ba sgom pa spyod pa spyod thabs 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gsung chos zab mo thob pa de dag chos grogs gzhan la phan pa'i phyir sgra 'dzin 'khor thag nas yi ger phab/ bdag gis bla ma skyabs rje bstan pa rin po che mchog la gsol ba btab pa ba.in yun tsam gyi ring la zhus dag dang mchod brjod mjug smon bcas gdung par mdzad cing / da lam mi rigs dpe sgun khang nas dpar bskrun rogs ram gyi zhal bzhed thob pas bka' drin bcas kyi dge rtsa ji snyed sbya /ṭwāṃpy-i sdo ṭwāṃ/sa cad gzhan don dang dpal ldan bla ma'i rjes su 'dzin pa'i

sngon 'gro'i chos kyi rim pa'i rnam gzhagaspyir btang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa rang rgyal gyi theg pa/ theg pa chen po gsum red/ theg pa chen po la'ang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang rdo rje theg pa gnyis red/ a ni sngon 'gro de la thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed pa dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pa bzhi de la thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro zer ba red/ thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro bzhi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni blo legs su rung ba'am sems legs su rung ba'am thar pa don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa'i thabs red/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bar bsam na chos bsgrub 'dod kyi blo skye gi red/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i mi lus 'di shin tu rnyed dka' ba'am thob dka' ba de da lta lan gcig thob pa yin pa ha go nas yid ches na chos bsgrub 'dod kyi blo skye yi red/ 'di'i steng du tshe mi rtag pa/spyir 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag pa/ khyad par du skye 'gro sems can rnams mi rtag pa 'di yag po shes na nga tsho'i dal 'byor gyi lus thob na'ang ring du mi gnas pa/ rgyun ring por gnas mi thub pa shi 'gro ba 'di shes nas chos maspyogs po bsgrub 'dod kyi blo skye ba red/ 'di'i steng du las rgyu 'bras de yag po zhig shes na/ rgyu dge ba bsgrub pa las 'bras bu bde ba byudī ba dang / rgyu sdig pa byed pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal byung ba de yag po

shes zhing bskor na sdig pa spong ba la dga' po dang / dge ba bsgrub pa la dga' po dang chos nyams su blangs pa la'ang dga' po dang sems shugs skye yi yod pa red/ bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa la spyir btang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ 'khor ba'i skyon 'di nga tsho 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nas mi'i lus rten red/ mi'i lus rten yin na'ang mi'i lus rten 'di la mtho ris bde ba cung zad cig yod red/ bde ba yod na'ang skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba mang po gcis da lta dngos su myong bzhin yod pa red/ sdug bsngal ha go ba'in yod red/ yin na'ang 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa/ 'khor ba'i sems can mtha' dag dang 'khor ba'i gnas lus longs spyod la zhen pa'i stobs kyis sdug bsngal yod pa de shes na thar pa thob 'dod kyi blo/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blo/ thar pa bsgrub na ci ma rung bsam pa'i sems shugs skye thub kyi yod pa red/ de skyes na thar pa dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la dka' ba med pa/ dam pa'i chos yas po bsgrub thub pa chags kyi red/ 'di'i phyir na thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro da lta blo ldog rnam pa bzhi la zer gyi yod pa red/ blo ldog zer rgyu de ga re las ldog dgos kyi red/ 'khor ba la zhen chags kyi blo'am 'khor ba la zhen cing chags pa'i rnam rtog 'di las ldog dgos kyi red/ 'khor ba la zhen cing chags pa'i rnam rtog 'di ldog ma thub na ches yag po gcig bzo thub kyi yod ma red/ de'i phyir na thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro bzhi 'di gal chen po red 'dugathun mongs ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro bzhi ni/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lam du zhugs pa la skyabs 'gro/ de'i nang nas theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa la sems skye 'di gnyis red/ de nas sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs par byed pa la sdig pa dang sgrib pa yod red/ sdig sgrib kyis sgrib bsdad pa'i skabs su sems kyi gnas lupy-is

'di rtogs dka' ba/ lta ba'i skabs su nges shes skye dka' ba/ bsgom pa'i skabs su rtogs dka' ba yin pa'i phyir na sdig sgrib sbyong dgos kyi yod red/sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgoms bzlas dang / sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog dgos kyi red/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ma bsag na sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po de rtogs dka' ba'i phyir na bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa la maṇḍal dang byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la'ang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs dbos kyi red/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs rang gi sems rgyud la zhugs par byed pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor te thun mongs ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro bzhi dang / de nas phyag rgya chen po'i khyad par gyi sngon 'gro bzhi yod red/ de'i nang nas skabs 'dir thun mongs phyi'i sngon 'gro ba'is blo las su rung ba byed de thun mongs ma yin pa nang gi sngon 'gro bzhi'i nyams len gyi rim pa de dgos kyi yod red/ de yang sngon 'gro'i chos 'di rnams sngon 'gro'i nyams len 'di rnams rgyun khyer du byed pa'i phyir rgyun du nyams su len pa'i phyir thun gyi rnga sgras bskul ba'i tshe na'ang thun bzung ba'i skabs su mkhar ja la sogs pa 'di tsho brdung nas sngon ma bsgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa rgya chenapo dar ba'i skabs su rgyun bzung gi yod red/ de 'dra po yin pa red/phyi 'dul khrims kyi dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen gang yin pa'i bslab pa dang mthun pas ldang ba rang dge slong dge tshul gang yin na'ang de'i bslab pa dang mthun pa zhogs pa yar ldang ba'am langs ba'i skabs su yang de dang mthun pa ldang dgos kyi 'dug phyi'i kun spyod red/ nang smon 'jug gi byang chub sems bskyed dang ldan pas 'tshogs la nang byang chub sems kyi nyams len ni smon pa byadī chub sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na ci

ma rung bsam pa'i sems de smon pa sems bskyed red/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub par bya ba'i ched du dngos su nyams len byed pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed red smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa'i sgo nas 'tshogs la/ byang chub kyi sems med na theg chen gyi lam la 'gro mi thub pa'i phyir na 'tshogs la zer dus 'dzoms la dkon mchog gi rten la gus pas phyag 'tshal/ dkon zer rgyu de spyir btang 'jig rten pa 'i lugs la rgyu gser dang dngul dang rin po che la sogs pa dkon po zer gyi red pa/mchog zer rgyu de dkon po yin na'ang mchog tu gyur pa/ dkon ing mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir na dkon mchog zer gyi red/ dkon mchog de la sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum red/ da bsgrub pa byed pa'i skabs su dkon mchog gi rten rgyas bsdus ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang dkon mchog gi rten rung ba red/ dper na rdo rje dril bu gcig yod na de la'ang dkon mchog gi rten tshang gi red/ de 'dra yin dus dkon mchos gi rten la gus pa chen po'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/ gus pas phyag 'tshal zer rgyu de spyir btang phyag 'tshal ba de la'ang lugs srol dang bstun te phyag 'tshal ba gcig dang gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal tshul gnyis yod red/ 'di'i skabs su dkon mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal zer ba red/ lugs srol gyi phyag 'tshal tshul dper na a pha a ma dad pa'i sgo nas lha khang la phyag 'tshal na phru gu tsho yang mnyam por phyag 'tshal ba de dad pa gang mu shes na'ang lugs srol gyi sgonas phyag 'tshal ba red/ de tsam ma yin pa gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/gsang sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi spyir btang gsang sngags zer rgyu de gsang ba'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pa dang / gsang zer rgyu de shin tu rtogs paradaka' ba'i lta ba zab mo yod pa'i phyir na gsang ba/ sngags zer rgyu de mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas sam rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis baktod

bsngags bya ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir na sngags kyang zer gyi red/ de yang skabs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi brka' dang dam tshig la gnas pas/ bka' la gnas zer rgyu de rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' gang gnang ba ba'in du bsgrub na bka' la gnas pa red/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ji ltar yod pa de la gnas na dam tshig la gnas pas bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pas/ mdor bsdus na rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' la gnas/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgo nas bzhug gral du/ gang bzhug pa'i gral du/ bzhug gral zer rgyu 'di'i skabs su rang sacig pu ma yin pa sgrub pa po mang po yod pa'i tshig red 'dug dper na sngar brka' brgyud pa la sgrub pa po ha cang mang po yod pa ri khrod dang brag phug dang dbeen gnas de tsho thams cad la sgrub pa pos gang ba de 'dra byung yod red/ de'i phyir na bzhus gral du lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pas 'khod/ spyir btang chos lnga dang rnam snang chos bdun la solas pa mi 'dra ba yod red/ de tsho rjes sor nges don rgya mtsho dang nges don sgron me'i skabs su yong gi red/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song bar 'chi chos yang dag par byed de snyam pas zhal 'don gyi dus su yang rig pa ma yengs par sgra don dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag nas zhes bya ba gsung ste/ nga tsho'i chos bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ chos de yang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song ba gcig dgos kyi 'dug chos brgyad ni rnyed pa mi rnyed pa/ bstod pa smad pa/ snyan pa mi snyan pa/ bde ba mi bde ba dang brgyad red/ rnyed pa la sogs pa ba'i de yag po red/ de la 'jig rten pa tsho zhen chags skye yi yod red/ mi snyan pa la sogs pa bzhi de sdug chag red/ de la mi dga' ba yong gi yod red sems pham gyi yod red/ rnyed pa la sogs pa bzhi thob pa dang mi rnyed pa la sogs pa ba'i bral ba'i ched du chos byed pa yin na rdos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba'i chos red chos brgyad kyi chos yin pa'i phyir

na chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song ba cig bzo dasos kyi 'dug mdor bsdu na tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags kyi ched du chos byed pa yin na chos brgyad kyi chos red/ 'chi chos yang dag par byed do snyam pas/ 'chi chos zer rgyu de chos kyi mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ thas nye sa nas bsam blo btang yong dus 'chi chos zer rgyu de 'chi ba'i skabs su phan pa 'i chos zhig bzo dgos snyam pa 'di red/ snyam zer rgyu bsam pa red/ nga tsho mi'i 'gro ba la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gtso bor gyur pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ dper na dgra dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ lus longs spyod la brten pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa yod na'ang nga tsho'i sdug bsngal che shos ni 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal de red/srogagi dbang po 'gags te lus sems kyi 'brel ba chad yong ba'i skabs su sdug bsngal gzhan gyi gnod pa gang yang med pa gcig chags yong gi red/'chi ba'i skabs su sdug bsngal che shos 'di red pa/ 'chi ba'i skabs su phan pa 'chi chos yang dag pa zhig byed do snyam pas(khyed rnam pa 'di'i dag cha de tsho thams cad mnyam por yi ge bris na da lta bsgrub rgyud pa'i slob grwa bsgrub pa'i bshad grwa 'dra po byung na yag po yong gi red ) zhal 'ardon gyi dus su mtshams mtshams kha ton yang zer yang zer gyi 'dug zhal 'don gyi dus su kha ton gyi skabs su yang rig pa ma yengs par/ spyir btang rig pa 'di sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal la rig pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa yod red/'di'i skabs kyi rig pa 'di sems la go dgos/ sems dang rig pa gnyis su dbye ba'i rig pa ma red/ spyir btang sems la go dgos pa red/ rig pa ma yengs pa/ sems ma yengs pa/ sems ga'an du ma yengs par sgra don dbyer med du sgra de ga re red zer na/ dang po bsgom bya dal 'byor rin chen py-idi/

thob dka' 'jig sla da res don yod bya/ zhes pa de sgra red/ yi ge de sgra 'di ston pa'i gzugs yin na'ang don de dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi'i lus 'di shin tu thob dka' ba 'di don red de yag po dran dgos kyi yod pa red/ sgra don dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag nas de'i sgra don gnyis po de la rig pa phra ba byed na dbu tshad kyi lugs la sgra dang don la so sor 'dra po bshad pa'ang yod red/ dngos gnas don gyi steng la 'grel ba med pa yod red/ tha snyad kyi skabs su sgra don gnyis dbyer med pa red/ dper na me zhes pa'i sgra 'di tsha zhing bsreg pa 'di dang dbyer med pa red/ nga tshos tsha zhing bsreg pa mthong yong dus me mthong song bsam/ me bsam dus tsha zhing bsreg pa dang dbyer med pa'i bsam blo yod red/ de dang 'dra po red/ tha snyad kyi skabs su sgra don dbyer med de ltar bzhag nas mi lus dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid kyi ngag 'don ni/ da mi'i lus 'di 'gro ba rig drug gi nang nas thob dka' shos red/ dal zer rgyu 'di mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dam mi dal ba brgyad las ldog pa'i cha nas dal ba brgyad ldan/ 'byor ba bcu ni rang 'byor lnga dang ga'an 'byor lnga yod red/ dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i mi'i lus rten 'di rshan tu rnyed dka' ba'i phyir na rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid kyi rim pa rgya chen po yod pa red/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid de la rgya chen po yod na'ang 'di'i skabs su ngag nas 'don pa de mdor bsdus gcig gsung pa red/ khrid kyi ngag 'don ni/ ngag gi 'don yas ni/dang po bsgom bya dal 'byor rin chen 'di/ thob dka' 'jig sla da res don yod bya/ bsgom bya mi 'dra ba mang po yod na'ang dang po bsgom bya zer dus thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub par 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi dang po bsgom par bya ba ga re bsgom dgos kyi 'dug dang po bsgom parwasdu dal 'byor rin chen 'di dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i

mi'i lus rten 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la sa dgos 'dod byung ba ba'in du dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di la brten te dam pa'i chos bsgrub na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub thub pas na rin po che dang 'dra po red/ de'i phyir na mi lus rin chen 'di zer nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus la rin po che'i tha snyad gsungs pa red/ de bzhin du dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i lus rten de la brten te dam pa'i chos bsgrub na rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub thub pa'i phyir na rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa red/yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra po red/ mi lus rin chen 'di zer rgyu de rang dal 'byor gyi mi lus yin pa gzhir bzhag nas 'di zer nas thag nye ba'i tshig red 'dug dal 'byor gyi mi lus de rgyu'i sgo nas thob dka' ba/dpe'i sgo nas thob dka' ba/ grangs kyi sgo nas thob dka' ba de tsho khrid yig rgyas pa las mang po gsungs yod pa red/ khyed rnam pa nges don sgron me/nges don rgya mtsho/ rdzogs chen dpal sprul gyi zhal lung de tsho klog na dpe gsal po dang yag po yod red/ mi lus rin chen 'di thob dka' ba ga 'dra ze thob dka'/ mi lus thob pa la rgyu skye ba sngon ma tshul khrims kyi sgo nas thob dka' ba/ dpe'i sgo nas thob dka' ba/ grangs kyi sgo nas thob dka' ba red/ 'o na dal 'byor gyi mi lus de thob dka' las khag po ('jig yang dka' las khag po ) red pas (ma red ) thob dka' las khag po red/'jig las sla po red/ dper na nga tsho'i lus rten 'di rkyen drag po dang glo bur du 'phrad pa'i skabs su 'jig gi red/ de rkyen dang ma 'phrad na'ang ga le ga le rang bzhin gyis zhig 'gro ba red/ me tog de skye dka' las khag po yod red/ cha tshang skyes tshar dus zhig yas de las sla po yod red/ 'dab ma de tsho rim pas gog 'gro ba red/ de bzhin du nga tsho rkyen ngan pa 'phrad na glo bur du zhig 'gro red/ de rkyen ma 'phrad na'ang rim pas rgad po chagadi ༵nga

dus nyin ma gcig la gang yang ma na na'ang thibs se 'gro red/ nang pa'i lugs la skyed byed la rgyu rkyen tshogs dgos kyi red/ 'jig byed dang shi byed la dngos gnas phra ba'i steng nas rkyen dgos kyi yod ma red/ 'jig pa rgyu med zer/ 'jig sla/ se gol gyi sgra de sgrag pa la rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po tshogs dgos red/ mar 'gag pa la rgyu dbos kyi yod ma red/ de'i phyir na nang pa'i lugs la 'jig pa rgyu med zer nas bshad yas yod red/ ha cang phra po yod red/ mdor bsdu na nga tsho lus la na tsha gang yang med na'ang gang mtshams 'ig nas rgad po chags dus nyi ma gcig la thibs se shi 'gro yi red/kha shas gnyid khug bsdad dus gnyid sad ma thub nas shi ba yod red/ de'i phyir na 'jig byed phra ba la dngos gnas mthar thus gi rkyen dgos kyi yod ma red/ 'jig las sla po yod red/ da res don yod bya/ dus da res don yod pa gcig bya dgos kyi 'dug rgyu mtshan ga re red/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus de thob dka' zhing 'jig sla ba'i phyir na da res dal 'byor gcig thob pa la don yod pa bya dgos kyi 'dug don yod pa de ga re red/ tshe 'di dgra 'dul gnyen skyong zas nor longs spyod bsags/ dzig po 'dra chags po zhig byed na 'di don yod red pas de ma red de mi rtag pa red/ glo bur du bzhag 'gro red/ don ga re red/ dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len bzo dgos kyi 'dugad res don yod bya/ mi la ras pas gsung mgur las gsungs pa bzhin du tshe 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur blta ste chos nyams len bzo dgos kyi yod red/yinana'ang dang po de dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i skabs su da res dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len yag po byed de don yod pa gcig bya dgos kyi 'dug dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len byed na don yod pa ga 'dra byed na bya thub kyi 'dugadam pa'i chos nyan len byed na 'khor ba de 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir na disnrol snang gi gnyen po de dam pa'i chos byed de rang 'khrul snang las grol

nas rang don grub/ rang 'khrul snang las grol te gzhan yang 'khrul snang sdug bsngal las grol ba'i thabs ston na gzhan don spub pas don gnyis bsgrub thub pa'i phyir na don yod pa dam pa'i chos red/ da ngas da res don yod pa zhig bya dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas sems shusas bskyed pa red/ tshig rkang gnyis kyi chos bsgrub pa'i sems shusas skyed pa red/gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa'arme tshe mi rtag pa red/ gnyis pa snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing / sgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur 'dra/ nam 'chi cha med thi tshe ro ru 'gyur/ de la chos kyis phan phyir brtson pas bsgrub/ zhes bya bar gsung ste/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba yag po sgom zin pa'i rjes su bsgom bya gnyis pa ga re red/ bsgom bya gnyis pa mi rtag pa red/ basbom bya gnyis pa mi rtag pa bsgom tshul ga 'dra red/ snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad mi rtag cing /mi rtag pa bsgom tshul sna tshogs pa 'ig yod na'ang mdor bsdu na 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten de mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang mi rtag cing / snod bcud thams cad zer dus phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mi rtag pa red/ de dag pa'i 'ing la sogs pa la go yas ma red/ 'khor ba'i snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing / bcud kyi sems can yang kha shas rtag pa kha shas mi rtag pa red pas/ ma red/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad mi rtag pa red/ snod bcud thams cad mi rtag pa red/ sgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur 'dra/sgos su khyad par du/ 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe srog de chu bur dang 'dra ba red/'gro zer rgyu de ga re red zer na/ las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug tu skye ba blangs pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / yang na las kyi dbang gis khams gsum gcig nas gcig tu skye ba blangs te 'gro ba'i phyir na 'gro ba rdodī gyi

red/ sgos su 'gro ba rnams kyi tshe srog de mi rtag pa chu bur lta bu red/ chu'i sbur ba de nang stong pa gcig yong ba/ de skad cig gis zhig 'gro gi red/bsdad thub yas yod ma red/ chu bur 'dra/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can mi rtag pa red/ rgyu mtshan ga re red/ 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir na mi rtas pa chu'i spur ba 'dra bo red/ de 'dra po bsam dgos kyi 'dug snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing sgos su 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi tshe srog chu bur dang 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na nam 'chi cha med pa/nam 'chi nges pa med pa/ ga dus 'chi tan tan yod ma red/ nga tsho de 'dra po zhig yin pa'i phyir na nga rang de ring 'chi gi ma red bsam pa'i yid ches brtan po de bzo thub kyi yod ma red yin na'ang rtag 'dzin gyi dbang gis gcig bzo gi yod red/ phal che ba rgyun ring po gnas bldad pa 'dra po gcig yod pa red de tan tan de rang gi yid ches bzo mi thub pa red 'duganam 'chi cha med pa nges pa med pa de thar rgyan las nam 'chi cha med pa sogs la 'chi ba sgo drug tu bsgom stangs ha cang yag po gsungs yod pa red/ nam 'chi cha med pa yin na'ang shi tshar dus ga 'dra yong gi red/ shi tshe ro ru 'gyur/nga tsho shi tshar dus rnam shes de skyid po gcig la 'gro/ phung po de yid du 'ong ba yag po zhig chags song na shi na'ang khyad par mi 'dug pa/ yin na'ang rnam shes de las kyi dbang gis rang dbang med pa rmi lam bzhin du 'khrul te 'khor ba la 'gro/ nga tsho'i gzugs po de ro ru gyur te mi gtsang ba yid du mi 'ong ba sdug chag zhig chags yong ba'i phyir na 'chi ba de dpe dka' las khag po gcig yod pa red/ mi la ras pas/ ro zhes bya mthong na 'jigs pa de/ dus da lta rang gi rtsa na gda'/ gsungs pa red/ ro zhes bya mthong na 'jigs pa skyug bro ba ya nga ba 'jigs skrag skye ba de nga tsho'i rtsa na 'dug zer/ de ga re red/nga rdo~X dbug de chad tshar song na ro red/ lus sems kyi 'brel ba ma chad kyi

bar ro ma red/ lus sems kyi 'brel pa chad yong dus ro red/ na nas 'chi 'gro/ 'chi 'gro dus lus sems kyi 'brel ba chad 'gro/ chas yong dus gzugs po'i dbyibs nyams kha dog nyams stobs nyams nus pa nyams dri ma ngan pa byung nas dpe dka' las khag po chags yong bzhin 'dug pa/ deng sang sman khang nang mtshams mtshams skor ba rgyab nas 'gro dgos kyi red/ mi tshog 'dra byung 'dug nga rang yang ga 'dra yong gi red bsam na chos bsgrub pa la phan thog yod red/ chos ma bsgrub de tsho ma bsam na dga' 'dug zer nas phyi rgyal tshos zer gyi 'dug go da 'chi ba'i skabs su rnam shes bar do 'khor ba la rang dbang med par 'khyams zhing las kyi dbang gis rang dbang med par 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor zhing gzugs po ro ru 'gyur yong na thabs ga re 'dug de la chos kyis phan phyir brtson pas bsgrub/ de 'dra po 'jigs su rung ba'i shi ba phung po ro ru 'gyur/ rnam shes rang dbang med pa chags yong ba'i skabs su pha ma gnyen 'brel gyis phan gyi ma red/ bskyab thub kyi ma red/ zas nor longs spyod kyis kyang phan gyi ma red/ stobs dang dbang thang gis kyang phan gyi ma red/ gang gis kyang mi phan pa dka' las khag po de'i skabs su ga res phan gyi red/ chos kyis phan phyir/ dam pa'i chos kyis phan gyi red/ dam pa'i chos de 'khrul snang sdug bsngal gyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir na dam pa'i chos kyis phan gyi red/ ga 'dra byed na phan gyi red/mi lam ngo ma shes pa'i skabs su mes 'tshig shing chus 'khyer ba'i sdug bsngal myong na rmi lam ngo shes pa'i shes rab kyis mi lam ngo ma shes pa'i skabs kyi mes 'tshig pa dang chus 'khyer ba'i sdug bsngal las grol thub pa bzhin du 'khor ba de 'khrul snang yin pa'i phyir na dam pa'i chos 'khrul snang ngo shes pa'i nyams len red/ 'khrul snang ngo shes pa'i nyams len gyis phan gyi red/ de brtson pas bsgrub/ brtson 'grus bzo dgos kyi 'dug gsungs pa red/ dpe1 ṭwāṃ mi

gcigathi lam nang mes 'tshig chus 'khyer nas dka' las khag po byung na mi lam gyi 'khrul pa de las grol ba'i thabs sam yang na mi lam yin pa nges rshas skye ba'i thabs gcig bzo yas yod na ci drag gang drag bsam gyi red pa/spyir btang nga tsho'i mi lam 'khrul pa de stobs che ba'i stobs kyis tshe 'di dang mi 'dra ba tshe 'di'i gnas lus longs spyod gnyen grogs dang mi 'dra ba ha cang khyad mtshar po'i mi lam zhig thar na'ang bag chags kyi stobs kyis rmi lam yin pa bsam blo gtong shes kyi mi 'dug nga tshos gzhan dngos gnas byed na tshe 'di la nyin mo la rtsa nas med pa'i sa gcig la slebs nyin mo'i grogs dang ha cang 'brel ba med pa'i khyad mtshar po de 'dra la slebs na rmi lam red bsam pa'i bsam blo gcig gtong shes dgos bsam bsam sacig 'dug go yin na'ang bag chags kyi stobs kyis bsam blo gtong bes kyi mi 'dus pa/ de nang bzhin nga tsho'i rgyud la 'khrul pa ha cang stobs chen po gcig yod pa red/'khrul pa stobs chen po de ga re red/ rtsa ba ma rig pa red/ ma rig pa la brten nas 'khrul gyi yod red/ 'khrul snang ngo shes par byed pa de dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len red/ khyad par du bka' rgyud pa'i lugs la thabs lam na ro chos drug dang grol lam phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de 'khrul snang ngo shes pa'i thabs red/ 'khrul snang ngo shes pa'i thabs zab mo/ 'khrul snang ngo sprod pa'i man ngag zab mo yod pa red/ da brtson pas sgrub/ nga brtson 'grus byed nas bsgrub dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas sems shugs che ru btang pa red/thag thung thung nas bsam blo btang yong dus 'chi ba'i tshe phung po ro ru gyur rnam shes las kyi dbang gis rang dbang med par gyur pa'i skabs su phan pa de dam pa'i chos red 'dug de'i phyir na ngas chos la brtson pas bsgrub dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas sems shusas che ru btang dgos pa red 'dug16da bsgom bya gsum pa de las rgyu 'bras red/ las rgyu 'bras ni/ sasum

pa shi tshe rang dbang mi 'dug bar/ las ni bdag gir bya phyir sdig pa spangs/dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya/ zhes bsam nyin re rang rgyud nyid la brtag ces bya ba gsungs te da bsgom bya gsum pa ni shi ba'i tshe/ shi ba'i skabs/ shi ba'i dus su/ rang dbang mi 'du ba'am rang dbang rang la rtsa nas med pa gcig chags yas yod red/ shi tshe rang dbang mi 'dug pa de sus bzos pa red/ dkon mchog gis bzos pa red pas zer na dkon mchog gis bzos pa ma red/ dkon mchog gis shi ba'i skabs su rang dbang med pa gcig bzos na/ dkon mchog de sdug po chags kyi red/ 'o na 'dud kyis bzos pa red pas/ 'dud kyis kyang bzos pa ma red/ 'o na rang dbang mi 'dus pa de rgyu med pa rkyen med pa rgyang phen pa nang bzhin rang bzhin gyis chags kyi yod red pas/ de yang ma red/ rgyu med rkyen med kyis chags na sdug bsngal las grol thub kyi ma red/ sdug bsngal med pa bzo thub kyi ma red/ 'o na ga re red/ shi ba'i tshe rang dbang mi 'dug pa de las la rag las pa red/ las ni bdag gir bya phyir/ da 'khor bar rang dbang med pa 'khor ba de las kyis byed pa yin pa'i phyir na/ shi ba'i tshe rang dbang mi 'dug pa de yang las las byung ba red/ shi tshe rang dbang mi 'dug pa de las las byung zhing las la rag las pa red/ las de yang gzhan gyi byed pa'i las kyis rang la rang dbang med pa chags pa lta bu yin na bzo yas yod ma red/ de 'dra ma red/ las ni bdag gi bya phyir/ rang gis byed pa'i las kyi 'bras bus rang la rang dbang med pa chags pa yin pa de'i phyir na/ sdig pa spangs/ rang dbang med pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal myong byed de sdig pa'i las kyi dbang las byung ba'i phyir na sdig pa spong dgos kyi 'dug rang gi las kyis rang la dbang med pa chags pa de dper na las bsags te las kyi dbang gi 'khrul snang shar nas 'khrul snang gi dbang las sdug bsngal myong ste rang tāshāng

med pa chags pa red/ 'khrul sna nga gi dbang las skye rsha bzo ste sdug bsngal myong pa de sdig pa la rag las pa/ sdig pa la balhos pa sdig pa la brten nas byung ba yin pa 'i phyir na sdig pa spangs/ dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya/ rang dbang yod pa dang 'khrul pa'i snang ba shar na'ang 'khrul snang yag po dang bzang po shar ba de dge ba la rag las pa red/ dper na da lta gnas skabs kyi bde ba 'khrul pa yin na'ang 'khrul pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal mi skye pa bde ba skyes pa de dge ba'i las la rag las pa red 'dug dge ba'i las la rag las pa'am dge ba'i las la bltos dgos pa'i phyir na/ dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya/ dge ba'i bya ba zer rgyu de dge ba'i las ka bzo dgos kyi 'dug dge ba'i bya ba'am dge ba'i las ka bzo dgos kyi 'dugalus ngag yid gsum gyis dge ba'i las ka bzo dgos kyi 'dug lus kyis phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed na lus kyi dge ba red/ ngag gis kha tog bzlas brjod byed na ngag gi dge ba red/ sems kyis byams pa snying rje sogs chos kyi dmigs pa bsgom na sems kyi dge ba red de'i phyir na dge bas bya ba'am las ka bzo dgos kyi 'dug dge ba'i bya ba dang dge ba'i las ka de mtshams mtshams bzo rtag tu ma byed na 'grig gi 'dug gas/ rtag tu 'da' bar bya/thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub 'dod na dge bas bya ba rtag tu 'da' b.rakhya/ rtag tu 'da' zer rgyu de/ rtag tu rgyun du 'da' zer rgyu de bya ba thams cad dge ba'i las ka bzo na tshe 'di dge ba'i las ka byed de rdzogs dgos kyi 'dug yang gnas skabs kyi lha dang mi'i bde ba bsgrub pa 'dra po gcig yin na bar ta bar ta la dge ba re bsgrub yang 'jig rten gyi las ka bzo gi yod red/ de gnas skabs kyi bde ba bsgrub pa la 'grig gi yod red/de thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub pa la rtag tu dge ba bzo dgos kyi yokā ṭwāṃd/ de'i phyir na dge bas bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya/ da nga tsho'i mi

pa'ang zer gyi 'dug rdzogs chen gyi tha snyad la rig thog tu bzhag pa rig pa rang la bzo bcos ma byed pa rig pa rang gi ngang du bzhag pa zer/ rig 'tsho ma zhig par bzhag zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong ngam rig stong yin pa'i phyir na rig 'tsho ma zhig pa rig pa rang tshugs ma zhig pa zhag bya 'jog byed yod pa ma red de yin na'ang rang bab tu gnas pa la bzhag zer ba red 'dug de la ma yengs skyong lugs kyang rje btsun mi la ras pas brag srin mo la gsungs pa'i mgur de'i nang la/ khyod lta ba blo 'das kyi don la ltos/ sgom pa yengs med kyi ngang du zhog ces gsungs pa red/ de bzhin duspyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ / blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ / gsungs pa gnyis ka don la gcig pa red/ lta ba blo 'das lta ba spros bral lta ba khas len las 'das pa gcig pa red/ sgom pa yengs med kyi ngang la zhog zer ba 'di lta ba 'di'i ngang du ma yengs par bzhag zer ba red/ des na mthar thug spyod 'bras kyang mi la ras pa'i mgur las lta ba stong pa'i ye shes yin/ sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin/ zhes gsungs pa red/ lta ba don dam mthar thug 'di stong pa'i ye shes sam rig stong dbyer med la zer/ rig stong dbyer med zer dus rdzogs chen dang tshig mthun po yod red/ 'o na bsgom na ga re red/ sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin/'od gsal 'di 'dzin pas ma bslad par 'dzin med zhes pa dgag sgrub rnam rtog gis ma bslad pa'am rnam rtog gis mi g.yo ba rang 'tsho ma zhig par 'dzin pa la zer gyi red/ 'o na rnam rtog bkag dgos kyi 'dug pas zer na phyag chenardzogs chen gyi lugs la rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul lam ngo bo chos sku las ma 'das pas na bkag dgos kyi min 'dug sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog spyod pa ga 'dra zhig byed na'ang lta sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba sgom gyi rtsal sbyong du 'gyur thub na spyod pa'i mchog zer gyi red/ dasdiṭwāṃ na

shā tram̐ rdzu /sna sdo ṭī kā tta/sa kyi 'dug bsam dgos pa red/ zhes bsam nyin re gsum pa shi tshe rang dbang med pa de las yin gyi las ni bdag gir byed pa yin pa de'i phyir na rtag tu sdig pa spangs zhing dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya zhes pa de 'dra bsam zhing bsam zer rgyu de bsam blo red/ de blo ldog gi skabs su bsam blo gtong tshul red/ da bsam blo btang ste sems la 'gyur ba bzo dgos kyi yod red/ zhes nyi ma gcig tsam gnyis tsam bsam nas g.yug bzhag na 'grig gi mi 'dug nyi ma re re ba'in du bsam nas rang rgyud nyid la brtag rang rgyud zer yas de rang gi gzugs po tsam dang rang gi lus kyi tshor ba la brtag pa tsam ma yin pa de'i skabs su rang rgyud de rang gi sems la brtag dgos kyi 'dug rang gi sems la brtag dpyad btang dgos kyi 'dug da nged kyi sems dge ba'i bsam blo btang bzhin 'dug gam sdig pa'i bsam blo btang bzhin 'dug brtag dgos kyi 'dug 'khor ba mi rtag pa bsams sems can la byin pa dang snying rje bsgom pa de 'dra po yod na dge ba'i sems red/— da dga' ba bsgom dgos kyi 'dug dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la sogs pa de 'dra po dang mnar sems gnod sems dang sems can gzhan la gnod pa byed pa'i bsam blo yod na ngag pa'i sems red/de spangs dgos kyi 'dug zhes bsam nyin re rang rgyud nyid la brtag zhes bsam ste nyin ma re re bzhin du rang gi rgyud dam rang gis sems la brtag tāsdod/ gtong dgos kyi 'dug 'di da gsum pa las rgyu 'bras bsgom tshul bsgomakhya bzhi pa ga re red zer na/ bzhi pa 'khor ba'i gnas grogs bde 'byor sogs/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i phyir/ gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' ston ltar/ zhen 'khris bcad nas ༵zlon

pas byang chub sgrubs/ da bsgom bya ba'i pa de gang la'ang zhen pa dang chags pa spangs te brtson 'grus chen po'i sgo nas byang chub bsgrub dgos kyi 'dug gsungs pa red/ zhen 'khris bcad nas brtson pas byang chub bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig dgos kyi 'dug rgyu mtshan yod na zhen 'khris bcad kyi yin/ med na bcas kyi min zer na/ da rgyu mtshan gcig bshad dgos kyi 'dug bzhi pa 'khor ba'i gnas grogs bde 'byor sogs/ srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas dang / 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang grogs gcig yong gi red/ mi la mi grogs/ lha la skye na lha'i grogs/ lha min la skyes na lha min gyi grogs/ dud 'gro la skyes na dud 'gro'i grogs/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags la dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi grogs 'dra po yong gi yod pa red 'dug de yang bden par grub pa ma red/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i grogs gcig yong gi yod pa red/ 'khor ba'i gnas grogs/ dmyal ba mnar med nas srid rtse bar gyi gnas dang dmyal ba nas 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang grogs gcig yong gi yod pa red/ bde 'byor sogs dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum la bde 'byor yod ma red/ ngan 'gro red/ mtho ris lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gsum la gnas skabs kyi bde skyid dang 'byor pa yod red/ 'byor zer yas de longs spyod la go dargos pa red/ kha shas la 'byor pa chen po yod red/ 'byor ba che shos lha red/ 'byor ba yod na'ang sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i phyir/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar zer rgyu de sdug bsngal gyis dka' las khag po bzos bsdad pa dang nyam thag pa la zer ba red/ sdug bsngal de la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal 'di gsum la zer ba red/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer rgyu de nga tsho'i sdug bsngal gcig gi steng du gcig byung ba lta bu la sdug bsngal gyi sdukā ༵sngal zer/ sbyir btang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yod pa de'i steng du

sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dmigs su 'char yong ba de la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer gyi 'dug dang po nas nga tsho'i phung po lnga la zhen cing chags pa yod pa'i skabs su rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal rtogs mi thub pa gcig yod pa red/de'i steng du tshor ba sdug bsngal zug mi thub pa chags yong dus sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer gyi 'dug 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zer rgyu de gnas skabs kyi bde ba yod na'ang bde ba de sdug bsngal du 'gyur 'gro ba/ bde ba sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba/ bde ba la brten te sdus bsngal 'phel ba de 'dra po la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zer gyi red 'dug dper na 'dzam gling nang gi mi gcig la dang po lus la nad med sems la sdug bsngal med/ nor longs spyod dang gnyen grogs phun sum tshogs pa yod na'ang de 'gyur te sdug bsngal yong gi red/ de ma 'gyur na'ang de la bden par zhen pa'i dbang gis rang ba'in gyi sdug bsngal gnyid khug mi thub pa de 'dra bo yong gi yod pa red 'dugaspyir btang dman pa rnams la lus kyi sdug bsngal zer ba red/ sdug bsngal chung gi red zer gyi 'dug chen po rnams la sems kyi sdug bsngal gnyid mi khug pa'i sdug bsngal yod red zer gyi 'dug phyi nas 'dra chags po mdzes po yod pa la rang bzhin gyis sems kyi steng nas sdug bsngal yod pa des gnyid khug mi thub pa red 'dug lus kyi sdug bsngal de nyal sa skyid po gcig byung /kha lag zhim po gcig byung na gnyid las sla po khug 'gro gi red/ ha ha/ da de tsho thams cad nga tsho'i nyams myong gis shes thub pa red/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer rgyu de phung po lnga blangs pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal yod pa/ phung po lnga la zhen pa yod pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal de 'dra po red/ sdug bsngal zer rgyu de sems 'khrug byed red/ sems 'khrug par byed pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i phyir/ dus rgyun du mnar ba'i phyir/ dka' las khag po yod pa'i phyir/ gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' stogā spyar/

da mi nyes pa can gcig rgyal khab kyi khrims dang 'gal nas gsod dgos kyi yod na/ gsod par zer dus/ gsod pa'i sa cha gcig la khrid pa ma gtogs mi de ga sa ga la bsad chog gi yod ma red/ rgyal khab so sos khrims gtong sa'i sa cha yod pa red 'dug gang gsod par bya rgyu'i mi de gshed ma'am gsod pa po rnams kyis gsod par khrid pa'i mi de la dga' ston gsham na gang yang phan gyi ma red/ de la zhen chags yang skye yi ma red/ kha shas mi gsod ran dus kha lag sprad yong dus dpe med mang po za thub kyi 'dug zer gyi 'dug ga 'di gang yin zer na sems ltogs skrag gi 'jigs snang chags 'gro ba'i skabs su gcig za yong dus rgyag yas med pa 'dra po chags 'gro gi yod sa red/ kha shas mid pa 'gag 'gro gi yod red/ de 'dra'i lo rgyus bshad yas mang po 'dug zhen 'khris zer nas tshig mnyam por lab na nus pa chen po yod rpāred/ da mdor tshur bsdu na tshe 'di'i 'khor ba'i gnas dang grogs dang bde skyid 'byor pa longs spyod ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi phyir na gsod par khrid pa'i mi la gsod pa de la gshed ma'i dga' ston gsham na zhen 'khris med pa de bzhin du zhen 'khris bcad nas brtson pas byang chub sgrub/ da 'di 'dra bo'i 'khor ba'i gnas grogs bde 'byor la zhen chags med pa gsod par khrid pa'i mi de la gshed ma'i dga' ston gsham pa lta bu'i sems skyes pa yin na a ni thar pa don gnyer gyi blo skye thub kyi yod red/ 'khor ba la zhen chags kyi blo de ldog ma thub pa yin na thar pa don gnyer gyi blo ngo ma skye thub kyi ma red/bcos ma 'dra ngo gcig bzo yi yod red de bcos ma ma yin pa'i thar pa don gnyer gyi blo de skyes pa la 'khor ba la zhen chags med pa'i blo de skyes dgos pa red/ zhen 'khris bcad nas brtson pa'i byang chub sgrub/ de yang kun bzang bla ༵sbya zhal lung las gsung yod red/ mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad de ga

'dra zhig dgos kyi 'dug zer na/ mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad de dge bshes kha rag sgom chung bzhag pa red/ don dag tshe 'di'i bya ba byed longs med pa dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len kho na ma gartosas las ka gzhan byed longs med pa gcig dgos kyi yod pa red 'dugalas rgyu 'bras rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad de rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa 'dra po gcig dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug mi la ras pas mar pa lo tsā'i bka' bzhin sras mkhar dgu thog bzhengs nas dka' ba chen po de ltar spyad nus pa de las 'bras la yid ches skyes nas dka' ba sbyad pa red ma gtogs/ las 'bras la yid ches med na dka' ba spyad kyi ma red/ khong mthu brgyab nas sdig pa chen po bsags pa la brten te tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag gcig med na 'gro sa gcig ma gtogs med bsam nas sems thag chod 'dug go rnam thar la yod red/ dka' ba spyad de gdams ngag thob na'ang rdo'i mchod kong mar khus bkangs te zla ba bcu gcig g.yo 'gul med par sgrub pa brgyabs pa nas bzung ste phyi'i rdzong drug nangagi rdzong drug gsang ba'i rdzong drug yang rdzong gnyis dang nyi shu yongs su grags pa'i phug chen bzhi la sogs pa la tshe 'di'i bya bzhag blos btang ste sgrub pa brgyabs pa de yang las 'bras la yid ches pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin zer nas mi la ras pa rang bis gsungs 'dug go khyed sangs rgyas byang sems rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa yin sa red zer dus nga la dag snang byed pa de yag po red/yin na'ang khyed rang tsho chos zab mo nyams su len pa'i khyad chos ma mthong pa red/ chos la log lta red gsungs 'dug pa/ las 'bras la yid ches na nga 'dra po'i snying stobs dang brtson 'grus thams cad la chags kyi red/ nga las 'bras la yid ches nas dka' ba spyad thub pa red/ gsungs 'dug go de yin dus las 'bras la yid ches pa mi la ras pa lta bu zhig dgos kyi red2/3 nga

tsho'i las 'bras la dngos gnas yid ches brtan po zhig chags na ga 'dra yong gi red zer na/ mi la ras pa 'dra po yong gi red/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la yid ches pa'i tshad de ga 'dra zhig dgos kyi red/ dasgye bshes glang ri thang pa 'dra po zhig dgos kyi 'dug bong mi tshe gcig la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rang bsam nas bzhad bgad shor ma myong ba red 'dug nyi ma gcig la maṇḍal steng du g.yu rdog rdog gcig yod pa de tsi tsis 'then nas 'drud ma thub pa 'gro bsdod dus 'al 'dzum tsam gnang ba red zer gyi 'dug yin na'ang de ma gtogs 'al 'dzum tsam yang gnang ma myong pa red/ de ni 'khor ba'i sdus bsngal bsgom pa'i tshad 'dra po yin pa red/ yin na'ang nga tsho theg pa chen po'i lugs la 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang ba'in bsgom gyi red de mthar thug sdug bsngal de yang bden par ma grub pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu bsgom gyi red ma satogs rtag tu sdug bsngal yang bsgom dgos kyi yod ma red/ nyan thos kyi lugs la phal cher rtag tu sdug bsngal bsgom dgos pa 'dra po yin pa red/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la dang po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom/ de nas sdug bsngal bden par ma spub pa mi lamasgyu ma lta bu bsgom ste mthar thug sdug bsngal las 'das 'gro gi red zer rnal 'byor mi la ras pas gsungs 'dug ngas dang po las nag po byed/bar du las dkar po byed/ da lta las kyi gzhi zad pa'i las dkar nag gnyis ka las 'das pa yin/ las kyi gzhi de ma rig pa dang bdag 'dzin red/ sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs/ ma rig 'gag yong pa'i skabs su las kyi gzhi zad 'gro ba red 'dug zhen 'khrid bcad nas brtson pas byang chub sgrub zer nas skul tshigs yod pa red/ rang gis kyang zhen 'khris bcad nas brtson pas byang chub bsgrub dgos kyi 'dug bsam dgos kyi swāṭā red/ de ltar bsam na thar pa don gnyer gyi blo yang dag pa skye yi red/

thar pa don gnyer gyi blo yang dag pa gcig skye yong na thun mongs ltar du byed na thar pa'i lam gyi sgo la zhugs pa red/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blo yang dag pa gcig rgyud la ma skyes na thar pa'i lam ngo ma la zhugs thub kyi med pa red 'dug de'i phyir na da blo jo ga rnam pa bzhi sgom dasos pa red/

karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung phyag chen smon lam gyi 'grel pa/'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasakyi go 'phang rin po che bsgrub par bya/ de'i ched du rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis brtson par bgyis snyam du bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed po sngon du btang ste gsan par zhu/ de yang skabs 'dir tshig 'grel kyi dbang du spyas nas mdor bsdus shisdu zhu na/na — gu rubla/ ṭā zlokā rdosngi ༵ dkā/ dkyil 'khor lha/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi smon lam rnams/ /ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin brlabs mdzod/ /ces bya ba gsungs te/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la/ yi dam/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla med kyi rgyud dang bzhi/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na swāspya pa'i rgyud la'ang/ pha rgyud ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud de dkyil

'khor gyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa red/sangs rgyas kyis dkyil 'khor spras te gsungs pa de dag gi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / phyogs bcu/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis te/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ 'das pa la phebs zin pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma 'ongs pa la phebs par 'gyur ba'i rgyal ba'am sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa/ da lta phebs bzhin pa'i sangs rgyas dang sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/bdag la brtser dgongs/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa po'am sgrub pa po bdag dang bdag 'dra ba rnams la'ang thugs brtse ba snying rje chen pos rjes su dgongs te/ bdag gi skabs 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras bu dang 'bras bu'i smon lam rnam par dag pa rnams/ da 'di bdag dang po karma pa rang byung rdo rje bdag la zer ba red 'dug nga tsho'i smon lam gyi skabs su smon lam 'debs pa po bdag dang phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa po bdag la go dgos pa red/ bdag gi smon lam rnam par dag pa 'di rnams/ ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin rlabs mdzod/ smon lam rnam par dag pa btab pa 'di rnams ji lta ba bzhin du ma nor ba nor 'khruladang bral ba ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur dang byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ spyir btang theg pa chen po'i lugs la smon lam gal chen po red/ 'di'i nang nas kyang gnas lugs don dam pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'am bde stong phyag rgya chen po dang / sems kyi gnas lugs ka dag rdzogs pa chen po sogs don dam pa'i bden pa 'di rtogs khag po red/ 'di rtogs pa la smon lam btab pa 'di smon lam zab mo dang phra mo red/ smon lam 'di dag 'grub pa la'ang mthun 'gyur dang byin rlabs dgos kyi yod dī ḍid/

phyosas bcu rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis smon lam 'di 'grub par gyur cig sasungs nas mthun 'gyur mdzad/ smon lam 'grub pa ra byin gyis brlab na smon lam 'grub las sla po yod pa red de'i phyir na smon lam 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur dang byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshigs bcad zer/bdas dang mtha' yas sem sa can thams cad kyi/ /bsam sbyor rnam dag gangs ri las skyes pa'i/ /'khor gsum rnyog med dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams/ /rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /bdag dang / bdag rang dang / spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la don dam par bdas med pa'am bdas tu ma thub pa yina'ang kun rdzob tu rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshosas tsam gyi bdag yod pa dang / sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i bdag yod pa red/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i bdag 'di skye ba sngon nas 'dir 'ong / 'di nas phyi mar 'gro/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i skabs su byang chub sgrub pa po'i bdag 'di sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu'i bdag yin pa 'i phyir na bdag dang zhes pa'i bdag 'di bden par ma grub na'ang 'khrul grol gyi ga'ir gyur ba'i bdag sgyu ma mi lam lta bu'i bdag dang / mtha' yas pa/ tshad med pa/grangs med pa/ ga'al du med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhes pa'i sems can la dgra gnyen bar ma gsum yod pas/ dgra gnyen gyi sems can thams cad kyi/ da theg pa chen po'i lugs la sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed dgos pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad de sangs rgyas dgos pa'i phyir na smon lam gyi skabs su dgra dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ched du smon lam btab dgos pa red/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam sbyor rnams dang gdīsdu ri las skyes pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa

byang chub kyi sems dang sbyor ba rnam pa ra dag pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nyams len nam yang na spyor ba rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems kun nas bslangs pas gzhan phan bsgrub pa'i spyod pa 'di tsho sbyor ba rnam par dag pa red/ de 'dra po'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus sa 'dra bzo na'ang bzo chog gi yod pa 'dug bsam sbyo ra rnam pa ra dag pa 'di gangs ri'i gzugs su bkod nas gangs ri la sa skyes pa'am gangs ri las byung ba'i chu bo'i rgyun 'di chu satsang la rgyun mi chad pa yo nga ba red 'dug sangs ri las skyes pa'i 'khor sasum rnyog med 'khor sasum 'di dper na sbyin pa btang ba lta bu yi rgyan sbyin pa po bdag dang sbyin yul dbul po dang sbyin bya'i dngos po ste 'khor sasum dmisas pa med pa de ba'in du tshul khrims kyi 'khor gsum bzod pa'i 'khor zer nas pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la sbyar dgos/ 'khor gsum rtog med 'khor gsum bden zhin gyis rtog pa med pa / gangs ri las byung ba'i chu bo'i rgyun 'di rtog pa dang 'brel na chu 'di yag po yod rme red/ chu gtsang ma yod ma red/ des las ldo ga ste rtog pa med pa rtog pa bral ba 'di 'thung du rung ba longs sbyod rung ba red de bzhin du 'khor gsum bden zhen gyi rtog pa med pa mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma'i rtog pa med pa'ang zer de 'khor gsum gyi dmigs pa 'di rtos pa 'i gzugs su de 'khor sasum rtog pa med pa bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs kyi rgyun rnams/ dase tshosas 'di chu bo'i rgyun gyi gzugs su bkod pa red/ dge tshogs kyi chu bo'i rgyun rnams/ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig rgyal ba 'di sku bzhi'i bdas nyid can red/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas bde gshesas don dag gcis pa red/ rgyal ba'am sangs rgyas sku ba'i'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod de/ rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par gyur cig bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can tham sa cad kyi bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa 'i sangs ri las skyedī ༵'i

'khor gsum rtog med kyi dge tshogs kyi chu bo'i rgyun chen po 'di sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi rgya mtsho la 'jug par gyur cig mdor na bdag gzhanasematrīrshan thams kocad bsam sbyo~X rnam dag gi dge tshogs rnams sangs rgyas lja 3 ṭwāṃsdosdobye kādī ṭwāṃrsha trīji nghrug/ /bai rsha sdo tram̐ ṭwāṃ / ༵༵༵ py-i / 3 rdzu zlog/sa /cing / /bde dge rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog /ji srid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa de srid du 'di'i bar du/ skye ba'am tshes 'di dang skye ba dang tshe rabs kun tu ste sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su nang pa'i lugs la skye ba thog ma med pa yin na'ang sangs rgyas thob na 'khor bar skyes pa 'di rgyun chad 'gro ba red/ de'i phyir na skye ba 'di dang tshe rab kun tu tshe rabs thams cad du sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags shing / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa byed pa lta ga la ste sdig pa'i sgra tsam yang mi grags pa dang / sdug bsngal dngos su myong ba lta ga la ste sdug bsngal gyi sgra tsam yang mi grags cing / bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i dpal la spyod pa shog da lta nga tsho'i tshe 'dir dge ba ci 'grub gang 'grub byas smon lam bzang po brgyab na skye ba phyi ma rnams su da lta rnam dkar gyi dge ba dang smon lam gyi stobs las rim bzhin dge ba 'di yang nus pa che ru che ru 'gro ba red/ da tshigs bcad 'di sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa'i las mi byed pa dang /bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba la spyod pa'i smon lam red/dal 'byor mchog thob dad brtson shes rab ldan/ /30 bshes gnyen bzang bsten gdams pa'i bcud thob nas/ /

tshul bzhin bsgrub la bar chad ma mchis par/ /tshe rabs kun tu dam chosaspyod par shog /dal 'byor/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu ste dal 'byor bco brgyadatshang ba'i lus rten 'di mi'i lus rten nang nas mchog tu gyur pa red/dal ba brgyad 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i lus rten mchog tu gyur pa thob pa dang /dad brtson shes rab ldan/ de yang sangs rgyas dang lam ston pa po sangs rgyas 'dis bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos la dad pa chen po yod pa/ chos 'di nyid bsgrub pa'am nyams su len pa la brtson 'grus yod pa dang / kun rdzob kyi snang tshul dang don dam gyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i shes rab 'di gal chen po red/ de'i phyir na dad brtson shes rab ldan pa zer/ deng sang phyi rgyal tsho la bshad pa byed pa'i skabs su mi'i lus rten dam pa'i chos la dad brtson shes rab ldan pa 'di bshad na las sla po yod red/ dad pa med na chos la mi 'jug brtson 'grus med na chos mthar phyin mi nus/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin mi nus pa'i phyir na brtson 'grus shes rab med na snang tshul dang gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin du mi shes/ snang tshul dang gnas tshul mi shes na don dmi pa'i bden pa rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir na dad brtson shes rab dang ldan zhing / bshes gnyen bzang bsten gdams pa'i bcud thob nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyer bzang po'am yang dag pa bsten te gdams ngag zab mo'i bcud thob nas/ tshul bzhin bsgrub la bar chad ma mchis par/ tshul bzhin bsgrub pa ji lta ba/ bsgrub pa/ ma nor ba bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi bar chad yod pa red 'dug gu ru'i gsol 'debs la gsungs pa bzhin du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad yod pa red 'dug gu ru'i gsol 'debs las gsungs pa bzhin du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad ma mchis par/'gal rkyen bar chad la 'grel ba dang / yang phyag rgya chen po dngos ṭwāṃ/sa

nyams len gyi skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad yang chos kyi grogs su 'char ba dang nyams len gyi grogs su 'char ba yod red/ 'di las dang po pa'i skabs su tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la bar chad ma mchis pa zer/ tshe rabs kun tu dam chosaspyod par shog skye ba 'di dang skye ba phyi ma tshes rabs kun tu ste sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du dam chos spyod par shog dam chos nyams su len par shog 'di tshe rabs kun tu dam chos spyod pa'i smon lam red/lungarigathosapasamiktosbyasgribalasagrol/cho /snanā dnghapy-i byāsdo rnyi ༵ sna wa dro ༵ snaṭwāṃ py-i pa rnoṅge sna/sal// /tshig bca/ ༵ ṭwāṃ ṭā ༵ ༵spra spra / dā ༵ shā~X sdu ༵ ṭwāṃ krās /rab sgom pa'i shes rab kyi 'od snang rgyas pa'i smon lam red/ lung rig thos pas mi shes sgrib las grol/ lung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa che chung rdo rje theg pa las gsungs pa 'di tshe thams cad red/ yang na mdo sngags kyi lung zhes pa dang dper na stong nyid bsgom pa lta bu zhig yin na lung 'ig dgos kyi 'dug lung 'di yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / deng sang bod kyi dgon pa thams cad la shes rab snying po blo 'don gnang ba red/ 'di yang lung zab mo dang bsdus pa zab mo yod pa red/ de ba'in mdo sngags nas gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lung zab mo slob sbyong byas nas thos pa dang rig pa 'di dpal phyogs kyi glang po dang chos kyi grags pa sogs kyis gsungs pa'i tshad ma'i rigs pa zabamo dang mgon po klu sgrub dang rgyal sras arya dme ba la sogs pa rang stong gi mkhas pa chen po rnams dang / gzhan stong gi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis snang tshul dang gnas tshul 'di tsho thams cad rigs pa'i rnam grangs mang po'i sgo /༵ bsgrubs te rigs pa mang po gsungs yod red/ de 'dra ba'i tshad ma'i

rigs pa dang stong nyid kyi rigs pa du ma yod pa thams cad thos pas/ thos pa tsam ma yin par thos pa'i don de dag la shes rab kyis phra 'ing phra ba dpyad de the tshom las grol na bsam pa'i shes rab yin/ lung rigs thos pa'i mi shes pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang lung rigs la rmongs pa'i sgrib pa las gro ba dang 'di'i steng du man ngag bsam pa'i the tshom mun nag bcom/ spyir btang theg pa chen po la man ngag yod red khyad par phyag rgya chen po dang rdzogs pa chen po sogs la'ang man ngag zab mo yod pa red/ man ngag de yang lung rgya chen po dang rigs pa de tsho thams cad phra ba dang mang po red de yin na'ang de dag gi don nyams su blangs bde ba sngon gyi mkhas pa grub thob rnams kyi don bsdus te bstan pa 'di 'dra po la man ngag zer ba yin/ man ngag zab mo'am gdams ngag zab mo rnams bsam pas the tshom gyi mun nag bcom pa dang/ lung rigs thos pa la brten nas mi shes pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang /mnangag zab mo bsam pa'i the tshom gyis mun nag bcom zhing sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ thos bsam gyi don 'di nyid thos pa dang bsam pa tsam ma yin par bsgom dgos/ ma bsgom na gnas lugs rtogs mi thub pa red/ dper na mi ltogs pa la zas go bas mi chog za dgos pa bzhin du stong nyid rtogs pa la'ang don go bas mi chog bsgom dgos gsungs pa red/de ltar don dam sems kyi gnas lugs la lung dang rigs pas dpyad nas the tshom med pa'i nges shes zab mo skyes/ nges shes zab mo skyes pa 'di'i ngang du rang babs su bzhag pa/ spyir btang gzhung chen po'i gsung tshul 'dra po byed na lta ba'i nges pa rnyed pa 'di'i ngang du rang babs su bzhag pa/ rang gi ngang du bzhag pa rang thog tu bzhag pa'i sgom byung 'od kyi zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ngo bo stong pa sprod bral dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal dang stong pa dang gsal ba gnyis kyang dbyer med pa yin pa'i phyir na 'od kyikā ktor

rgyu 'di sems rang babs su gnas na sgom byung gi shes rab brdol ba dang nyams myong khyad par can shar gyi yod pa red 'dug sgom byung 'di 'od kyi gzugs su bkod de dper na khang pa mun nag zhig gi nang du 'od med na dngos po 'di tsho mthong gi ma red/ 'od byung na khang pa 'di'i nang gi sku gsung thugs rten la sogs pa'i dngos po thams cad gsal bar mthong ba bzhin du sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ sgom byung gi 'od la brten nas gnas lugs don dam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'am rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs 'di nyid ji bzhin gsal/ ji bzhin gsal tshul 'di rtog ges rigs pa'i dpyad pa tsam ma yin pa/ rnam rtog gis sgro btags pa'ang ma yin pa/ yin snyam byed nas mos pa byed pa tsam ma yin pa ji bzhin mngon sum du gsal ba/ de lta bu'i shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par shes/ lung rigs thos pa'i mi shes pa'i sgrib las grol te thob pa'i shes rab skye/ man ngag bsam pas the tshom gyi mun nag las grol te bsam pa'i shes rab skye sgom byung gi 'od kyis gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs te sgom byung gi shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par shog da 'di sngon ma bzhin du bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshe 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan rnams su nyams len byed de thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum gyi 'od snang rgyas par shog zer nāsprasdusna ṭāṭātrī sdo //ga/ da 'di thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab 'phel rtag chad mtha' bral bden gnyis gzhi yi don/ /sgro skur mtha' bral tshogs gnyis lam mchog gis/ /srid zhi'i mtha' bral don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i/ /34 gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog /

da 'di gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad pa nor 'khrul las 'das pa'i chos dang phrad pa'i smon lam red/ gol ba dang 'chug pa med pa nor 'khrul med pa'i chos dang 'phrad na gang 'dra ze 'phrad dgos zhe na/ rtag chad mtha' bral/ lta ba gol 'chug med pa rtogs pa la rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba bden gnyis dbyer med kyi gzhi'i gnas lugs la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / lta ba gzhi'i gnas lugs rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral te bden gnyis dbyer med kyi gzhi'i don ma nor ba rtogs pa dang / sgro skur mtha' bral tshogs gnyis lam chog gis/ sgro 'dogs pa dang skur ba 'debs pa'i mtha' dang 'bral te tshogs gnyis lam mchog gis tshogs gnyis bden grub smos na sgro 'dogs pa red/ tshogs gnyis bsags mi dgos par 'dod na skur 'debs red/ de 'dra ba'i sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i tshogs gnyis/don dam sprod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste ye shes kyi tshogs gsog tshul dang / kun rdzob rgyu rkyen tshogs tsam gyi snang ba la brten te bsod nam gyi tshogs gsog tshul de dag ma nor ba shes nas sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i lam mchog gis srid zhi mtha' bral don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das gnyis ka'i mtha' dang bral ba dper na don dam byang chub sems dang kun rdzob byang chub sems gnyis kyi nang nas don dam byang chub sems kyisasrid pa'i rtsa ba gcod pa'am 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod de srid mtha' las grol ba srid mtha' gcod byed kyi gnyen po don dam byang chub kyi sems dang /zhi ba'i mtha' la zhes pa 'gog byed kyi gnyen po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin pa'i phyir na de 'dra ba'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis la brten te srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ 3ḍid

zhiganyis la mi gnas par mi gnas myang 'das sam srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob ste don gnyis 'bras thob shogadon dam byang chub kyi sems kyis srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod de rang don mthar phyin kunardzob byang chub sems kyis 'i ba'i mtha' la zhen pa bkag ste gzhan don mthar phyin te don gnyis kyi 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa thob par shog lta ba gol 'chug med pa rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi don rtogs/ lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug nyams su blangs te srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i 'bras bu thob par shog cig 'di lta bu nyams su blangs thub pa yin na gol ba med pa 'chug pa med pa nor 'khrul dang bral ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir na gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad de bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'di lta bu'i nyams len tshul bzhin nus par shog cigasbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug la/ /sbyong byed phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ches/ /sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams/ /sbyangs 'bras dri bral chos sku mngon gyur shog /tshigs bcad 'di sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyang bya sbyangs 'bras la smon pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub ste dam pa'i chos nyams len gnang dgos kyi yod na/ dam pa'i chos 'di dri ma sbyong byed red/ 'khrul snang dang sdug bsngal 'di tsho dri ma red/ 'khrul snang sdug bsngal de dag sbyong byed de dam pa'i chos kyi nyams len yin dus 'dri ma sbyang ba'i gzhi gcig dgos kyi 'dug sbyang gzhi 'di gang red/ sbyang bya ma gtogs sbyang gzhi med na dri ma sbyang tshar dus gang yang thob yas med pa chags yong ba red/ de'i phyir na sbyang gzhi gcig dgos kyi 'dug sbyang gzhi sems nyikā sdusal stong zung 'jug gang dri ma sbyang ba'i gzhi dper na til las til gyi

pags pa sbyang ba la sbyang gzhi mar khu red gser mdog dang dngul mdog bzhu dor byed pa la sbyang gzhi gser dang dngul gyi rdul phran yin pa de bzhin du dri ma sbyang gzhi sems nyid/ sems nyid zer dus sems 'di rnam shes la zer ba dang nyid sgras sems kyi gnas lugs la 'jug pa red/ des na sbyang gzhi sems nyid dam sems kyi gnas lugs yang na yin lugs sam gshigs lugs mthar thug pa gang yin pa 'di red/ de yang gsal stong zung du 'jug pa dgag sgrub kyi rigs pas ma dpyad cing rnam rtog gis ma bsgrib par bzhag na gsal cha yod pa dwangs cha yod pa rig cha yod pa/ gsal cha dwangs cha rig cha yod pa 'di ga re red zer na sgom pa'i nyams myong gi dbang du byed na gsal sang nge ba dwangs sang nge ba gcig de nyams len gyi skabs su shes kyi red 'o 'di las gzhan med pa red 'dug rang babs su ba'ag na gsal sang nge ba dwangs sang nge ba yod pa nag thom me ba ma yin pa 'di 'dra po la go dgos pa red 'dug sems nyid ma dpyad par rang babs su bzhag na gsal cha yod pa ste gsal ba/ stong zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la gcig tu bral la sogs pa'i dbu ma'i gtan tshigs rigs pas dpyad na ngo bo ma grub pa ma rnyed pa 'di zhes ba'ag tu med pa 'khrul pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid dang / dpyad na ma rnyed pa'i ngo bo stong pa bzhag na gsal cha yod pa 'di gnyis so sor red pas zer na ming dang tshig dang rnam rtog pa la ldog pa tha dad du shar na'ang ngo bo dbyer med pa yin pa'i phyir na gsal stong dbyer med pa'am gsal stong zung 'jug zer/ gnas lugs la stong pa 'di gsal ba/ gsal ba 'di yang stong pa yin pa'i phyir na dbyer med pa red/ da lta sbyir btang chos skad la gsal stong zung 'jug zer nas bshad pa red ma gtogs gsal ba 'di yang ngo bo stong pa red/ stong pa 'di stong bzhin du gsal ba red/ gsal stong dbyer med pa red/ de la daṭwāṃttas

te lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rta mgur las/ gsal stong mi 'gal ba zung du chog kyang slob bshad rjes 'dzin rnams dwogs chung ma mdzad ces gsal ba kho rang stong pa dang stong pa kho rang yang gsal ba yin pa'i phyir na ga re brjod na'ang gsal ba brjod na stong pa lhag 'gro ma red stong pa brjod na'ang gsal ba lhag 'gro ma red/ rtag tu gsal stong zer lab dgos kyi mi 'dug gsungs pa red/ da 'di 'dra po rigs pas dbyad pa byed pa'i skabs su mang po bshad yas yod pa red/ yin na'ang nyams len dang sbyar na gsal stong zung 'jug gsal stong dbyer med pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i lugs la dri ma sbyang ba'i gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug lab na 'grigs kyi 'dug dri ma sbyong byed de phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ches/ dri ma sbyong ba byed pa'i thabs sam nyams len 'di ga re red/ phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ram phyag rgya chen po'i lta sgom zab mo'i nyams len 'di glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma spyong byed red/ ches zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong dbyer med dam bde stong dbyer med la lta bas nges shes rnyed de sgom pas rang phab ma bcos par lhod kyis glod pa'i nyams zab mo rnal 'byor zab mo ting 'dzin zab mo 'di 'dra po la zer ba red/ de yang glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma sbyong byed kyi gnyen po red/ sbyang bya ga re red/ sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams/ sbyang bya de glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma red ma gtogs sbyang bya bden par grub pa med pa red/ glo bur 'khrul zer rgyu 'di gnas lugs kyi don ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis glo bur gyi 'khrul pa yod pa red/ glo bur gyi 'khrul pa 'di gang las byung ba red zer na/ thal rang gi lugs byed na rgyu rkyen rten 'brel snang tsam ma gtogs bshad yas med pa red/ glo bur gyi dri ma gang red/ glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams ma rtogs na sgrib byed yin pa snyi sna yin pa/ dri ma 'di rmi lam gyi skabs su lcags sgrog gis bcings pa

bzhin du snang tsam las ngo bo'am rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin dus gnyen po la brten te rang gi 'gal zla'i mi mthun phyogs la gnyen po'i nyams len byung na dri ma rang grol du 'gro ba 'di 'dra po la glo bur gyi dri ma zer ba red/dper na rmi lam du lcags sgrog gis bcings na rmi lam ngo ma shes pa'i skabs su bcing bya bdag yang bden grub 'ching byed lcags sgrog yang bden grub yin bsam ste bden grub kyi lcags sgrog gis bcings pa red/ rmi lam ngo shes na snang tsam yin dus snang tsam gyi lcags sgrog gis bcings pa red/ gnas lugs la bcing grol las 'das pa red/ bcing grol ma grub pa red/ rmi lam lta bu la bsam mno gtong na go las sla ba yod red/ de rtsa ba shes rab bcing 'grol brtag pa'i skabs su dang po nas bcing ba med pa'i phyir grol ba med pa red gsungs/ de nas phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi skabs su bcing grol las 'das pa'i bshad pa mang po yod na'ang rtsa shes kyi bcing grol brtag pa'i rab byed 'di las lhag pa'i rigs pa gzhan med pa red 'dug 'o na ma rig pa la brten nas nyon mongs/ nyon mongs la brten pa'i las dang las la brten te sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa 'di tsho dri ma ma red pas/ 'di tsho dri ma red de yin na'ang thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pa snang tsam gyi glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rmi lam 'dra po red/ mi lam lta bu'i dri ma rnams sbyangs 'bras dri bral chos sku mngon gyur shog da dri ma ngos bzung nas sbyang pa'i 'bras bu 'di ga re red/ sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma 'di nyid sbyong byed phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi dri ma sbyang pas 'bras bu 'di dri ma dang bral ba rmi lam ngo shes pa bzhin du glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri bral chos sku mngon du gyur pa shog cig da phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi bshad tshul la sbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug 'di don dag glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri bral la chos sku zer nas bzhag pa red ma gtogs rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos sku 'di sbyang gzhi semadī ṭwāṃd

gsal stong zung 'jug dang ngo bo khyad par med pa yin pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong zung 'jug 'di rang bzhin rnams dag gi chos sku yina'ang glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma yod red glo bur dri bral gyi chos sku ma red/phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi dri ma sbyang pas glo bur dri bral gyi chos sku mngon du bskur te dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku mngon du gyur pa red/ de'i phyir na ༵kyāsdu trī/cad 'di la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku mngon du gyur pa'i smon lam gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa lta ba'i gdengs/ /de la ma yengs skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad/ /sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog /lta sgom spyod pa'i gdengs dang ldan par shog /da nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la 'bras bu bzang po thob byed 'di lta sgomaspyod pa la rag las pa red/ de'i phyir na lta ba sgom pa spyod pa 'di gal chen po red/ de la 'khor lo bar pa rang stong lugs kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras dang 'khor lo mtha' ma rgyud bla ma dang stod tshogs kyi dargongs pa gzhan stong lugs kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras/ phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi lugs kyi lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi 'dzin tshul tha snyad mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa las da phyag rgya chen po'i lugs la lta sgom spyod 'bras ga re red/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa lta ba'i gdengs/ 'di'i skabs kyi gzhi 'byung khams skye mched la bzhag rgyu ma yin pa gzhi sems kyi gnas lugs la bden grub tu sgro 'dogs pa dang sems kyi gnas lugs ci yang med par stong rkyang du 'dod na skur ba 'debs pa red gzhi sems kyi gnas lugs la the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa 'di lta ba red/lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa gcig dgos kyi 'dug lta ba 'di nga tsho'i phung po khadīsdu dang skyes mched kun rdzob rmi lam bzhin du rten 'brel snang tsam yin pa

dang don dam par ma grub pa dang ma grub pa de yang ma grub pa'i spros pa dang bral ba'i dpyad pa de tsho rtogs las sla po yod pa red/ des las da ltar gyi sems 'das pa 'gags zin ma 'ongs pa'i sems ma skye da ltar gyi sems la sgro 'dogs chod pa 'di zab mo dang phra mo yod pa red/ ga re red zer na/sems kyis phyi'i yul la phar blta dus phyi'i yul la lta tshul 'di rags pa dang sems rang la tshur blta ba'i skabs su phra ba yong gi red/ de'i phyir na gzhi sems kyi gnas lugs la sgro 'dogs dang the tshom chod de nges shes brtan po rnyed pa'i lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa gcig dgos kyi 'dug da lta'i sems kyi gnas lugs 'di phyag chen gyi lugs la skyes 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba yod med 'gro 'ong las 'das pa rtag chad las 'das pa la sogs pa thal 'gyur gyi lta ba dang gcig pa red/ rag pa la dpyad yong dus dbyibs kha dog las 'das pa de'i phyir na gzhi la sgro 'dogs dang the tshom chod de nges shes brtan po'am nges shes khyad par can la lta ba zer/ de la ma yengs skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad/ sgom pa 'di ga re red/ lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa lta ba'i nges shes rnyed pa de la gzhan sgom yod red pas/ de las gzhan du yod pa ma red gang the tshom las 'das pa'i lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa'am nges shes rnyed pa de la'am 'di'i ngang du ma yengs par skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad/ ma yengs skyong zer dus ma yengs par skyong dgos kyi red ma gtogs phyag chen gyi sgom ngo ma la ma yengs skyong tshul 'di dmigs pa dang 'dzin pa skyed rim lta bu sgro btags dang bsdur bcos mi dgos par bstan pa dang / yang na gzhi semasakyi gnas lugs la thos bsam gyi blta ba'i nges shes brtan po rnyed pa 'di'i ngang du rang babs su lhod kyis glod de ma yengs pa gcig dgos kyi 'dug lta ba la dmigs pa 'dzin pa yod na lta ba dug dang / sgom pa la 'bad brtson yod na sgom pa'i skyon du gsungs pa red/ de yang mi pharwa ḍin

po che'i gsung thor bu'i nang la gang la dmigs par byed pa lta ba'i dug gang zhig rtsol bas zin pa sgom pa'i skyon gsungs pa ltar dmigs pa'i gtad so yod na lta ba'i skyon red/ lta ba mthar la phyin pa red/ sgom pa'i tshe rtsol ba yod pa rtsol ba dgos pa 'bad brtson byed de sgom yas yod na sgom pa'i skyon dang sgom pa mthar phyin pa ma yin de'i phyir na lta ba dmigs gtad las 'das pa sgom pa rtsol ba las 'das pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug ma yengs skyong tshul 'di gong du brjod pa bzhin lta ba'i nges shes rnyed pa 'di'i ngang du rang babs su lhod kyis glod dgos kyi red/ de yang rnal 'byor mi la ras pas gcer gyis bltas pas ngo bo stong / spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / gsungs pa 'dis lta ba bstan pa dang / cogs kyis ba'ag pas gnas lugs rtogs/chos kun stong pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ lhod kyis glod pas rang sar phyed/ rig pa'i chu bo dwangs snyigs phyed/ ces gsungs pa red/ mdor na lta bas nges shes rnyed pa 'di'i ngang du lhod kyis glod zer rgyu 'di dmigs pa dang 'dzin pa med pa'i tshig red/ de phyag chen gyi khri yig 'di tsho'i nang la ma yengs mi sgom bzod med gsum 'di tshig ha cang zab mo red/ ma yengs zer rgyu 'di lta ba'i nges shes rnyed pa de las ma yengs/ 'o na ma yengs na sgom dgos sam zhe na sgom dgos kyi mi 'dug nged kyis bsgom gyi yin bsam ste bsgom na bsgom bya sgom byed kyi 'dzin pa yod na gnas lugs kyi ngang la gnas thub kyi ma red byas tsang mi sgom/ mi bsgom na bzo bcos bzo dgos kyi 'dug gas bzo bcos bzo dgos kyi mi 'dug ma yengs mi sgom bzod med gsum 'di gal chen po red/ ma yengs mi sgom bzod med zer rgyu 'di dang po lta ba'i skabs su dbu ma'i rigs chen lnga dang rig pa brgya phrag la sogs pa'i sgo nas dpyad pa byed de nas phyag rgya chen po'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i gnas lugs la dpyad padī sprad de rang babs su 'dzin dgos kyi yod red/ rang thog tu bzhag

pa'ang zer gyi 'dug rdzogs chen gyi tha snyad la rig thog tu bzhag pa rig pa rang la bzo bcos ma byed pa rig pa rang gi ngang du bzhag pa zer/ rig 'tsho ma zhig par bzhag zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong ngam rig stong yin pa'i phyir na rig 'tsho ma zhig pa rig pa rang tshugs ma zhig pa zhag bya 'jog byed yod pa ma red de yin na'ang rang bab tu gnas pa la bzhag zer ba red 'dug de la ma yengs skyong lugs kyang rje btsun mi la ras pas brag srin mo la gsungs pa'i mgur de'i nang la/ khyod lta ba blo 'das kyi don la ltos/ sgom pa yengs med kyi ngang du zhog ces gsungs pa red/ de bzhin duspyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ / blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ / gsungs pa gnyis ka don la gcig pa red/ lta ba blo 'das lta ba spros bral lta ba khas len las 'das pa gcig pa red/ sgom pa yengs med kyi ngang la zhog zer ba 'di lta ba 'di'i ngang du ma yengs par bzhag zer ba red/ des na mthar thug spyod 'bras kyang mi la ras pa'i mgur las lta ba stong pa'i ye shes yin/ sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin/ zhes gsungs pa red/ lta ba don dam mthar thug 'di stong pa'i ye shes sam rig stong dbyer med la zer/ rig stong dbyer med zer dus rdzogs chen dang tshig mthun po yod red/ 'o na bsgom na ga re red/ sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin/'od gsal 'di 'dzin pas ma bslad par 'dzin med zhes pa dgag sgrub rnam rtog gis ma bslad pa'am rnam rtog gis mi g.yo ba rang 'tsho ma zhig par 'dzin pa la zer gyi red/ 'o na rnam rtog bkag dgos kyi 'dug pas zer na phyag chenardzogs chen gyi lugs la rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul lam ngo bo chos sku las ma 'das pas na bkag dgos kyi min 'dug sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog spyod pa ga 'dra zhig byed na'ang lta sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba sgom gyi rtsal sbyong du 'gyur thub na spyod pa'i mchog zer gyi red/ dasdiṭwāṃ na

deng sang phyi rgyal ba kha shas ha cang gis lus rtsed mkhas pa 'di tshos lus rtsed gcigakhyed yong dus sems gzhan du ma yengs pa byed de lus shin sbyang thob bsdad pa 'dra po 'dug ga de bzhin du spyod pa'i ngang nas lta ba dran bzhin sgom pa la'ang rtsal sbyong du 'gyur pa/ lta sgom zab mo'i ngang nas lus ngag gi spyod pa'i bya ba byed thub pa dgos kyi yod red/ mdor na da lta ba'i mchog ga re red/ gzhi sems kyi gnas lugs la the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod de nges shes khyad par can rnyed pa/ sgom pa'i mchog ga re red/ ma yengs rang babs su lhod kyis glod shes pa/ spyod pa'i mchog ga re red/ lus ngag gi bya ba sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba red/ de'i phyir na bdag gzhan sems can thams cad skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum spra //rdokā kādā /rsha ༵bye ktoṭwāṃ ci/ ga ces gong du bdag dang mtha' yas kyi tshig chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te/ /sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bos stong / /stong 'ing ma 'gags chir yang snang ba ste/ /legs par brtag nas gzhi rtsa chod par thog /chos rnams zer rgyu 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams phyi dang nang gi chos rnams yang na rnam rtog gi dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi chos ma lus pa rnams sems kyi rnam 'phrul te/ sems kyi rnam 'phrul 'di sems tsam gyi grub mtha'i lugs dang sbyar na/ phyi'i yul gyi gzugs sgra dri ro'i snang ba 'di dag bag chags la brten nas byung ba'i phyir na serma sa kyi rnam 'phrul du bshad pa red/ phyag rgya chen po thun mongs yin pa ltar du byed na bag chags la sbyar dgos kyi yod ma red/ chos rnams thams cad sems kyi gnāsdu lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtsal dang rol pa red/ rtsal dang

rol pa zer rgyu 'di rang 'od dang rang mdangs red/ rang 'od rang mdangs rangatsal zer rgyu 'di sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba la zer/ rtsal sna tshogs shar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na da 'di mgon po klu sgrub kyi rtsa ba shes rab rten 'byung gi rigs pa la gtug na ma gtogs phra ba 'di bzhag mi thub red 'dug de yang rten cing 'brel byung ma yin pa'i chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /de'i phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ / zer na ha cang mang po gsungs 'dug ga 'khor 'das gnyis yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red rten 'byung red/ bdag gzhan gnyis yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gang red/rten 'byung red/ bde sdug gnyis yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rten 'byung red/dgra yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red gnyen yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/gnod pa byed pa yod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red phan btags pa gcig yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red tshang ma phan tshun ltos grub dang brten nas byung ba red/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas rten 'brel gsungs pa'i nang la/ rten 'brel shin tu phra ba la/ phra mo'i 'dor len shes par bya/ zhes gsungs/ spyir btang chos thams cad rten 'brel yin pas mnyam nyid yin pa dang / 'dor len gyi skabs su phra mo'i 'dor len shes pa dang phyag rdzogs kyi nyams len gyi skabs su'ang phra mo'i 'dor len bzod yas yod pa red 'dug gegs su 'gyur ba de tshe las grol yas grogs su 'gyur ba blangs yas 'dra po rten 'brel mkha' la mdung skor gyi skabs su gsungs yod pa red/ 'o na chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin na/ sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bo ste/ da sems sam rnam shes 'di ga re red/ sems ni sems med sems sems su ma grub pa sems ngo bos ma grub pa rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa red/sems kyi ngo bo stong pa 'di rtogs las sla shos sems gcig dang du mdī ḍing

bzhin las 'das pa'i phyir na sems kyi ngo bo ma grub pa stong pa 'di red/ de yang spros bral du bzhag na sems sems kyi ngo bo ma grub pa yin pa'i phyir na ngo bo med pa'ang ma grub pa red/ bden par med pa'i phyir na stong pa'ang ma grub pa red/ bden pa dang stong pa gnyis ka yang ltos grub red/ sems bden par med pa'i phyir na stong pa'ang med ngo bo med pa'i phyir na ngo bo med pa'ang med zer nas dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi nang du ha cang phra po gsungs 'dug mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang gal te stong min cung zad yod/ / stong pa'ang cung zad yod par 'gyur/ / stong min cung zad med pas na/ / stong pa'ang yod pa ma yin no/ / 'o 'di 'dra po gsungs pa red/ stong pa mi stong pa gnyis ltos thub yin pa'i phyir na stong pa min pa gcig yod na stong pa'ang grub kyi red/ stong pa min pa 'khor 'das kyi chos gcig kyang med pa'i phyir na stong pa'ang ma spub/ a ni ga re dgos kyi 'dug stong mi stong las 'das pa/ stong dang min stong la sogs zhi/ zhi ba 'di la ga la yod/ bdag dang bdag med la sogs zhi/ /zhi ba 'di la ga la yod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar du mthar thug 'di spros bral las 'da' dgos kyi 'dug 'di 'dra po'i sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bos stong / zhes pa ltar sems ngo bo stong pa rang gis stong pa yin na'ang stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste/ sems kyi ngo bo spros pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo yin na'ang rmi lam ltar stong bzhin du ma 'gags pa'i snang ba cir yang shar ba/ mi lam gyi snang ba sna tshogs ma skyes pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir na ma 'gags pa'i snang ba red skye bar snang bzhin du ma skyes pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su shar bsdad yod pa'i phyir na 'gags bzhin du ma 'gags pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba 'di/ gal te skyes las skyes pa 'di la skyes/ / des las skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ / rkyen la radī ༵sa gang de stong pa nyid/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ /
