zhes rmā tri pas zhus pa'i mdo'i lung red/ de nang bzhin shes rab snying po las/ gzugs stong pa'o stong pa nyid gzugs so gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'ang mdo dang sbyar dgos kyi yod red/ cir yang snang ba zer rgyu 'di sna tshogs su snang ba snang ba'i tshad 'di red 'di'i phar mtha' la snang yas yod ma red/ snang ba'i tshad 'di red zer nas tshad bzung yas med pa red 'dugade yang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis shes bya ga tshod yod med tshad bzung shes kyi ma red gsungs pa 'di bden pa yin gyi 'dug da ngo bo stong pa dang stong bzhin du ma 'gags pa cir yang snang ba yin pa'i phyir na snang ba thams cad snang stong dbyer med red/ de lta bu legs par brtag nas gzhi rtsa chad pa shogalegs par brtag pa ni legs par dpyad pa la zer/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su gang zag las dang po pa'i skabs su 'tshol brtag dpyad gsum gyis sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs/ de nas rim pas dpyad pa nyung du nyung du gtong ste nges shes rnyed zin pa'i rjes su yang skyar mi dpyad pa dbyad pa bkag pa'i khyaspya parsha 'byed dgos kyirkye yopy-i pa repy-i/ phyag ṭwāṃn gyi gzhung trī shas nang sdo~Xsdo ༵ sdogo sdu ༵ spra ṭwāṃsdo ༵ byebye ༵sna rtaṅged tu/ darnyiwa sdoṅgikā spyi kā da /dīrdzushā gsungs kyi yod red/ nges don rgya mtsho las 'tshol brtag dpyad gsum gyi gtan 'bebs dgos gsungs pa red/ las dang po pa'i skabs dang nges shes brtan po rnyed zin pa'i khyad par yod red/ dper na khang pa'i nang sgrul yod snyam pa'i dwogs pa skyes na brtag dpyad yag po btang med par thag chod nasayang skyar btsal bsdad na dgos pa med pa 'di 'dra po bshad kyi 'dugad 'di yan chad la sems kyi gnas lugs gzhi rtsa chod pa'i smon lam zer/yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul/ / 47

ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul/ /gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyam/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad bdar chod pa shog /yod ma myong ba'i phyi rol yul gyi snang ba gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i snang ba 'di tsho rmi lam bzhin du dngos gnas yul gyi ngos nas rang dbang ba zhig yod ma myong ba spub ma myong pa red/ de 'dra po yin na sems can rnams ga 'dra byas nas 'khrul zhe na/ rang snang yul du 'khrul/ rang gi snang ba la yul du 'khrul pa sems tsam ltar du byed na bag chags kyi snang ba la yul du bden par zhen te 'khrul pa thun mongs ma yin pa phyag chen ltar du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po'am 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtsal dang rol pa'am rang rtsal dang rang 'od la yul du 'khrul pa rang rtsal dang rang 'od la yul du zhen pa/ dper na sems rang la dpyad de mnyam par bzhag yong dus rtsal dang rol pa 'ja' tshon thig le thig phran la sogs pa shar yas yod red/ 'di shar yong ba'i skabs su gnyis 'dzin skyes nas yul du 'khrul yong ba red 'dug 'khrul tshul 'di phal cher ming dang tha snyad 'brel yong na yul du 'khrul 'gro yas yod pa red/ dus 'khor gyi stong gzugs dang rdzogs chen gyi stong gzugs thod rgal lta bu'i skabs su 'dzin pa ma zhugs par rang babs su bzhag pa red/ ma rig dbang gis sems kyi gnas lugs ma rig pa'am ngo ma shes pa'i dbang gis ma rig zer rgyu 'di rang ngo rang gis ma rig pa'am rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa/sems rang gi ngo bo gsal stong dbyer med dam rig stong dbyer med yin pa la 'di ma rig pa'am ngo ma shes pa rang ngo rang gis ma rig pa zer yas 'di ma rig pa phra ba red/ rang ngo rang gis rig na rig pa'i ye shes zer rang byung gi ye ṭwāṃ~X kyang zer/ de phyag chen gyi skabs su rtogs ma rtogs ces pa 'khor

'das lag pa'i rgyab mdun lta bu bshad bsdad pa red 'di ngo shes ma shes kyi khyad par red 'dug ma rig dbang gis rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul pa rang rig la bden par zhen pa de 'dra po'i dbang gis rang snang la yul du 'khrul rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul pa/ 'khrul tshul phra ba zab mo nang don las sems can 'khrul tshul gsungs yong dus gsal stong du 'khrul gsungs sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong dbyer med red gsal cha ngo ma shes nas gzhan du 'khrul stong cha ngo shes pas nga dang bdag tu 'khrul pa yin gsungs pa red 'di phra po red/ de 'dra po'i gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams/gnyis su med bzhin du gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dbang gis gnyis 'dzin stobs kyisasrid pa'i rba klong du 'khyams/ 'khyams zer rgyu 'di mtshan mo mun nag nang nas thang stong du 'khyam pa yang na rgya mtsho'i rba klong nang du gru dzings 'gro ba lta bu 'khor bar 'khyams pa/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad bdar chod par shogade 'dra bo 'khrul grol gyi rtsa ba chod par shog ma rig pas ji ltar 'khrul pa'i tshul shes par shog rang rig la bdag dang rang snang la yul du 'khrul pa'i tshul shes par shog phyi rol yul gyi snang ba 'di tsho la phar blta yong dus mthong yas yod pa red/ de'i dbang gis gsal cha ngo ma shes pa las 'khrul tshul zhig yod pa red/ bdag ga par 'dug btsal yong dus rnyed rgyu med pa 'jog mi shes pa ga par 'dug ha mi go ba stong sang byed kyi red 'di stong cha la 'khrul pa red/ rmi lam du 'khrul yong dus gsal cha la yul du 'khrul stong cha la bdag tu 'khrul te bdag rtog dang gzhan rtog zhugs nas 'khrul pa red/da 'di ma rig 'a~Xl pa'i sdutsad bdar chod pa'i sdin lam yin/rtesdo ༵ sdu ༵rsha shākṣiṃ sdo ṭā rdozlo ༵/ bye snasna// //'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam/ / 49

mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog /'di yod pa ma yin med pa ma yin pa 'di chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sam gshigs lugs 'di yod med gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa yang na sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po 'di yod med kyi mtha' las 'das pa lasbyar ba red/ sems kyi gams lugs 'di yod pa ma yin te yod na rang bzhin gyis yod dgos pa dbu ma'i lugs dang mtshungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra po gshigs lugs la yod pa ma yin ga re red zer na rgyal ba'am sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs/ de yang mdo'i lung las sems ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur/ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur/ da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur zhes gsungs pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs ces pa'i tshigs 'di'i gdags gzhi yod pa rang bzhin kyis grub pa'am ngo bos yod pa ma gzigs/ med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ 'o na sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ci yang med pa stong kyang med dgag red pas/ ci yang med pa dgag bya rnam par bcad tsam gyi med dgag de yang ma red 'di'i rgyu mtshan gang red/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi 'khrul pa'i skabs su 'khor ba'i snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba'i gzhi yang sems kyi gnas lugs red/ 'khrul pa zad de rtogs pa'i skabs su sku dang ye shes kyi dag snang 'char gzhi yang yin pa'i phyir na stong kyang yang yin na 'grigs kyi min 'dug 'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam/ de lta bu yod pa ma yin med pa ma yin na yod med gnyis ka'i 'gal 'du can red pas zer na 'gal 'du ma yin ga re red zer na zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam red/ dbu ma zer rgyu 'di mtha' thams cad dang brakā sdu'i cha nas dbus zer gyi red dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o zer dus

dbus las kyang 'das pa'i mtha' bral bshad kyi 'dug ga de mdo'i lung mang po yod pa red/ tha snyad du dbu ma zer lab na'ang dbus la bden par zhen na yang 'khrul pa chags pa red/ de lta bu'i spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i sems kyi gnas lugs sam sems kyi chos nyid sems kyi gshigs lugs ji lta ba bzhin ma nor bar rtogs par shog cig 'o na sems kyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i smon lam btab kyi 'dug rtogs pa po'i bdag yod red pas/ rtogs pa po'i bdag yang ma grub red gnas lugs la rtogs ma rtogs las 'das pa yin/ rtogs pa las 'das nas ma rtogs pa khas blangs na'ang 'grigs kyi yod ma red/ rtogs ma rtogs las 'das pa da lta shes rab snying po las/ ma rig pa med ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do zhes pa dang yang mtshan nyid med pa ma skyes pa la 'gags pa dri ma med pa dri ma dang bral ba med pa bri ba med pa gang ba med pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltar 'phel 'grib med pa yin pa'i phyir na mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog don dam par rtogs su med na'ang tha snyad tsam hā ṭwāṃsdurno /yas yod pa red/ da 'di mtha' bral gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i smon 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med/ /'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med/ /blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas/ /yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog /da 'di sems kyi gnas lugs sam chos nyid la sbyar ba red ma gartogs chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs thams cad gcig pa red/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ zhes chos gcig gi stong nyid 'di chos thams cad kyi stong nyid dang gcig pa red/ chos gcig stodī pyar

bsgrub pa'i rigs pa 'di chos thams cad kyi stong pa bsgrub pa'i rigs pa 'di sbyar chog gi red gsungs 'dug ga 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med/sems kyi gnas lugs 'di yin zhes khas len thub kyi ma red/ gang yin zer na 'di yin zhes khas blangs pa 'di gang gi mtshon byed rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dpe med pa'i phyir/ 'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med/ 'di ma yin zer nas dgag pa'i gtan tshigs kyis bkag ste ci yang med pa'i stong pa gcig yang khas len yas yod ma red/ las dang po pa'i skabs su dgag pa'i gtan tshigs gcig du bral gyi dbu ma'i rigs pa mang pos gtan la 'bebs pa red ma gtogs gnas lugs phra ba phra ba chags yong dus dgag sgrub las 'das 'gro ba red 'dug rtags las 'das pa rtags 'dzin gyi sems las 'das pa/ rtags 'dzin gyi sems rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i phyir na rtags can rjes dpag yang rang bzhin gyi ma grub pa/ rtogs bya rtogs byed las 'das pa/ gang las dpyad na su la dpyad na'ang gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin las 'das pa'i phyir na ma grub pa 'di go sla po yod pa red bsam pa yod/ gang gis bkag pa med/ de 'dra po yin na'ang yod pa gcig bkag ste mthar thug la med pa gcig bsgrub yas med pa red de yang stong nyid bcu drug gi nang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong nyid la zhen pa bkag pa'i phyir du stong pa'ang stong pa nyid du ma grub pa'i phyir na stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gsungs pa red 'dug stong pa 'di stong pa nyid du spub na stong nyid bden grub chags kyi yod red/ stong pa la rang bzhin bkag pa'i phyir du rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid tha snyad du stong pa zer brjod kyi yod red ma gtogs stong pa rang yang stong pa'i rang bzhin las 'das pa red/ stong pa'ang ma grub pa red/mgon po klu sgrub kyis stong ngo zhes kyang mi bya zhing / mi stong zhes kyang mi bya ste/gardi~X dang gnyis min mi bya ste/ gdags pa'i don du brjod par bya/ zhes

gsungs pa bzhin gnas lugs mthar thug la 'di stong ngo zer na mkhas len thub kyi ma red/ min stong pa'ang khas blangs thub kyi ma red yin na'ang tha snyad gdags pa'i ched du dgag sgrub kyi rnam ga'ag gang yang lab dgos kyi 'dug da 'di 'dra po mtshams mtshams su stong zhes lab/ mtshams mtshams su mi stong zhes lab/ skabs skabs su don dam du stong kun rdzob tu mi stong zhes lab dgos kyi 'dug blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas/da gnas lugs mthar thug ga re red/ blo 'das red/ de ltar yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyugs rje mi la ras pas/ khyed lta ba blo 'das kyi don la ltos/zhes dang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ blo ni kun rdzob yin par brjod/ zhes gsungs pa ba'in du don dam mthar rgyug 'di blo 'das red/ blo de yang kun rdzob tu blo rnam rtog gi spyod yul zer nas sbyar gyi 'dug yin na'ang sus rtogs zer na/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis rtogs zer nas dgag sgrub kyi skabs su 'di 'dra po 'dra mi 'dra lab dgos kyi yod pa red/ blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas/ blo las 'das pa rnam rtogs la 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas zer rgyu 'di don dam 'dus ma byas 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas las 'das pa'i don dam 'dus ma byas/gzhan stong gi lugs rgyud bla ma'i skabs su/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ces pa'i 'dus ma byas dang sems kyi gnas lugs kyang 'dus ma byas bzhag pade tshos 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas las 'das pa'i don dam 'dus ma byas la go dgos pa red 'dug 'di bzhag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di tha snyad gcig dgos kyi 'dug tha snyad med na dgag sgrub rgyun chad 'gro yi yod pa red de'i phyir na 'dra mi 'dra btags kyi yod pa red/ yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog de 'dra po'i stong pa nyid dam chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid yang dag pa'i mtha' la sogs pa'i stong nyid kyi mtshan rdi /ma

grangs mang po gsungs yod red/ 'di 'dra po'i yang dag pa'i don gyi mtha' chos nyid 'di la nges shes skye bar shog cig zhes smon pa'o/'asdi trīd swā rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ṭwāṃkhor/ /trī~X ṭwāṃ hā sdokyāj-i spya sna ziṭwāṃ ṭwāṃsna snaṭā nānd+ra ༵sdo// //chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog /'di zhes pa'i nye ba'i tshig sbyar yas 'di sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid ma rtogs na/ ma rtogs pa 'di ma rig pa red sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ma rtogs pa'am ma rig pa'i dbang gis chags sdang rmongs gsum la sogs pa'i nyon mongs skyes/ nyon mongs la brten nas las sna tshogs bsags/ las sna tshogs la brten te 'khor bar skyes te sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i phyir na/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di nyid ma rtogs na srid pa khamasagasum 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor bsdad kyi yod pa red/ 'di nyid rtogs na sems kyi gnas lugs sam chos nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba gzhan na yod ma red/ kun rdzob kyi sangs rgyas na yod red phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang phyogs re re la'ang sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad pa dang / sangs rgyas sman bla bshad yong dus sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bdun bshad kyi red/ zhing khams re re'i rgya tshad bkod pa bshad/ sangs rgyas re re'i smon lam bzhi dang brgyad dang sangs rgyasasnan bla rang gi smon lam bcu drug la sogs pa bshad pa red 'di tshos rnam rtog dang mthun pa'i snang tshul gyi sangs rgyas gzhan du yod na'ang sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid rtogs na don dam gyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ba gzhan na med/ kun rdzob kyi sangs rgyas gzhan na yod de swā~Xs can rnams smon lam gyi dbang gis 'gro sa dang skye ba blangs pa dang

gzhan don byed pa de 'dra po mang po dgos pa'i phyir na gzhan du yod/thams cad 'di yin 'di min gang yang med/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs 'di yin 'di min gang yang med/ sbyir las dang po pa'i gnas skabs su don dam la 'jug pa spro ba'i phyir du dgag sgrub kyi gtan tshig shod na'ang gnas lugs ngo ma'am chos nyid la bsams na dgag skub las 'das pa red 'diyin 'di min las 'das pa red/ de ltar yang mi la ras pa'i dbu ma yang dag par brjod pa las/ khams gsum rten dang g.yo ba bcas/ gdod nas ma grub skyes ba'ang med/ gzhi med lhan cig skyes pa med/ las dang las kyi rnam smin med/ de'i phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ zhes gsungs pa red/ 'khor ba 'khor ba zhes pa'i gdags gzhi ma grub pa ma zad ming de yang ma grub pa red/ ming ma spub pa 'di rtogs yas las sla po red/ dper na 'khor ba zhes tshig gnyis brjod dus 'khor dngos po sgra yin pa'i skabs su ba dngos med red/ ba dngos po chags pa'i skabs su 'khor dngos med chags 'gro red/ 'khor ba zer nas ming tshig tsam yang mnyam por med pa red 'dug chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog kun gzhi la chos nyid kyi kun gzhi dang rnam shes kun gzhi gnyis yod pa red/ gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba 'char ba'i gzhi 'di rnam thes kun gzhi zer ba red/ 'di'i skabs su chos nyid kun gzhi 'di sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po dang gcig pa la go dgos pa red/ mtshang rig pa 'di chos nyid kun py-iṭwāṃ dī kā kās/ lugs rig pa la go dgos chos nyid kun gzhi'i don rtogs pa'i snang yang sems la stong yang sems yin te/ /rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems/ /skyes kyang sems la 'gags kyang sems yin pas/ / 55

sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par thog /snang ba ste gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su ji ltar snang yang sems kyis gnas lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtsal dang rol pa yin pa'i phyir na sems yin la/ stong yang sems yin te stong pa'ang sems kyi gsal cha'am yang na sems kyi btags pa'i phyir na stong yang sems yin te stong pa'o bsam pa de yang sems kyis btags pa'i phyir mdor na snang stong gnyis ka sems kyi rtsal dang rol pa yin pa'i phyir gsal cha las snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba'i phyir na snang yang sems yin/ stong cha las stong nyams sna tshogs skyes pa'i phyir na stong yang sems yin la/ dper na rmi lam nang la blta yong dus snang stong gnyis snang gi yod 'dug sa rdo khang pa brag ri la sogs pa 'di tsho snang cha red/ nam mkha' stong pa dang khang pa stong pa la sogs pa stong cha red/ snang stong gnyis mnyam du shar yong ba red 'dug de ma yin pa'i snang ba kho na yin pa dang stong pa kho na yin pa zhig rmi lam du 'char yas med pa red 'dug 'khrul snang 'di tsho sems tsam pa ltar du byed na bag chags kyi 'khrul snang phyag rgya chen po ltar du byed na gsal stong gi rtsal red/rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems/ 'khrul pa las grol ba'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur na'ang sems la sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa red sems kyi gnas lugs las gzhan rtogs pa ma red/ yang na ma rig pa'i dbang gis 'khrul yang rang gi sems 'khrul bsdad pa red ma gtogs 'khrul rgyu dang 'khrul gzhi yul bden par grub pa med pa rmi lam 'dra po red/'khrul grol thams cad sems las ga'an du ma grub/ de yang rtsa ba shes rab las/ 'khrul grol 'gro 'ong las 'das pa red gsungs/ 'khrul pa 'di gzhan nas ma 'ong pa'i phyir na gzhan du mi 'gro grol ba yang gzhan nas ma 'odī ༵'i phyir na ga'an du mi 'gro/ nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal yang 'gro 'ong

las 'das pa/ nga rang bsams na 'gro 'ong las 'das pa la shes rab kyis dpyad pa mang du byed na phan gyi yod kyi red/ nga tsho sems 'khrugs te sdug bsngalagacig byung nas sdug bsngal 'di gang du yang 'gro yi ma red gang nas yang ma yong ba red/ 'gro 'ong las 'das pa'i phyir na stong pa red/ yin na'ang 'gro 'ong las 'das pa'i don ma rtogs te bden pa red bsam na 'khrul gyi 'dug skyes kyang sems la 'gasas kyang sems yin pas/ rmi lam bzhin du skyes kyang sem sa kyi rtsal dang rol pa red/ 'gags kyang sems kyi rtsal dang rol pa 'gags pa red/ 'di/ skyes ba med las thams cad skyes/skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med/ 'gags pa med la thams cad 'gags/'gags tsam nyid nas 'gags pa med/ zer rgyu 'di rnying ma'i rgyud gsang snying nang la tshigs 'di 'dug gsar ma'i lugs kyi rgyud kha shas nang la'ang lung 'di dang gcig pa 'dug lung kha shas gcig pa yong gi 'dug sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang ka ba bum pa la sgro 'dogs chod pa tsam gyis 'khrul pa zhig thub kyi mi 'dug rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ 'khrul gzhi 'di ka ba dang bum pa ma red/ 'khrul gzhi sems yin pa'i phyir na sems la the tshom dang sgro 'dogs spros pa 'di tsho chod dgos kyi 'dug sems la sgro 'dogs chod na lta ba mthar thug yin gsungs pa red/ de yang mi la ras pas/ lar sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa la/ mtha' phral gyi lta ba mi zer ram/ lus rigs dang 'brel ba zhig rgyan du che/ zhes sgro 'dogs dang the tshom thams cad sems la chod nas nges shes skye ba 'di la mtha' bral gyi lta ba zer gyi red/ mtha' bral gyi lta ba 'di yang lung shes rigs pa shes na rgyan du che ba'i lta ba mkhas pa'i tshogs su bshad yas kyi lta ba chags kyi red/ lung dang rig pa med na rang la mtha' bral gyi lta ba red de rgyan du che ba'i lta ba chags kyi ma red/ mkhas pa'i nātta la

zhe drag bshad yas med pa red 'dug ha ha ha/ da 'di yan chad sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod pa'i smon lam yin no/ /blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing / /thama~X'adu 'dzi'irlungagisam balhad sprar/ nga/ṭwāṃ ༵byesdo /snaṭā ༵ ṭwāṃsdo ༵zlosdu ṅgings py-ing dṛsdo ṅgig/ //blosabyas/ blo yis byas pa rnam rtog gis byas pa 'bad brtson gyi sgom gyis ma bslad cing / spyir btang rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la bskyed rim de tsho btags pa'i rnal 'byor bcos ma'i rnal 'byor rtog btags kyi rnal 'byor red/ lha dang dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad btags te bsgom dgos pa red/ da bskyed rim gyi skabs su 'di 'dra po dgos kyi red ma gtogs phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su blos byas pa'i rnam rtog gis byas pa'i 'bad brtson gyi sgom gyis ma bslad cing 'di bzhin du stong pa'o/gsal ba 'o bsam pa'i 'bad brtson gyis ma bslad pa dgos kyi yod red/ tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod par/ 'o na blos byas kyi 'bad brtson gyis ma bslad pa ma bcos pa bsgom na 'di ga la tha mal gyi 'du 'dzis 'grig gi red pas/ tha mal gang zag tha mal 'du 'dzi zer rgyu 'di nyon mongs pa'i 'du 'dzi dang rnam rtog la sogs pa'i 'du 'dzi 'di rlung gi gzugs su bkod derlung gis ma g.yo ba'am ma bcos pa ma bcos gnyug ma rang babs 'jog shes pa'i/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di bzo bcos las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir na gnyug ma red/ gsang ba 'dus pa las gnyug sems zer rgyu 'di bshad pa rgya chen po yod pa red 'dug gnyug ma gang red gnyug ma ma bcos pa red/ gnyug ma'i sems ga re red/ ma bcos pa'i sems red/ ma brdosdu pa'i sems 'di sems kyi gnas lugs la bzhag gi 'dug ga phyag rgya

chen po'i lugs la gnyug sems 'di la tha mal shes pa zer tha mal shes pa zer rgyu 'di bzod bcos las 'das pa'i shes pa la zer gyi red/ da 'di'i skabs su shes pa'i gnas lugs la shes pa'i tha snyad bstan pa red/ da bsgom dus gnyug ma'i sems sam tha mal gyi shes pa bsgom dgos kyi 'dug sgom tshul ga re red/ rang 'bab 'jog shes pa'i/ rang gi ngang du 'jog shes dgos kyi 'dug gnyug ma 'di gsal ba yin bsam na 'grig gi 'dug pas de yang 'grig gi mi 'dug phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len ma red/ gnyug ma 'di stong pa yin bsam na'ang 'grig gi mi 'dug 'o na ga 'dra red/ rang babs su 'jog pa rang 'thog tu 'jog pa rang gi ngang du 'jog pa rdzogs chen ltar du byed na rig pa rang 'tsho ma zhig pa 'jog pa rang babs su 'jog shes pa la mkhas pa'i rig pa rang babs 'jog dgos kyi 'dug bka' rgyud lugs la tha mal shes pa ngo sprod zer rgyu 'di gsang 'dus ltar du byed nas gnyug ma'i sems kyi ngo sprod la zer gyi 'dug sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog sems don nam sems kyi gnas lugs kyi nyams len 'di ha cang mkhas pa'i sgo nas skyong bar shog cig sems don skyong tshul ma shes na nor gyi yod pa red/ sems don nyams len ha cang mkhas pa'i skyong tshul dka' ba la brten nas dmigs pa sna tshogs dang bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa du ma la brten te sgom bskyed rim gyi bar ta la tad tsa tad tsa mnyam par bzhag rdzogs rim mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pa thig le dang nā da rtsa dang rlung la sogs pa'i dmigs pa sna tshogs pa brten te bsgom yang bar ta la tha mal shes pa rang babs su 'jog 'di 'dra ze bsdad dgos pa red 'dug go lus rtsal sbyang pa ṭwāṃṭā ༵ṭwāṃ kā/na ༵ ༵ ṭwāṃ/ sem/ sa don nyams len ha cang mkhas pa'i sgo nas skyong phra rags rtog pa'i rba rlabs rang sar zhi/ / 59

g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas/ /bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog /phra rags zer rgyu 'di rnam rtog phra ba dang rnam rtog rags pa'i rba rlabs rang sar zhi ba rnam rtog phra rags 'di rba rlabs kyi gzusas su bkod pa red rang sar zhi zer rgyu 'di rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'di rgya mtsho rang gi ngang la zhi nas thim 'gro yi yod red dpe yag po gcig yod pa red/ 'gro mgon satsang pa rgya ras kyi gsung mgur gcig la/ shin tu dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho 'di/ chu bur byung bzhin thim pa ste/ rnam rtog chos skur ngo sprod pa'i/ slob dpon zhig lags te go lags sam/ zhes bka' rgyud pa'i lugs la rnam rtog gi gnas lugs chos sku 'am gsal stong ngam spros bral du ngo sprod pa'i dpe rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'di yag shos yin gsungs pa red 'dug des na phra rags sam rnam rtog gi rba rlabs rang sar 'i 'ing rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i ngang la thim pa ba'in du phra rags kyi rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhi zhing / phra rags kyi rnam rtog 'gro 'ong med pa red ga'an las ma 'ong pa'i phyir na gzhan du 'gro yi ma red/ de rang gi ngang du zhi dgos kyi 'dug phra rags kyi rnam rtog 'di ga'an las 'ong ba yin na ga'an du btang chog gi red ga'an nas ma 'ong ba'i phyir na ga'an du 'gro sa yod ma red/ g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang i gnas/g.yo ba med pa'i sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas rang bzhin gyis gnas pa/sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong dbyer med de g.yo ba med pa chu bo'i gzugs su bkod de rang ṅgas gnas rang bzhin gyis gnas pa rlung gis ma g.yo na chu rang bzhin gyis gnas pa bzhin du ngang gis gnas pa la zer/ de yang gangs mgur nges don zab mo las/ sgom pa 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun/sgoma~X 'i thun mtshams bzung du med/ bsgom bya sgom byed brtol nas thal/

sgom pa'i snying rus bzang ste byung / gsungs pa 'di dang don dag gcig pa 'dug ga sgom pa 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun 'dra po rgyun chad med pa sgom rgyu'i thun mtshams bzung rgyu med/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du rang babs su bzhag pa thun dang thun ma tshams las 'das pa bsgom bya sgom byed brtol nas thal/gnas lugs bsgom bya sgom byed brtol song bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das song ba de'i phyir na nga sgom pa'i snying rus 'di yag po yin bsam pa yod gsungs pa red 'dug bsgom bya sgom byed yod na snying rus byed na'ang 'dzin pa la brten pa'i snying rus red pa bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i/ bying rmugs zer rgyu 'di la da bshad pa mang po gda' ba zhi gnas kyi skabs su dgag gzhas rgya chen po mang po zhe drag 'dug ga mtshams mtshams su bying rmugs 'di rtogs dka' las khag po ngos zin dka' las khag po yod pa red/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis lam rim ye shes snying po'i 'grel pa gcig la rig pa'i dwangs cha med pas bying ba gsal ba'i nyams kyis ma zin pa la rmugs pa/ gnyid dang 'brel bas 'thib pa zer nas gsungs 'dus da 'di 'dra po bying ba dang rmugs pa'i rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i bying rmugs 'di rnyog pa'i dri ma la bzhag pa red/ bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'am 'das pa'i zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog skyon med pa'i zhi gnas brtan po yong ba'i smon lam red/ zhi gnas sgom pa'i skabs su tshigs bcad 'de yag po yod red/baspyaraṭwāṃdatrīmatrītrīyarshayangabalhasapa~Xtshe/ /༵ṭwāṃtrī wa wa wa nā rdo bye sdu~X/ ṭwāṃkū war/ ma/ nga / /'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shog /bltar med sems kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa 'di spros pa dadī zlol

ba yin pa'i phyir na bltar med pa red/ don dam dasnyod byed kyi shes rab kyis mthar thug par blta mi thub pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs spros bral yin pa'i phyir na don dam dpyod byed kyi shes rab kyis ji lta ba ba'in du bltar med pa/ rjes dpag gis blta yi yod red yin na'ang ji lta ba bzhin du bltar med pa/ ngo bo spros bral yin pa'i cha shas bltar med pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs la yang nas yang du brtag cing dpyad na de lta ba red mthong med don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong / lta ba'i skabs su blta bya lta byed las 'das pa'i phyir na bsgom pa'i skabs su dang mthong ba'i skabs su'ang mthong bya mthong byed las 'das dgos red/ mthong du med pa'i don ni ji bzhin lhan ger mthong / ga 'dra byed nas lhag ger mthong ba red/ mthong bya mthongakhyed las 'da' pa'i don gsal bar mthong ba rjes car du mthong ba red/ yin min don la the tshom chod pa nyid/ 'di yin nam min bsam pa'i the tshom som nyi chod pa/ 'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shos cig da 'di nor 'khrul dang bral ba'i rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i smon lam mo/ /yul la bltas pas yul med sems su mthong / /sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bos stong / /gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol/ /'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /phyi gzung ba'i yul la gcig tu bral la sogs pa'i shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas yul med sems su mthong yul rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa sems su mthong / sems tsam ltar du byed na sems kyi 'khrul snang yin par mthong phyag rgya chen po ltar du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal gyi rtsal dang rol par mthong / yul la bltas pas yul med sems su mthong na sems la bltas na sdu ༵dra red/ sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bo ste/ sems rang gi ngo

bo la shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas sems kyang ma grub pa/ sems ni sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o gsungs pa bzhin du sems la bltas pas gcig tu bral gyi rig pa sogs kyis brtags shing dpyad na sems ma grub pa sems yang gcig du ma'i rang bzhin la 'das pa'i phyir na sems yang ma grub pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid red/de nas mtha' bzhi skye 'gog dang mu bzhi skyes 'gog sogs kyi rigs pas dpyad na sems skye ba med pa red sems skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba red/ de'i phyir na sems rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa red/ sems med sems la bltas pas sems med pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid red sems kyi ngo bo stong pa yin na'ang stong pa 'di grub pa red pas stong pa'ang stong pa las 'das pa red stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gsungs pa bzhin du stong pa'ang ma grub/ gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol/ phyi gzung ba'i yul dang nang 'dzin pa'i sems gnyis ka la bltas pas gzung 'dzin gnyis las 'das pa'i phyir na gnyis 'dzin la bden par zhen pa rang sar grol/ lta ba'i skabs su gnyis 'dzin la bden par zhen pa rang sar grol sgom pa'i skabs su gzung 'dzin las 'das pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang du gnas pa'i gzung 'dzin rang sar grol bas rang sar grol/ da 'di phyag chen gyi skabs su gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog shar ba'i skabs su gzung 'dzin bkag mi dgos pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa rang la bltas pas gzung 'dzin gyi sems 'di nyid gsal stong dbyer med red 'di'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs rgya mtsho la thim pa bzhin du rang sar grol ba gsungs pa red/ gzugs 'dzin rang sar grol te 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po mngon sum du rtogs par shog cig 'di'i skabs su tha ṭwāṃtā du

sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal yin pa 'di khas blangs te 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs te rmongs pa'i mun nag las grol ba shog de yang bdag gzhan sems can thams cad/ gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol te bdag gakrikā sems ༵na thams cad kyis 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa' —na lam yi/ da/ byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che/ / mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin/ /'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya/ /gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob shog /da 'di gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob pa'i smon lam byed/ phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi lugs la gcig shes kun grol dang kun shes gcig sdug zer nas gnyis gsungs kyi red/ gcig shes kun grol zer rgyu 'di gcig sems kyi gnas lugs shes shing rtogs na lta sgom zab mo'i gnad thams cad rtogs pa'i phyir na kun las grol ba rmongs pa thams cad las grol ba red/ kun shes gcig sdug zer rgyu 'di tshigs dang tha snyad mang po shes na'ang sems kyi gnas lugs ma shes na gcig tu sdug pa rmongs pa sdug shes 'di spongs thub kyi ma red zer nas gsungs pa red/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che/ sems kyi gnas lugs yid byed las 'das pa 'di ni chos can phyag rgya chen po yin te de las ga'an pa'i lta ba zab mo dang sgom zab mo med pa'i phyir 'di 'dra po/ spyir btang phyag dang rgya la bshad pa mang po yod pa red/ mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin/ sems kyi gnas lugs yod med mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di dbu ma chen po red/ sems kyi gnasdu lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di chos can/ dbu ma

chen po yin te/ spros pa'i mtha' dang bral zhing dbus la'ang mi gnas pa'i phyir/ 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ni chos can/ yang na sems 'das kyi rig pa 'di ni chos can/ rdzogs chen zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ kun 'dus pa'i phyir ma rtogs pa'i skabs su 'khor ba'i chos su 'dus rtogs pa'i skabs su myang 'das kyi chos thams cad 'dus shing rdzogs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i sems kyi gnas lusas 'di rtogs na spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing 'phags ba'i skye ba'i yum yin pa'i cha nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang red bde bar gshes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po yang red phyag rgya chen po'ang red rdzogs pa chen po'ang yin pa'i phyir na gcig shes na don dam gyi lta ba thams cad kyi don rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan par shog cig 'di'i skabs su phyag rdzogs dbu gsum la khyad par med tshul bshad pa red/ sems kyi sanas lugs gcig la tha snyad btags pa'i skabs su phyag chen rdzogs chen dbu ma'i tha snyad so sor btags pa red/ 'di la paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung gcig la/ phyag chen rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ nyams len can gyi rnal 'byor pas/dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu babs/ ces nyams len can gyi rnal 'byor pas dpyad na dgongs pa gcig red ma gtogs so sor med pa gnas lugs mthar thug gcig red gsungs pa yin/ nyams len ma byed pa'i tha snyad kyi rig pas dpyad na dgag sgrub bzo ba'i skabs su 'gal 'dur bzod de dgag sgrub bzos dgos pa red 'gal 'du med na dgag sgrub bzo thub kyi ma red yang de ba'in 'ju mi pham gyi gsung nges shes sgron ma'i nang / kha cig rang lugs rdzogs pa che/ phyag chen sogs las 'phags so zer/ ma rtogs lam gyi tha snyad med/ rtogs na dgongs pa gcig pa la/ rigs pa 'thad pa'i dbye ba med/ kha cig rang lugs kyi rdzogs pa chen po phyag chen dadī ṭābu

ma sogs las 'phags so zer gyi 'dug zer zer rgyu 'di ma rang ba'i tshigs yin bzhin 'dug ga ma rtogs lam gyi tha snyad min/ sems kyi gnas lugs dngosaganas ma yin na phyag chen yang ma red/ rdzogs chen yang ma red dbu ma yang ma red/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs na sems 'di la ngo bo mang po med pa ngo bo gcig rang yin pa'i phyir na rig pas 'thad pa'i sgrub byed yod ma red gsungs pa de yang yag po 'dug 'brug pa kun legs kyis phyag chen rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ don la khyad par ngas ma mthong / phyogs re can gyis so sor 'byed/ zhes gsungs pa red/ ha ha tshig 'di yag po yod pa red 'di bka' brgyud pa'i grub thob kyi rtsag gcig yin/ phyag chen rdzogs chenadabu ma gsum/ don la khyad par ngas ma mthong / tshigs la khyad par yod red ma gtogs don la khyad par nga 'brug pa kun legs kyis mthong ma song zer/ phyogs re can gyis so sor 'byed/ phyogs re can namacirang gi lta ba mchog tu bsgrub te dgag sgrub byed 'dod pa tshos so sor 'byed cig gsungs/ 'di so sor ma 'byed na dgag sgrub bzo thub kyi ma red so sor 'byed dgos kyi red gsungs/ rang lugs mchog tu sgrub pa'i skabs su gzhan gyi lta ba 'di tad tsa dman pa bzo dman pa'i cha nas dgag pa brgyab dgos kyi red phyogs re can dgag sgrub 'dod pa chos so sor 'byed de dgag sgrub kyis gsung pa red 'dug dngos gnas khyad par yod ma red/ a ni 'di'i skabs su karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes kyang / yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che/ mtha' dang 'bral ba dbu ma chen po ste/ 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya/ gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thoṭwāshogadocepy-iphyag chenardzogasduchespya dbu ma gsum thare snyad so sor red ma ga 6sdus na — sna/ ༵ trī/kā ṭwāṃṭwāṃkū ༵/ ༵ sna spyarshas me lda / da//

mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral/ /blo las 'das pas mi rtog lhun gyis grub/ /rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /da 'di'i skabs su bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong rgyun chad med pa'i smon lam yin gyi 'dug sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du 'jog tshul dang bzhag tshul zab mo byung na bde ba chen po skyes kyi red de yang zhenapa med pas bde chen rgyun chad med pa/ bden chen la zhen pa yod na 'ching byed red de'i phyir na zhen pa med pa'i bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa dang mtshan 'dzin med pa'i 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral/ 'di 'od gsal ba'o bsam nas mtshan 'dzin dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa med pas 'od gsal sgribagayogs dang bral ba phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor pas sems rang babs su bzhagapa'i cha nas 'od gsal gyi nyams myong ga 'dra yod red zer na gsal sang nge dwangs sang nge gsal dwangs lhang nge ba rig pa'i dwangs cha dang gsal cha rig cha yod na'ang de la mtshan mar 'dzin pa med pa mtshan 'dzin yod na mtshan 'dzin gyis bsgribs bsdad pa red/ mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba blo las 'das pas mi rtog lhun gyis grub/rnam par mi rtog pa'ang blo las 'das pa rnam rtog las 'das pa'i mi rtog lhun gyis grub pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong spyir btang sgom brgyab pa'i skabs su sems rang babs su gnas yong dus bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams myong yong gi yod pa red 'dug de yong tshul la khyad par can 'di skabs su zhes pa med pas bde chen rgyun chad med pa mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral ba blo las 'das pas mi rtog lhun gyis grub pa 'di 'dra po rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog rtsol ba med pa'i nyams myong 'bad brtson med pa'i nyams myong 'bad brtson las 'das pa'i nyamakā ktong

rgyun chad med pa shā3nga ci snan nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol/ /ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag /tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med/ /sbos bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog /ngan rtog 'khrul pa rnam rtog gi 'khrul pa ngan pa rnam rtog gi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi dbyings su dag pa rnam rtog ngan pa dang 'khrul pa ngan pa yod na'ang rnam rtog ngan pa 'khrul pa ngan pa ma spub pa dang / ma grub pa 'di chos dbyings red rtsa ba shes rab las phyin ci lo ga brtags pa dang 'dod chags dang chags pa brtags pa 'di tsho'i skabs su phyin ci log bzhi ma thub pa dang 'dod chags dang chags pa po ma grub pa brtags pa 'di tsho de dag gi gnas lugs sam chos dbyings gtan la phab nas gsungs pa red/ 'di ga re red zer na phyin ci log la bden par zhen pa bkag pa'i ched du gsungs pa red 'dug ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang gi rang bzhin gyis dbyings su dag pa rnamartog ngan pa 'khrul pa ga 'dra yod na'ang 'khrul pa rang gi gnas lugs sam rang bzhin 'di rang ba'in gyis ma grub pa chos kyi dbyings red/ ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin gyis dbyings su rang sar grol/ phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi skabs su mtshams mtshams su rnam rtog 'khrul pa spang du med zer rgyu 'di rgyu mtshan gcig yod red/ 'di gnas lugs bsgom pa'i 'khrul pa rang sar grol ba la go dgos red/ tha mal shes pa bzo bcos las 'das pa'i shes pa gnyug ma'i shes pa sems las 'das pa'i rig pa 'di la spa blang bral thob med ngo bo la skyon med pa'i phyir na skyon spong yas yod ma red/ spang blang bral thob med skyon spong zhing bral ba dang / yon tan blang zhing thob pa med pa 'di~X rgyu mtshan 'di skyon rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa'i cha nas ngo bo la spong du

med pa/ sazhan stong dang 'brel na yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i cha nas gzhan nas bsgrub tu med pa bshad kyi red/ mdor na sku gsum lhun grub zer rgyu dang 'di tsho thams cad ga'an nas bsgrub tu med pa don dam gyi yon tan 'di sems la lhun grub tu gnas pa gzhan las bsgrub tu med pa red/ ga'an nas sgub tu yod na phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi lugs la 'dus byas chags kyi red/de'i phyir na spros bral chos nyid bden par rtogs par shog da 'di'i skabs suphyag chen gyi lugs la ngo bo spros bral gyi cha nas thal 'gyur gyi lta ba dang 'brel/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi cha nas rgyud bla ma dang mthun par gsungs/khyad par du gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde sogs las gsungs pa red 'dug spros bral chos nyid bdeshā pa ༈gsapaṭwāṃsmon lamamo/ /༵ ṅge sna~X sdoṭā zlo washā sdupa / sdusdo ༵ /dṛ dṛdro 'a/khya/mas/ /shāpy-i sdo trīsdo ddhisna spra rnyi sdo kā rnyi dī trīdhi can/ la/ /bzod med kyi snying rje skye ba'i smon lam red/ 'gro ba sems can gyi rang bzhin las kyi dbang gis khams gsum 'khor bar 'gro zhing / 'gro ba'i rang ba'in nam 'gro ba'i ngo bo 'di rtag tu sangs rgyas ye nas sangs rgyas kyang /rdzogs chen gyi lugs la gdod nas sangs rgyas dang po'i sangs rgyas ka dag gi sangs rgyas zer na bshad pa mang po yod pa red/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las sangs rgyas thog ma mtha' ma med/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa zer rgyu 'di red don dam pa'i 'jal dpal gyi mtshan mang po'i rnam grangs brjod pa sems kyi gnas lugs la bshad pa red 'dug 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu don dam pa'i sangs rgyas min kyang ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams/ 'gro ba rnams kyi rang gi rang bzhin nam sems kyi /ṭās

lugs 'di ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs pa'i stobs kyis mtha' med 'khorabar 'khyams/ gnyen po med na 'khor ba la mtha' med pa'i phyir na mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba la 'khyams pa red/ gnyen po yod na 'khor ba las grol te mtha' yod red/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ sa bon thog ma yod med kyang /mes tshig pas na phyi mtha' mthong / de bzhin 'khor ba mtha' med kyang /bdag med mthong bas phyi mtha' grub/ zhes 'khor ba thog ma med pa mtha' ma yod pa gsungs/ thog pa med pa'i bye brag la bltos nas mtha' ma yod pa'ang bshad pa red/ gnas lugs lta ba'i dbang du byed na 'khor ba kho rang mtha' yod med las 'das pa red/ sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la/sdug bsngal mu dang mtha' med pa'i sems can rnams la bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog bzod du med pa'i snying rje chen po rgyud la skye bar shog zer nas snying rje skye ba'i smon lam 'di yang gal chen po red 'dug rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pas/ tshe 'di rmi lam byu mar blta/ ma rtogs pa la snying rje bsgoms/ gsungs pa 'di tshos 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur blta tshe 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu ma rtogs pa'i dbang gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i sems can la snying tram̐ sgo/saṭwāṃsu~Xtshopa red 'dug go / —༵ṭwāṃ twe ṭwāṃ kā ṭwāṃ dnghaX rdo /kā sna dī trī lhakāg/ sa/ pa'i/ /zung 'jug gol sa bral ba'i lam mchog 'di/ /'bral med nyin mtshan kun tu bsgom par shog /bzod med snying rje'i rtsal yang ma 'gags pa'i bzod du med pa'i snying rjechen po 'di'i rang rtsal lam rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i brtse dus ngo bo stong don rjen par shar brtse dus zer rgyu 'di snying rje rang dus su ngo bo stong dokā rān par shar ba/ snying rje'i stong nyid 'di bsgom dgos pa red 'dug

sems can la bzod med kyi snying rje bsgom snying rje'i sems kyi ngo bo yang stong pa red/ phyag rgya chen po red/ brtse ba'i rang dus su ngo bo stong pa'i don rjen par shar ba/ brtse sems kyi stong nyid bsgom na brtse stong dbyer med pa red pa/ zung mjug gol sa bral ba'i lam mchog 'di/ stong nyid snying rje rgyud du 'brel ba/ brtse stong zung du 'brel ba'i zung du 'jug pa'i lam 'di go sa dang bral ba theg pa chen po'i lam ma nor ba red/ gol sa dang bral ba'i lam gyi mchog tu gyur pa 'di 'bral med nyin mtshan kun tu bsgom par shoga'abral ba med pa nyin dang mtshan rtag tu bsgom par shog da 'di rtag tu stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel gyi lam bsgom pa'i smon lam mo/ /sdom stobs sdus byung spyan dang maṭwāṃn shes dang / /༵dro~X zloshā ༵nā zlosdu ༵ ṭāzlo / ༵'i zlo / sdu phroṃ dnghasnas/ // /rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /'di lta bu phyag rgya chen po'i don ma nor ba bsgom pa'i stobs las ga re byung gi red/ spyan dang mngon shes drug sbyan dang mngon shes kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa red/ de dag mngon du gyur pa dang de yang mi la ras pas dbu ma yang dag par brjod pa las/ de las snying rje shugs phyung ste/stobs dang mi 'dzin bzung la sogs/ sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin pa/nor bu rin chen tshul du byung / gsungs pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i stobs las spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams kyang rang bzhin gyi0byung ba red gsungs pa red/ sems can smin byas/ sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dngos po bzhi la brten nas sems can rnams smin par byas 'ing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rab tu sbyangs pa bde ba can bsta~X pa

la'ang 'ing khams sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa byed/ zhing khams sbyangs zer rgyu 'di phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di zhing khams yin bsam pa nang rang cu snying nang du bde can gyi 'ing khams bsgom pa skyes yul 'di nas nyi ma nub kyi phyosas rol na nam mkha' mthon po'i dbyings la bde ba can gyi 'ing khams yod par bsam ste phyi nang skye yul gyi 'ing lams gsum 'brel te smon lam btab pa yod red 'di tsho 'ing sbyangs zer/ sems can smin byas sangs rgyas zhing rab sbyangs/ 'ing la sogs pa'i smon lam de 'di 'dra bo'i nyams len bsam gyis mikhyab pa yod pa red/ sangs rgyas chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zer rgyu 'di kun rdzob kyi chos dang don dam gyi chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs sems can gyi don byed pa la kun rdzob kyi chos rnams 'grub dgos kyi red 'dug rang don mthar phyin pa la don dam gyi chos rnams rdzogs dgos kyi yod red/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog bsod nam kyi tshogs rdzogs pa sems can smin pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyangs pa ste rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin te mthar thug bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sangs rgyas par gyur cigaphyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang / /rnam dkar dge ba ji snyid yod pa'i mthus/ /de ltar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /smon lam rnam dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas dang sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje dang / rnam dkar dge ba ji nyid yod pa'i mthus/ rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji nyid yod pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas gong du smon lam ji skad bta7༵ pa de ltar bdag dang smon lam 'debs pa po bdag dang / da dang po

'debs pa'i skabs su karma pa rang byung rdo rje mchog red da lta bdag dang zer rgyu 'di smon lam 'debs pa po bdag dang pha mar ma 'gyur pa gcig kyang med pa'i mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi smon lam rnam dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig smon lam rnam par dag pa 'di btab pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'dis smon lam 'grub pa'i smon lam byed/ da theg pa chen po'i lugs la mjus bsngo ba dang smon lam 'di gal chen po yod red/skyob pa 'jig rten gyi phyag chen lnga lda na las kyang / tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la/ smon lam gyi byi dor ma byas na/ dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi byung bas/ mjug bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ gsungs pa red mjug bsngo ba dang smon lam gal chen po red gsungs/ de bzhin du 'go nas sems bskyed gal che ba'ang / byams dang snying rje'i rta pho la/ gzhan phan gyis dkyus thag ma chod na/ khrom lha mi'i 'or che mi 'byung bas/ sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan brjod/ gsungs pa red 'go la sems can gyi don du sems bskyed pa de yang gal chen po red gsungs/ rang lus lha sku rgyal po la/ gzhan 'gyur med kyi gdan sa ma bzung na/ ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs mi 'du bas/lus yi dam gyi lha la nan tan bya/ gsungs pa red/ lus tha mal gyi zhen pa sbyangs pa dang rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong sprin bzhin du bsdu ba la'ang rang lus lha skur bsgom dgos pa red 'dug lha sku phyag rgya chen po'ang bsgom dgos red yi dam lha yang gal chen po yin pa red/ sems nyid nam mkha' yangs pa la/ rnam rtog gi thin tshogs ma bcangs na/ mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas/ sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod/sems kyi gnas lugs mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i nam mkha' yangs pa la rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs 'di dwangs dgos kyi 'dug rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dwangs na mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar ma shar ba de'i phyir na sems rnalha ༵ra

mi rtog pa'i ngang du rang babs su bcos pa lhod kyis bzhag pa'ang gal chen po red/ da spyir btang phyag rgya chen po'i lugs la nges don rgya mtsho ltar du byed na snang ba sems su ngo sprad pa sems stong par ngo sprod pa stong pa lhun spub tu ngo sprod pa lhun grub rang grol du ngo sprod pa bzhin red/ snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa 'di las dang po pa la sems tsam dang mthun par bshad/ thun mongs ma yin pa 'od gsal sems kyi rang rtsal du ngo sprod pa/ sems stong par ngo sprod pa thun mongs ltar du gcig tu bral gyi gtan tshig sogs kyis dpyad de sems ngo bos ma spub pa/ thun mongs ma yin pa ltar du byed na da lta'i sems skye 'gag gnas gsum byung gnas 'gro gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du bshad pa'ang yod/ stong pa lhun grub tu ngo sprod pa stong pa 'di yang stong kyang med dgag tsam dang spros pa zhi tsam ma yin pa stong pa lhun grub tu ngo sprod pa lhun grub rang grol du ngo sprod pa de yang gal chen po red/ da 'di tshig 'grel mdor bsdus yin la tram̐ditrī'agrel bshad rgyasapasitu'i'aktol chenadang yang ṭāshā ༵rsha snarnoswā ldadri rdo ṭwāṃṭwāṃ kā zlo zlod yo sdod re/da sa bcad 'a tsho bkram nas ga 74

rje mi la'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rnam gzhag mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa/༄7/ /lta ba stong pa'i ye shes yin/ /sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin/ /spyod pa chags metā /py-i ḍikā tram̐spya/ shes/ ldabra/sa bu dri med gcer bu yin/ /kha lta rkyang par shor nyen gda'/py-irsha rsha zlo ༵/sna ༵dzosna ḍā/ ba med/ltab ltong pa'i ye shes zer nas kha rkyang pas bshad bsdad na phan thog yod ma red/ lta ba stong pa'i ye shes zhes pa'i ming gdags pa'i gzhi tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs kyi don de la nges shes skyes dgos kyi 'dugarjod byed stong pa'i ye shes ces pa'i tshig gam tha snyad du 'jug pa'i don la bee tshom las 'das pa'i nges shes skye dgos kyi 'dug nges shes ma skye na tshig gis bdag 'dzin grol ba med/ stong pa'i ye shes lab pa'i tshig tsam gyis bdag 'dzin dang bden 'dzin las grol thub kyi ma red/ don dam 'jog tshul gyi tha snyadakli tshig ji 'dra zhig yin na'ang tshig 'dis bdag 'dzin las grol gyi ma red/ don dam zhes pa'i tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi'i don la nges shes skye ste the tshom las 'das pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug ma gtogs tshig tsam gyis stong lhasbya ye

shes brjod pas bdag 'dzin las grol ba med/ tshig gis bdag 'dzin las grol mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan des na nges shes drag po saces/ sems kyi sanas lusas spros bral gyi ye shes sam sems kyi sanas lugs 'od gsal yin pa la the tshom med pa'i nges shes drag po 'am nges shes shugs chen po nges shes brtan po sacig skye dgos kyi 'dug sbyir btang stong pa'i ye shes zer rgyu 'di tshig red/tshig 'di'i brjod bya'i don la nges shes skye dgos pa red gsungs/ mdor ṭwāṃnārdzu rsha lta ba stong ba'i ye shes de la the tshom med pa'i nges shes drag po dargos sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med de/gnas pa rkyang par 'chor nyen gda'/yeshesananganasamashaṭwāṃn/ cheṭwāṃspyaṅgi sdo ༵༵trī gātrī bye~X / da/des na ma yengs dran pa gces/mthar thug gi phyag rgya chen po'i sgom de ga re red zer na/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'dzin pa med pa red/ sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med de yang lhag mthong gi cha med par gnas pa rkyang par 'chor nyen gda'/ sems 'od gsal gyi ngang du rang babs tu gnas pa kho rang zhing gnas red/ rang babs su sanas pa'i ngang nas rang ngo rig pa'i rig pa shar dgos pa red/ ye shes nang nas ma shar na/ de sems 'od gsal gyi ngang du rang babs su gnas pa'i ngang nas rang ngo rig pa'i rig pa'am ye shes shar dgos kyi 'dug de yang rig bya rig byed las 'das pa'i ye shes shar dgos kyi 'dug rig pa'i ye shes nang nas ma shar na rkyen ga re 'dug gnas pa brtan kyang grol cha mekā/6 sems rang babs su ba'ag ste rang babs su gnas pa brtan po yod

na'ang grol cha yod ma red/ 'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun gyi gnyen po rig pa'i ye shes nang nas ma 'ar na gnas pa brtan po ga tshod yod na'ang grol ba'i cha yo da ma red/ dper na bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrub yong dus gzugs med bzhi'i skabs la bskal pa brgyad khri la sogs pa sems rtse gcig tu gnas 'gro ba red zer gyi yod red yin na'ang bdag 'dzin dang bden 'dzin las grol ba'i cha med pa bshad pa red/ de nang ba'in sems rang 'bab su gnas pa rkyang pa la grol cha med/ bying rgod la ye shes mi skye bas/ sems gsal cha med pa'am rig pa'i dwangs cha med pas bying ba dang / phyi rol gyi yul la yengs pa'i rgod pa de gnyis ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gegs yin pa'i phyir na bying rgod gnyis las ye shes mi skye bas des na ma yengs dran pa gces/ sgom pa'i skabs su sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'dzin pa med pa dmigs pa med pa ra 'jog pa'i skabs su rang ngo rig pasbya rig pasharaṭwāṃgosakyi sdudusnaṭwāṃtā sdu sbyakātrī ṭwāṃkā sdi rnyi rdo sna sdo'/ /lta sgom grosas su ma yar na/brtul zhugs spyod pa chos brgyad grogs/des na zhen med sgrib med gces/tho co spyod pa zer rgyu 'di rang la lta ba zab mo dang sgom bzang po med par rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa byed pa/ yang mtshams mtshams su skye bo'i dbus su gcer rgug byed pa la'ang bzhag gi 'dug klong chen pa'i snying gtam sum cu pa'i nang la skye bo'i dbus su gcer rgug byed la sogs/ tho co'i spyod pa brtul bzhugs yin snyam yang / 'jig rten pa rnams ma dad skye ba'i rgyu/bag yod brten pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ gsungs pa red/ rtokādhi pa

mthon por ma slebs kyi gong du tho co'i spyod pa byed na phan gyi ma red/ tho co'i spyod pa 'chor ba'i nyen kha gda' zer rgyu 'di mi la ras pa rang gi nyams myong nas gsungs pa red 'dug spyod pa ci mdzad na'ang lta ba zab mo dang sgom gyi grogs su shar dgos kyi 'dug lta sgom grogs su ma shar na/ brtul bzhugs spyod pa chos brgyad grogs/ lta sgom gyi grogs su ma shar ba'i brtul bzhugs kyi spyod pa 'di 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi gnyen por mi 'gro bar chos brgyad kyi grogs su 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa'i rgyu mtshan des na zhen med sgrib med gces/zhen med sgrib med gces zer rgyu 'di spyod pa gang 'dra zhig byed na'ang spyod byed yul spyod pa po'i bdag spyod pa'i bya ba gang la yang zhen pa med pa dmigs pa med pa 'dzin pa med pa dgos red gsungs/ dper na byams pa'i smon lam las/ bdag 'dzine bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ dngos po kun la mi gnas pa/ sems can kun la sman slad du/ ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog zhes gsungs pa 'di pha rol phyin pa spyi'i mtshan nyid la sbyar yas red 'dug de nang bzhin spyod pa thams cad la'ang sbyar chog pa red/ bdag 'dzin dang bdag gir 'dzin pa med pa'i sgo nas spyod pa yod na lta sgom zab mo dang 'brel bsdad pa red lta sgom zab mo dang ma 'brel na tho co'i spyod pa'am brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa 'di 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi grogs su 'gro yi red de'i phyir na zhen med sgrib med gces/ zhes gsungs pa red/ mdor na spyod pa chags med rgyun zhig skyong ba de la 'khor gsungs zhen pa yod na sgrib pa red spyod pa'i 'khor gsum la zhen pa med na sgrib pa'ang yong gi ma red/des na zhen med sgrib med / sbyod pa sduces meer pa red 'duga~Xrno ṭī 'i na tā py-i~X rsha hāl snye/na gda'/78 'khrul pa nang nas ma zhig na/

sdotā rdonā zlormātrīṭwā ṅgidī shā spya chu/ nga /lta ba don dam mthar thug rang byung gi ye shes sam sems 'das kyi rig pa 'di nyid kyi glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma'i gos dang bral te 'bras bu dri med gcer bu bzhag pa yin na'ang mtshan ma'i na bza' gsol nyen gda'/'bras bu de la zhen pa'am mchog tu 'dzin te mtshan 'dzin gyi na bza' gsol ba'i nyer kha 'dug na bza' zer rgyu 'di gos red/ mtshan 'dzin gyi gos g.yogs ya'i nyen kha yod red/ spyir btang 'bras bu dri med gcer bu dang 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyi bshad pa mang du yod na'ang 'bras bu la bden par zhen na bden par zhen pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma chags yod/ skabs 'dir mtshan 'dzin la na bza'i ming btags pa red/'khrul pa nang nas ma zhig na/ sems kyi 'khrul snang de dag rang byung ye shes kyi ngang la 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'khrul pa nang nas ma zhig na/ yid smon bsgoms kyang don go chung / yid smon byed de 'bras bu dri med gcer bu dang 'bras bu rang byung gi ye shes dang 'bras bu sems 'das kyi rig pa la sogs ci 'dra zhig zer na'ang phan gyi ma red/ des na 'khrul pa zhig par gces/'bras bu dri med gcer bu la sogs pa bshad bsdad na mtshan 'dzin gyi na bza' gsol nyen yod pa dang 'khrul pa nang nas ma zhig na yid smon bsgoms kyang don rtsa nas med pa ma red de don chung ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di'i phyir na/ 'khrul pa nang nas zhig ste 'bras bu dri med gcer bu 'di mngon du 'gyur ba 'ig dgos kyi 'dug de ltar bzhin du lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung mgur las/ bka' rgyud pa rang babs su 'dzin pa la u tshugs che drags kyi 'dug snying ma pa ka dag dang kun bzang zer nas bzang po la zhen pa byed kyi 'dug sa skya pa gsal stong la zhen pa chen po 'dug dge shāpy-is
