gzugs stong pa'o/ stong pa nyid gzugs so/ gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na da snang ba snang stong dbyer med la blta ba'i skabs su nges shes skye dgos kyi yod pa red/ snang ba snang stong dbyer med la nges shes skye na de lta ba red/ de napy-i de'i rjes su lta ba gzhan dag zhig btsal dgos kyi mi 'dug gsungs pa da/blo yi bzhag thabs go lags sam/blo yi bzhag thabs ma go na/sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug par/rang sems bcas bcos ma byed cig /de ni lta ba la nges shes skye ste sgom pa'i skabs su da mnyam par bzhag dgos kyi 'dug mnyam par bzhag pa'i skabs su bzhag ya de blo mnyam par bzhag pa red pa sems mnyam par bzhag pa red/ blo yi bzhag thabs go lags sam go song bas/ blo yi bzhag thabs ma go na/ blo yi bzhag thabs ma go na/ ma shes na/ ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug blo yi bzhag thabs ma go na/sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug par/ sems 'phyo ru ma bcug pa/ phyir btang sems zer dus kun rdzob kyi sems red/ nyid kyi sgras sems kyi gnas lugs la go yi 'dug de'i skabs su sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug pa zer rgyu de sems dang sems nyid so sor la phye mi dgos par sems dang soms nyid so so la ma phye pa yin pa red bsam pa yod/ sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug pa/ phyo ru ma bcug pa mchong du ma bcug pa/ gzhan du rgyug ma bcug pa/ sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug pa/ rang sems bcas bcos ma byed cig sems nyid 'phyo ru ma bcug na de ni sems ṭākag ste bcas bcos bzo dgos kyi 'dug go zer na/ sems nyid bcas bcos ma byehā ༵ga

semasakyi gnas lugs de gang zag gi bdag med kyi dbang du byed na bdag med pa red/ sems tsam gyi dbang du byed na gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi rang rig tsam red/ rang rgyud kyi dbang du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs gcig du ma las 'das pa stong pa nam mkha' lta bu gsungs pa red/ thal 'gyur gyi dbang du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs spros bral red/ ga'an stong gi dbang du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs de rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba red/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang du byed na sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong dbyer med dang bde stong dbyer med dang rig stong dbyer med yin pa'i phyir na bcas bcos bzo ya med pa red/ rnam rtog gi bcas bcos sna tshogs bzo na'ang gnas lugs rang la bcas bcos med pa/ gnas lugs rang la bzo bcos med pa'i phyir na bcas bcos ma byed cig de stong nyid bcu drug gi nang nas kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid zer rgyu de chos rnams kyi gnas lugs bzo bcos las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid bzo bcos las 'das pa'i cha nas rang bzhin stong pa nyid gsungs kyi 'dug ga 'o de nang bzhin sems nyid bcas bcos ma byed cig gnas lugs bzo bcos las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir na bzo bcos ma byed cig sems kyi gnas lugs spros bral yin pa'i phyir na spro bral la bzo bcos ma byed cig sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong dbyer med yin pa'i phyir na gsal stong dbyer med la bzo bcos bzo ya med pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs rang byung rig pa'i ye shes la bzo bcos bzo ya yod ma red/ de'i phyir na bzo bcos ma byed cig bzo bcos ma byed na da rang 'babs su 'jog tshul ga re red zer na da 'di'i skabs su lta ba'i dpyad pa de lhag mthong gi khongs su gtogs pa red/ da de sa swā py-inas red/ zhi gnas kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i bsgom tshul red/ rang

lugs bu chung lta bur zhog rang lugs bu chung lta bur zhog zhes pa'i don dag de bu chung la gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i gdag gzhi'i snang ba yod na'ang gdag gzhi la sgra rtog 'brel 'dzin gyi tha snyad med pa dang rang gis bzo bcos gang yang mi byed pa snang ba bkag mi dgos pa/ snang ba bkag mi dgos pa/ snang sems mi dgag pa/ snang sems bkag mi dgos pa dang dgag mi dgos pa de bzhin du rang lugs bu chung ltar bu zhog rang lugs su zhog rang babs su zhog rang gi ngang du zhog rang gi sems rang gi gnas lugs kyi ngang du bzo bcos ma byed par zhog snang ba ma dgag pa rang babs su zhog ces pa rang lugs bu chung lta bur zhog da 'di'i 'jog tshul de phyag chen gyi lugs srol yin sa red/ snang ba dgag mi dgos pa/ snang sems dgag mi dgos pa rang babs su 'jog tshul de bshad pa red/ rlabs med rgya mtsho lta bur zhog rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs las 'das pa/ rgya mtsho rlung gis mi g.yo ba bzhin du rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs rang sar zhi ba rgya mtsho lta bur zhog dper na ngas sngar de byas ma 'ongs par de bya/ da lta de byed bsam pa'i rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs rang sar zhi ba/ rgya mtsho rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta bu rang babs su zhog gsungs pa red/ rang gi ngang du lhod kyis bzhag pa de da lta skyon bkag cing yon tan bsgrub mi dgos pa rang gi ngang du rang babs su 'jog tshul red bzhag rlabs med rgya mtsho lta bur zhog rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs rang sar zhi ba/ rgya mtsho rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta bu dang de'i 'jog tshul de rnam rtog ga 'dra zhig yod na'ang rnam rtog gang skye na'ang rnam rtog la dgag sgrub mi byed par rnam rtog rang gi rang thog tu lhod kyis lhod pa'i rnam rtog rang grol du 'gro ba'i sgom tshul de red/ phyag chen dang 'brel ba yod pa/ rlabs med rgya mtsho lta bur zhog rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs de gzhan nas 'ong ba ma red gzhan du 'gro yi ma red/ gzhan nas ma 'ong ba'i phyir te gzhan du 'gro yi ༵ ḍid/

'gro 'ong dang 'bral ba (blo bzhin )rang gi ngang du zhi 'gro ba bzhin du rnam rtog de gzhan nas ma 'ong ba'i phyir na ga'an du 'gro yi ma red/ 'gro 'ong dang bral bas rnam rtog rang gi ngang du zhi 'gro'i red/ de 'dra po rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs rtsa nas ma g.yo ba bzhag na gsal cha med pa stong rkyang 'dra po dang spros pa zhi tsam dang gsal tsha rtsa nas med pa 'gro na ga 'dra 'dug gsal cha med pa ma yin pa/ gsal ba mar me lta bur zhog rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs ma g.yo na'ang gsal cha yod pa dwangs cha yod pa/ rig cha yod pa/mar me rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta bur zhog de'i 'jog tshul de gzhan stong gi 'jog tshul dang phyag chen dang rdzogs chen gyi 'jog tshul phal cher de tsho gcig pa yin sa yod gsal pa yod/ mar me rlung gis g.yo ba lta bu gsal sang nge dwangs sang nge ba lta bu/ da de'i 'jog tshul de rnam rtog rang gi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pa lta ba red/ lta zer rgyu de shes rab kyi mig gis don dam pa'i gnas lugs la blta ba la lta ba zer ba yin pa 'i phyir na rnam rtog gang zhig gis gnas lugs la gcer gyis bltas na lta ba red/ de'i ngang du lhod kyis glod yong dus rnam rtog gi dba' rlabs rang sar zhi ba de rgya mtsho rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta bu red/ gsal cha yod gsal cha dang dwangs cha rig cha yod pa mar me rlung gis mi g.yo ba lta bu'i 'jog tshul de rnam rtog gi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod tshul shes na gsal cha dang dwangs cha de rang bzhin gyis yong gi yod pa red 'dug sgom pa'i tshe na gsal dwangs bsgom mi dgos zer ba red/ gsal cha yod/ gsal cha dang dwangs cha yod bsam nas bzo mi dgos pa/ rang babs su gnas yong dus rang bzhin gsal cha yod pa de 'dra po la zer gyi red/ gsal ba mar me lta bur zhog de lta bu gsal cha dang dwangs cha yod na da de ni nga'i sgom de yag po 'dug gsal cha dang dwangs cha 'arīsdu nga sgom chen yag po/ nga'i sgom de yag po yin bsam gyi yod red/

nga sgom chen yin bsams nas de ni da lta snyems zhugs kyi yod pa red 'dug gde 'dra po'i snyems zhugs pa yin na/ nga'i sgom gyi nyams myong yag po red/nga sgom chen yag po yin bsam nas snyems zhugs na rnam rtog gi 'dzin pa bsgrib yong gi yod red/ rnam rtog gis bsdam pa/ rnam rtog gis bsgrib pa/rnam rtog gis bcings pa red/ dper na nga sgom chen yag po yin bsam na bdag 'dzin red/ nga'i sgom gyi nyams myong de yas po yin bsam na/ nga sgom chen yag po yin bsam na gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang 'brel yong gi yod pa red 'dug nga'i sgom gyi nyams myong de yag po yin bsam na chos kyi bdag 'dzin dang 'brel yo nga ba red/ de'i phyir na sgom yag po yong gi yod ma red/ des na da ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug de 'dra po'i snyem sa zhugs na snyems de yang nga sgom chen yag po 'dug nga'i sgom gyi nyams myong de yag po yin bsam pa'i 'dzin pa de yang rang zhig tu 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ snyems med pa zhog ga 'dra byed zhog mi ro lta bur zhog sgom gyi nyams myong dang nga sgom chen yag po yin bsam pa'i snyems byed ma zhugs par mi ro lta bur zhogami ros mi ro yin/ mi ro nga yag po yin bsam pa'i rnam rtog yod ma red/ de dpe 'dra po red/ nga sgom chen yin/ nga'i sgom gyi nyams myong de yag po yin bsam na yang de bkag thub kyi mi 'dug bkag dgos kyi mi 'dug yin na'ang de 'dra de gang ga rnam rtog red/ nga sgom chen yag po yin/ sgom gyi nyams myong yag po yin bsam pa'i rnam rtog de'i ngo bo la gcer gyis blta lhod kyis klod ya red/ phyag chen gyi lugs srol red/ lhod kyis klod/ de mi la ras pa'i gsung mgur gzhan dag cig la'ang / 'gro chags nyal 'dug sems la blta/ thun mtshams med pa'i dge sbyor yin zer gyi red/ 'gro chags nyal 'dug gang gi skabs su yang rnam rtog gi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod na zhi lhag gnyis ka tshang ba bshad pa red/ gcer gyis sduktos

pas cha nas lta ba/ rnam rtog gi gnas lugs la blta dus gsal ba'am stong pa'am gsal stong dbyer med/ ma gtogs gzhan zhig shar ya med pa red/degacer gyis bltas na lta ba red/ lhod kyis klod na sgom pa red/ snyems med mi ro lta bur zhog 'dzin pa/ snyems kyi 'dzin pa ga 'dra zhig zhugs na'ang de'i ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod ya red/ da phyag chen dang rdzogs chen gnyis ka'i skabs su mthar thug gi bshad tshul de red/snyems med mi ro lta bur zhog des na sbyir btang dbu ma'i sgoyo tshul dang de tsho thams cad khyed rang tsho bar ta bar ta la slob sbyong byed na las sla po yong gi red pa/ da lta nga'i khyad par can phyag chen gyi sgom tshul 'dra po red snyems medami ro lta bur zhog g.yo med ri bo lta bur zhog de 'dra po bsgom pa'i skabs su rkyen ngan pas g.yo na ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug sgom de rkyen bzang po dang rkyen ngan pas g.yo ba yong gi red/ da rkyen bzang po dang ngan pa'i rnam rtog gis g.yo na mi g.yo ba zhog mi g.yo ba ga 'dra byed nas bzhag dgos kyi 'dug dpe ri bo lta bur zhog ri bo sa g.yem sogs kyis g.yo'i yod red de rlung gis mi g.yo ba rkyen rlung gis g.yo ba med pa de bzhin du bzang ngan gyi rkyen gyis mi g.yo bar zhog bzang ngan gyi rkyen gyis rnam rtos byung na'ang rnam rtog rang gi ngo bo la gcer bltas cog bzhag dgos kyi yod red/ ngo bo la cer gyis bltas lhod kyis bzhag rnam rtog skye tshe gcer gyis blta ba gces/sems thag gcod tshe thog tu bzhag pa gces/ sgom du med kyang sgom du bzhag pa gces/ (yid mos )sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ zer nas klong chen pa'i gsung gcig la de 'dra zhig 'dug ha cang yag po red pa/ g.yo med ri bo lta bur zhog de lta bur bzhag na sems nyid sgro btags med pa yin/sems la yin pa dang ma yin pas sgro mi btags/ dgag pa dang sgrub pa'i sgro rtsa /sdu ma btags gsungs pa red/ gnas lugs dgag sgrub las 'das pa

spros pa las 'das pa'i phyir na dgag sgrub gang yang bzo ya med pa red/dgag sgrub med pa la sbyir btang rnam rtog gis dgag sgrub bzo'i yod red/mtshams mtshams dgag pa bzo/ mtshams mtshams sgrub pa bzo/ 'dra mi 'dra bzo'i yod red/ de'i phyir na sems nyid sgro btags med/ sgro 'dogs med pa sgro btags med pa dgag sgrub med pa'i ngang du lhod kyis lhod/ 'o na dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog skye tshe ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog ga re skye na'ang ngo bor gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod ya ma gtogs de las gzhan dag bzo ya med pa red/ 'o dgag pa dang sgrub pa de yag po ma red bsams nas phar g.yug ya med pa red yang tshur sgrug ya med pa red/ gnas lugs dgag sgrub las 'das pa red pa sems nyid sgro btags med pa yin/da 'di sgom tshul red/ rang lugs bu chung lta bur bzhag pa/ rlabs med rgya mtsho lta bur bzhag pa/ gsal ba mar me lta bur bzhag pa/ snyems med mi ro lta bur bzhag pa/ g.yo med ri bo lta bur bzhag pa/ bzhag tshul lnga red ba/da sems rang babs su bzhag tshul gyi dpe mi 'dra ba mang po yod red de de las lhag pa yod sa ma red bsam pa yod/ sgro btags med pa yin zer/mdor bsdus na lta ba'i nges shes rnyed nas 'jog pa'i skabs su sgro btags med pa'i ngang du lhod kyis klod dgos kyi yod red/ de nas lhod tshul de mi la ras pas/ phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su/ chung ngu chung ngu yang yang sgom/gsungs pa red phyag rgya chen po la chen po dang chung ngu'i dbye ba med pa red de dus tshod thung thung gi nang la lhod kyis klod dgos pa red 'dug go gcer gyis blta lhod kyis klod/ lhod kyis klod de lhod kyis klod pa la mu tshugs brgyab na de ni rnam rtog gis bsdam yong gi yod red/ de lhod kyis lhod ya la 'bad rtsol bzo ya med pa red 'dug ga dus tshod thung thung la gcer gyis bltas/ lhod kyis klod yang rnam rtog zhig skye na gcer gyis bltas lhokā spyas

klod de 'dra yang yang bzo dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug yang de 'dra bzo ba'i skabs su gal chen bzo nas de ni yang bag yangs kyi ngang du bzhag dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug 'o gcer gyis bltas na mthong rgyu gcig yod/ lhod kyis klod na lhod nas gcig yang rtogs ya gcig yod bsams nas de 'dzin mi dgos pa red 'dug da lta ba sgom pa nyams myong de 'dra po gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod pa'i nyams len lta ba zab mo dang sgom pa zab mo de 'dra po bzo nas de yang mdor bsdus na gcer bltas cog bzhag gnyis red/ de nas nyams myong ga 'dra byed shar gyi red/nyams ṭwāṃ 'char lugs go trīgs sam/ṭwāṃ snardzuṅge ༵ trīṭwāṃ spyisdu ༵sna ༵ nāng/ sa/rnasdu snrog sdu'an du spangs pa med/ṭābye na ṭā da zlo rdzu ṭwāṃ sbyaṭwāṃ ༵sduṭwāṃ//dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char/phyogs med nam mkha' lta bur 'char/gsungs pa red/ nyams kyi 'char lugs ha go 'dug gas gsungs pa red/ lo ston dge 'dun la/ nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam/ de'i skabs su lo ston dge 'dun la gdams ngag gnang ste dga' chen sgom tshar ba red/ rjes su bar ta gcig la nyams kyi bcos thabs gcig zhus 'dug ga de'i skabs su gsungs pa red/ nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam/ go song bas/ nyams kyi 'char lugs ma go na/ ha ma go na/ khri gdugs rtsal gyis mun pa sangs/ khri gdugs zer rgyu de nyi ma red/ glu'i tshig dang mgur gyi rdospra la nyi ma la khri gdugs zer gyi red/ khri gdugs kyi nyi ma'i 'od kyi rtsal

gyis mun pa rang sangs su 'gro'i red/ mun pa sangs/ mun pa de gzhan nas 'ong ba ma red gzhan du 'gro'i ma red/ nyi ma'i rtsal shar ba'i skabs su mun pa rang zhig rang grol rang gi ngang du zhig 'gro ba dang grol 'gro ba red ma gtogs nyi ma shar song zer nas mun pa gzhan dag la 'gro'i ma red/ de nang bzhin khri gdugs col gyis mun pa sangs pa de bzhin du rnam rtog gzhan du spangs pa med/ rnam rtog gzhan du spangs ya yod ma red/ gang yin zer na rnam rtog gzhan nas 'ong ba yin na gzhan du btang gi red/ rnam rtog gzhan nas ma 'ong ba'i phyir na gzhan du 'gro'i ma red/ rnam rtog 'gro 'ong las 'das pa red/ rnam rtog gzhan du spangs pa med/ de nas spyod 'jug shes rab le'u la'ang / gzhan nas 'ong ba ma yin la/ gnas pa ma yin 'gro ma yin/ rmongs pas btags pa gang yin pa/ sgyu ma las ni khyad ci yod/zer nas shes rab le'u'i nang 'dug ga sbyir btang chos thams cad 'gro 'ong las 'das pa red/ khyad par du thol byung gi rnam rtog gang skye 'gro 'ong las 'das pa red/ rnam rtog gzhan du spangs pa med/ de'i phyir na bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ga 'dra zhig skye na rnam rtog bzang po gzhan nas bsgrub ya med red/ rnam rtog ngan pa gzhan du spangs ya med pa red/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ rnam rtog la ngo bo med pa/ rnam rtog gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin las 'das pa'i phyir na rnam rtog la ngo bo med pa dang / rnam rtog gi ngo bo gsal stong yin pa dang / rnam rtog gi rang bzhin 'od gsal yin pa'i phyir na de ni rnam rtog gzhan du spang du med/ da grub mtha' dang sbyar na/rnam rtog gzhan du spang du med pa la grub mtha' dang sbyar na mang po yod pa red/ mtshams mtshams su grub mtha' dang sbyar na rgya chen po chags kyi 'dug ga da shar tshul ga re red/ gzhi med rmi lam/ lta bur 'char/ nyams kyi 'char tshul de gzhi med pa shar gyi red/ nyams mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa/9ktom

brgyab pa'i skabs su nyams mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa shar ba de gzhi dang rtsa ba bden par grub pa dgos kyi min 'dug gzhi med kyi nyams shar gyi red/gzhi med kyi nyams de'i dpe gcig dgos kyi 'dug zer na mi lam lta bu shar ba red/ rmi lam du nyams dang snang ba sna tshogs pa shar na'ang kho rang gzhi dang rtsa ba gang yang yod ma red/ gzhi med kyi snang ba red/ snang ba thams cad gzhi med kyi snang ba/ nyams myong thams cad gzhi med kyi snang ba rmi lam lta bu red/ nyams kyi snang ba thams cad gzhi med rmi lam lta bu yin pa'i phyir na nyams ga 'dra 'ig byung na'ang de la nyams bzang po la zhen pa bzo ya med pa red/ nyams ngan pa la bkag ya dang nyams bzang po bsgrub ya med pa red/ nyams la dgag sgrub bzo na nyams bzang ngan ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang bcing ba bzo'i red/ nyams ngan pa la zhen na sems 'khrug pa ma zad nyams bzang po la zhen na'ang bcings kyi yod pa red 'dug ga'i med rmi lam lta bur 'char/ de ni phyag chen dang rdzogs chen gyi tshig kha shas la dkar nag spyin gyis bsgrib par mnyam pa dang gser sgrog thag sgrog bsgrib par mnyam pa de rgyu mtshan de ngo bo bcing grol las 'das pa'i don dag red/ bzang ngan gyi bcing grol las 'das pa'i tshig red/ shes rab snying po las/ ma rig pa med ma rig pa zad pa med/ rga shi med/ rga thi zad pa'i bar du yang med do/gsung pa de gnas lugs bcing grol las 'das pa'i don dag ston gyi yod red/ de nang bzhin gnas lugs bcing grol las 'das pa red/ gnas lugs bcing grol las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir na nyams ga 'dra zhig shar na'ang gzhi med pa rtsa ba med/ gzhi med rtsa bral gyi nyams red/ de'i phyir na nyams la zhen pa med pa de yang gal chen po red/ yang nyams la zhen pa dgos kyi min 'dug ma zhen pa gcig dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas u tshugs yadī ༵rgyab mi dgos pa red/ nyams la zhen pa med pa'i zhen pa de yang rang

grol tu 'gro dgos kyi 'dug de mi la ras pas brag srin mo la gsungs pa'i thim pa nyer brgyad kyi mjug la'ang / sgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa ste/ mi sgom pa'ang rtog pa yin/ sgom dang mi sgom gnyis su med/ mthar thug don la lta ba med/ zer rgyu de sgom bsam na'ang rtog pa red/ 'o sgom rtog pa red 'dug pa/ mi sgom bsam na'ang rtog pa red/ gnas lugs sgom mi sgom gyi spros pa las 'das pa red/ rgyu mtshan ga re red/ chos dbyings spros pa las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir na de ni sgom yang spros pa las 'das pa sgom mi sgom gyi spros pa las 'das pa red/ de'i phyir na sgom ngo ma de la lhod lhod byed nas lhod shes dgos kyi yod red/ yang lhod lhod de yang zhen pa med pa dgos pa red 'dug 'dzin med chu zla lta bur 'char/ da 'dzin pa med pa/ 'dzin pa med pa chu zla lta bur 'char/ da 'dzin pa med pa/ 'dzin pa med pa chu zla lta bu 'char/ 'dzin pa med pa'i nyams shar gyi red/ nyams shar na'ang de la 'dzin pa med pa dgos kyi 'dug sgom gyi skabs su spyir btang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum shar gyi red zer gyi 'dug ga bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ga 'dra zhig shar na'ang de la zhen pa dang 'dzin pa med na/bcings pa med pa red/ zhen pa dang 'dzin pa yod na nyams bzang na ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang bcing ba yong gi yod pa red 'dug nyams gang shar 'dzin med du bzhag 'dzin med du bzhag na ga 'dra zhig chags kyi 'dug chu zla lta bu chags kyi 'dug chu nang gi zla ba lta bu chags/ sprin dang bral ba'i nam mkha'i zla ba chu dwangs ba la shar ba'i skabs su g.yo mgul 'gro 'ong sna tshogs bzo yi red/ de yin na'ang g.yo 'gul 'gro 'ong de bden par spub pa rang bzhin gyis grub ma red/ rten 'brel snang tsam red de'i phyir na rten 'brel snang tsam la bden par ma zhen/ bden par zhen na de 'ching byed red/'dzin med chu zla lta bur 'char/ dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur rnyi~Xr/

nyams de tsho dngos por med pa red/ dbu ma'i skabs su dngos por med pa rang bzhin med pa bden pa med pa de tsho mang che ba la don dag gcig pa red/dngos po med pa rang bzhin med pa'i nyams shar gyi red/ dngos med kyi nyams sam rang bzhin med pa'i nyams de ga re red/ 'ja' tshon lta bur shar gnam dwangs por yod dus nam mkha' la 'dza' tshon gcig shar yong dus gzhu 'dra po cig mdzes po kha dog sna tshogs shig shar yong dus de ni dngos po med pa'i snang ba red/ dngos po med pa'am rang bzhin gyi med pa'i snang ba red yin na'ang kho rang gzhi gcig la nam mkha' gang ga la khyab yong gi min 'dug lam ka 'dra bo gcig la gcig shar yong ya 'dug de 'dra bo la rten 'brel gyi snang ba zer gyi red pa rten 'brel gyi snang ba 'gag pa med pa/ rten 'brel gyi snang ba rang bzhin med pa red/ des na dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char/ nyams 'char tshul de 'ja' tshon lta bur yin pa'i phyir na de la zhen pa yod na 'ching byed red ma gtogs zhen pa med na nyams ga 'dra zhig 'char na'ang 'ching ba med pa red 'dug de mi la ras pa'i gsung mgur gangs mgur nges don zab mo las kyang spyod pa'i bya byed 'od gsal ngang /rten 'brel stong par thag chod pas/ spyod bya spyod byed gtol nas thal/ spyod pa'i byed tshul bzang nas byung / gsungs pa red/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa bzhin du mi la ras pas kyang rten 'brel la stong pas khyab par zhal gyis bzhes pa red/ rten 'brel stong par thag chod pas gsung rgyu de rten 'brel la stong pas khyab pa de la nga the tshom rtsa nas med yid ches yod gsungs pa red/ de ni nga tsho yang lam sang the tshom med pa ma byung na de ni dpyad pa bzo nas de'i rjes su 'brang nas the tshom med pa bzo dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char/ phyogs med nam mkha' lta bukā ༵char/ phyogs med pa/ phyogs med pa de phyogs med pa spros pa med

pa'i nyams shar ya yod pa red/ phyogs med spros med kyi nyams de ga re red/nam mkha' lta bur 'char/ nam mkha' de gzugs can gyi dngos po ci yang med pa stong rkyang gi dpe bzhag yong dus stong rkyang de gzugs can gyi dngos po thams cad dang bral ba'i cha nas de ni stong rkyang gi dpe dang nam mkha' la mtha' dbus las 'das pa'i cha nas spros bral gyi dpe la bzhag gi 'dug gophyogs med nam mkha' lta bur 'char/ phyogs med kyi nyams 'char gyi red ga 'dra zhig shar gyi red nam mkha' lta bur 'char gyi red/ gzhi med rmi lam lta bur/ 'dzin med chu zla lta bur/ dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur/ phyogs med nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams shar gyi red/ de nyams kyi 'char tshul red/nyams kyi 'char tshul bzhi red/ bcos thabs red/ nyams la zhen pa byung na ga 'dra byas bcos dgos kyi 'dug bcos thabs red/ nyams kyi bcos thabs go lags sam/ nyams mi 'dra ba shar yong ba'i skabs su de la zhen pa dang 'dzin pa byung na bcos thabs dgos 'dug gam/ nyams kyi bcos thabs ma go na/ miha/ spya na da dang po dpe'i sgo nas gsungs pa red/rdo ༵ḍi tre sdu~X zlo trī ༵༵ zlo drong/ // / rsha ṭwāṃṭwāṃldi sdo nga kṣiṃ ṭwāṃ/kha'ishe dīng pa/ 'phro yang skye med ngang /shes pa 'phro zer rgyu de sems kyi shes pa 'phro ba rnam rtog 'phro ba de bzang rtog dang ngan rtog dang bar ma'i rnam rtog sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dang skye yi yod red/rnam rtog ji ltar 'phro na'ang gang 'phro yas yi rnam rtog de skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir skye med kyi ngang red/ shes pa rang skye med yin pa'i phyir na rnam rtog ga 'dra zhig 'phro na'ang skye med kyi ngang red/ de'i phyir na dgag sgrub ma bzo gsungs ༵ ḍid/

da skye med kyi rnam rtog ga 'dra zhig 'phro na'ang 'phro ba'i rnam rtog bzang rtog ngan rtog bar ma'i rnam rtog ga 'dra yin na yang skye med kyi nges shes de dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug ga skye med 'di red zer nas mthong yas med na'ang skye med la nges shes skye yas yod red/ shes pa 'phro yang skye ba med pa'i ngang red/dpe de dpe gsum red/ skyi ser che yang bar snang ngang / skyi ser de rlung red/mgur dang glu'i skabs su rlung la skyi ser zer gyi 'dug skyi ser ram rlung shugs chen po/ rlung mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa/ rlung ji ltar che na'ang bar snang stong pa'i ngang red/ bar snang stong pa la rlung de 'gro bsdad red ma gtogs ga'an dag kho rang 'gro sa yod ma red/ stong pa gcig la rlung de 'gro dgos red/ dpe de bzhin du shes pa 'phro yang skye ba med pa'i ngang red/ bzang rtog ngan rtog ga re 'phro na'ang dgag sgrub ma bzo/ 'o na ga 'dra byas bzo dgos kyi 'dug sngon ma bshad pa bzhin du gcer gyis blta lhod kyis slod yas red/ rba rlabs che yang rgya mtsho'i ngang / rnam rtog 'di rba rlabs/ rba rlabs ji ltar che yang rgya mtsho'i ngang yin pa de bzhin du rnam rtog gi rba rlabs ji ltar che na'ang skye med kyi rgya mtsho'am 'od gsal gyi rgya mtsho'am skye med kyi rgya mtsho la g.yo ba med red/ de'i phyir na rnam rtog g.yo ba'i skabs su rnam rtog gingo bo skye med spros bral yin pa'i phyir na spros bral skye med kyi ngang la g.yo ba med pa'i nges shes de dran dgos pa red 'dug rba rlabs che yang rgya mtsho'i ngang / lho sprin mthug kyang nam mkha'i ngang / lho sprin zer rgyu de sprin gyi ming red glu'i skabs su mgur gyi skabs su lho sprin mthug kyang / sprin ga 'dra zhig mthug na'ang nam mkha'i ngang red/ nam mkha' las gzhan du sprin 'gro sa yod ma red/ brag 'dra bo de 'dra'i sring la sprin de rdzus thub kyi ma red/ nam mkha'i ngang las byung nam mkha'i ngang la zhig 'gro ba red/ dpe de bzhin du ba~X rtog ngan rtog bar ma'i rnam rtog ga 'dra zhig 'phro na'ang skye ba med pa'i

ngang red/ skye med kyi ngang du rang babs su bzhag dgos kyi 'dug da dpe gsum dang sbyar te rnam rtog gang skye'i ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas na skye ba med pa red/ skye ba med pa'i ngang du lhod kyis klod na de ni nyams ga 'dra zhig shar na'ang zhen pa dang bcings pa yod ma red/ rang grol du 'gro gi red/ shes pa 'phro yang skye med ngang / rig pa srang du 'jug pa la/ rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs/ srang du 'jug zer rgyu de rig pa de rang byung rig pa'i ye shes/ gzhan stong dang khyab chen rdzogs chen gyi skabs su rig pa dang rang byung gi rig pa dang de ni sems 'das kyi rig pa la sogs pa tha snyad sna tshogs yod red/ rig pa srang du 'jug pa la zer dus rig pa rnam rtog gis mi g.yo b.rasrang du 'jug par byed pa la/ rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs/rlung dang / rlung dang bzhag nas sgom rlung dang sbyar nas sgom tshul de rlung phyi ru 'gro ba dang nang du rngub pa dal po byed nas rlung sems dbyer gyi ngang la bzhag pa dang / yang rlung ti si bar rlung bzung ste sems rang babs su bzhag pa/ rnam rtog gi zhon pa rlung yin pa'i phyir na rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs zer dus rlung / rnam rtog gi gzhi rlung 'gro 'os dal po'i ngang du sems rang babs su bzhag rlung sems dbyer med du bzhag rlung gi gnas lugs yang skye med red sems kyi gnas lugs yang skye med red/rlung sems skye med spros bral gyi ngang du lhod kyis klod/ de 'dra po yin pa red/rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs/ spyir btang rlung zhon de la de ni chos drug gi lugs la gti mug bsgom ste rlung sgom yas mi 'dra ba mang po yod red pa yin na'ang rlung sgom pa'i skabs su rlung dal po 'jam po byed nas sgom dgos kyi yod red/ rlung shugs chen po byed nas bkag na rlung de rtsa khyad par can la 'gro na'ang sems 'khrug gi red/ rlung rgya yan du btang ba'am de ga la btang na'ang sems gnas thub kyi ma red/ rlung bkag na'ang 'a// gi

ma red/ lhod lhod byed nas rlung lhod kyis klod dgos kyi red/ rlung lhod kyis klod na sems yang lhod kyis klod kyi yod red/ de nga tsho'i lus drang na rtsa drang / rtsa drang na rlung drang rlung drang na sems drang zer gyi red pa lus drang po byed lhod lhod byed nas bsdad na rtsa yang drang po lhod lhod yong gi yod red/rtsa drang po lhod lhod byed nas bzhag na de ni rlung yang lhod lhod byed nas bsdad kyi yod red/ rlung lhod lhod byed nas rgyu na sems yang lhod lhod byed nas gnas kyi yod pa red 'dug yin na'ang gnas dgos/ yag po gnas dgos bsam pa'i 'dzin pa de dka' las khag shos red pa/ de 'dra po'i 'dzin pa byung na 'dzin pa la gcer gyis blta lhod kyis slod ya de zab shes de red/ rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs/ de steng rlung nas 'og rlung 'then lte ba'i thad rtsa zhig byed kha sna nas rlung dal po'i rgyu ba byed nas de nas mnyam par bzhag na rlung sems dbyer med du 'jog tshul sems rang babs suganas pa'i thabs zab mo yod pa red/ rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thongs/ da gti mug kyi skabs su bum chen sgom ya da de tsho yang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod red pa/ rnam rtog rkun bu byung ba la/ rkun ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag thongs/ rnam rtog de ting nge 'dzin de rku ma rku mkhan 'dra ba red/ rnam rtog de ting nge 'dzin gyi rkun bu'am rku ma byung na ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug rkun ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag thongs/ rku ma ngo shes dgos kyi 'dug zer red/ ga 'dra red zer na rnam rtog ngo shes dgos kyi red/ rnam rtog ngo shes na 'grig gi red gsungs pa red/ da de yin dus ngo shes pa de lta ba red pa/ ngo shes pa'i ngang du lhod kyis klod na sgom pa red pa/ 'o nga'i sgom la da rnam rtog gcig skye song bsal dus rnam rtog gi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas na de ni skye med dam spros bral lam gsal stong ngam stong sang nges pa 'asdi ༵ga yod pa de/ de blta tshul de lta ba red/ de'i ngang du lhod kyis klod na

sgom pa red/ rang babs su lhod pa red/ de 'dra po la sgom na rku ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag thongs/ rku ma ngos 'dzin dgos kyi 'dug rnam rtog ngo shes dgos kyi 'dug don dag rnam rtog ngo shes te lhod kyis klod dgos kyi 'dug ma gtogs rnam rtog dgag sgrub bzo thub kyi ma red/ bzo dgos kyi ma red/ phyag chen gyi lugs la rnam rtog bkag dgos kyi ma red/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo la blta ngo bo ngang la lhod kyis klod ya red/ rkun ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag thongs/ da dper na rku ma gcig khang pa'i nang la slebs yong na rku ma de ngo shes na las ka mang po dgos kyi mi 'dug pa/ rku ma de'i 'o nga ngo shes song bsam na kho rgyug 'gro'i red/ jag pa 'dra po yin na dka' las khag po red pa/ ha ha/ rkun ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag thongs/ shes pa yul phyir shor ba la/ bya rog gzings 'phur gdams ngag thongs/ shes pa yul gyi phyi la shor na ga 'dra dgos kyi 'dug phyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i yul gyi rjes su shor de la zhen pa skye na shes pa yul phyir shor ba red/ shes pa yul phyir shor na da shes pa de tshur bkug dgos kyi 'dug gas/ bzung dgos kyi 'dug gas/bsdam dgos kyi 'dug gas/ khang pa'i nang la rtsig dgos kyi 'dug gas/dgos kyi mi 'dug bya rog gzings 'phur gdams ngag thongs/ de rgya mtsho chenapo la gru gzings 'gro ba'i skabs su bya rog 'phur 'gro na/ bya rog de gtang na/ rgya mtsho chen po yin dus 'bab sa rtsa nas med pa red/ de kho de ga la g.yug bzhag na tshur dzing gi sding la babs 'ong gi red zer/ nga tshos brtag dpyad btang myong med/ yin na'ang de 'dra po red zer gyi 'dugamatsho chung chung yin na phyi la 'phur 'gro'i red po/ mtsho chen po/ rgya mtsho chen po la de ni ri yod ma red/ babs sa med dus tshur 'phur yong ba red/ de nang bzhin shes pa yul gyi gzugs sgra dri ro la rnam rtog shor na/ bya rog gzings 'phur gdams ngag thongs/ bya rog gzigs nas 'phur na1 ༵ṭwāṃng

bzhag na tshur 'phur yong gi red/ de bzhin du shes pa yul gyi phyi la 'brangs song na yul ga 'dra zhig la 'brangs na'ang de ni rnam rtog 'gro ba de la ngo shes pa tsam gyis lhod kyis klod na rnam rtog de ni 'gro ya med pa red/ spyir btang 'groyas med pa'i rgyu mtshan de rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs bzhin du rnam rtog skye 'gags las 'das pa rnam rtog skye tsam du rang zhig tu 'gro ba red de'i phyir na de ni bya rog gzigs 'phur gdams ngag gtang na 'grig gi yod red/rnam rtog 'gro ba de ngo shes tsam gyis 'gro ba med pa red/ skye ba med las thams cad skye/ skyes tsam nyid las skye ba med/ zer rgyu de rnying ma'i rgyud gsang snying gi lung 'dug gsar ma'i lugs la'ang mang po yod pa red 'dug da bya rog gzings 'phur gdams ngag thongs/ rnam rtog phyi la shor song na ngo shes pa tsam gyis lhod kyis klod na ma gtogs rjes su rgug dgos kyi min 'dug bzung dgos kyi min 'dug bkag dgos kyi min 'dug de ni bkag pa yin na bkag ma thub nas de ni yang sems 'khrug gi yod pa red/rnamartog gi gnas lugs la dbyibs dang kha dog skye 'gag med pa'i phyir na bkag thub kyi med pa red/ bkag dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa'i 'dzin pa des bsgrib kyi yod pa red/ bya rog gzings 'phur gdams ngag thongs/ de nyams kyi bcos thabs red pa/ nyams myong mi 'dra ba tsho ga 'dra byed bcos dgos kyi 'dug rnam rtog gi rku ma byung na rkun ma ngos 'dzin dgos kyi 'dugashes pa yul phyir shor na bya rog gzings 'phur gyi gdams ngag thongs dgos 'dug da 'di'i mgur de tsho yang nas yang du gsungs na yag po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug spyod pa'i spyad thabs go lags sam/ spyod pa'i spyad thabs ma go na/ seng chen 'gying ba bzhin du spyad/ 'dam skyes padma bzhin du spyad/glang chen spyon pa bzhin du spyad/ shel gong phyis pa bzhin du sbyad/ seng chen 'asdi~X zlo bzhin du spyad zer rgyu de ga re red/ seng ge chen po de tsho/ stag dang

gzigs dang wa la sogs pa dud 'gro gang la'ang 'jigs pa med dus kho g.yo ba med pa 'gying nas bsdad kyi yod/ red dpe de bzhin du gang la'ang ma skrag pa/ gang la'ang zhum pa med pa'i spyod pa de seng chen 'gying ba bzhin du spyad/ de zhum pa med pa'i spyod pa red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel snang tsam yin pa dang / don dam spros pa dang bral ba dang / kun rdzobakyi rten 'brel de snang tsam yin pa'i phyir na 'jigs pa'i yul gang yang med pa red/ 'jigs pa'i yul bden par grub pa rdul tsam med par shes pa'i sgo nas de ni 'jigs pa med pa seng chen 'gying ba bzhin du spyad de 'gying med kyi spyod pa/ 'dam skyes padma bzhin du spyad zer rgyu de me tog padma 'dam rdzab mi gtsang ba'i nang nas skye na'ang mi gtsang ba'i dri mas ma gos pa bzhin du nga tsho 'khor ba la gnas/ 'khor ba'i rnam rtog 'khor ba'i nyon mongs sna tshogs kyis g.yo na'ang 'di'i dri mas ma gos pa padma bzhin du spyad/padma la dri mas ma gos pa bzhin du sbyad/ rgyu mtshan ga re ded/ dri mas ma gos pa de nga tsho'i dri ma yod na snang sems gnyis de red/ snang ba snang stong dbyer meda'i rdul phran yod ma red dri ma yod ma red/ shes pa gsal stong dbyer med la dri ma yod ma red/ snang sems gnyis po de la dri ma yod ma red/ dri mamed par shes dgos kyi 'dug lam sang dri ma med pa skye thub kyi ma red/snang sems la dri ma med pa dang / dri ma de snang sems la bden par zhen pa tsam red/ snang sems la bden par zhen pa'i dri ma de'i rnam rtog gi ngo bo la yang gcer gyis bltas lhod kyis klod na de ni 'dam skyes padma 'dra po red/'dam skyes padma bzhin du spyad/ de kha shas 'khor ba'i sems can gyi nang du gnas na'ang sems can gyi dri mas ma gos pa bshad tshul gcig yod red/yang rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched la nyon mongs skyes na'ang de'i dri mas ma bsgrib pa'i spyad tshul red/ glang chen smyon pa bzhin du spyad/ zer ༵ snyi'i

spyod pa de rtogs pa mthon po la slebs pa'i skabs su glang chen smyon pa bzhin du spyad pa/ dgag sgrub las 'das pa'i spyod pa la zer gyi red/ de phal cher rtogs pa mthon po la slobs nas rmi lam ngo shes na glang chen smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa bzo thub kyi yod pa red/ dgra dang gnyen gyi khyad par mi phye ba/gtsang ma dang btsog pa'i khyad par mi phye ba'i spyod pa la zer gyi yod pa red 'dug shel gong phyis pa bzhin du spyad/ shel gong la ngo bo la dri ma yod ma red/ phyi rol rdul sogs phyis na de ni kho rang phyi la dri ma yod ma red nang la'ang dri ma yod ma red/ de ba'in du shel gong phyis pa bzhin du spyad/ snang sems la dri mas ma gos pa/ da lta'i rnam rtog gi ngo bo gsal stong gi ngang du lhod kyis klod pa'i dri mas ma gos pa shel gong phyis pa ba'in du spyad/ de spyod pa'i spyad tshul red/ mdor bsdus na da lta'i snang sems kyi ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas snang ba snang stong dbyer med red/ de la 'dzin pas ma bsgrib/shes pa gsal stong dbyer med red gsal stong gi ngang du lhod kyis klod na dri ma med pa red/ dri ma yod pa de rnam rtog tsam red/ rnam rtog gi dri ma de rang grol du 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug da 'bras bu'i 'char lugs red 'dug 'bras bu'i 'char lugs go lags sam/ 'bras bu'i 'char lugs ma go na/ mi rtog pa las chos sku 'byung / 'bras bu'i 'char lugs dgos 'dug gas de ma go na de ni sku bzhi 'jog tshul de phyi la yod pa lta bu'i sku bzhi dang / sems kyi sku bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhi'i 'jog tshul gyi khyad par yod pa red/ da lta de'i sku bzhi de sems kyi sku bzhi la bzhag pa red/mi rtog pa las chos sku 'byung / sems kyi gnas lugs mi rtog pa mngon du 'gyur pa las ni chos sku 'byung gi red/ mi rtog pa'i dri ma dag pa'i chos sku 'byung gi red/ sems kyi gnas lugs bde ba nyid las longs sku 'byung /sedisdu ḍi gnas lugs bde stong dbyer med red de sgrib byed kyi dri ma dag na

de ni longs sku 'byung gi red/ gsal ba las ni sprul sku 'byung / gsal ba la sgrib byed kyi dri ma las grol na sprul sku 'byung gi red/ gnyug mas ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ gnyug ma sems kyi gnas lugs bzo bcos las 'das pa de'i dri ma dag na ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'byung gi red/ de sems la sku bzhi bzhag ste sems la rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku bzhi lhun gyis grub par bshad pa red/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sku bzhi lhun grub yin na'ang glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma yod dus glo bur dri bral gyi sku bzhi ma red/ glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma dag dus glo bur dri bral gyi sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur gyi red/ da 'di lam gyi skabs su sems la sku bzhi 'jog tshul de red/ gnyug mas ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ mi nga la mkhas pa'i sku bzhi yod/ mi nga la/ mi la ras pa nga la mkhas pa'i sku bzhi mkhas pas bzhed pa'i sku bzhi 'jog tshul de lhun grub tu yod gsungs pa red/ sku bzhi 'jog tshul zab mo de mkhas pa ma gtogs de ni slob sbyong gtad tsa med na shes kyi mi 'dug pa/ mkhas pas bshad bsdad yas kyi sku bzhi de nga la yod/ gang yin zer na/ sems kyi gnas lugs la sku bzhi lhun gyis grub pa red 'dug gsungs pa red/ mi nga la mkhas pa'i sku bzhi yod/ chos kyi dbyings su g.yo ba med/ sku bzhi de yang chos kyi dbyings su g.yo ba med pa/ sku bzhi zer nas ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba red ma gtogs gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings red/chos kyi dbyings chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba/ chos kyi dbyings/ de bzhin nyid don dam pa'i bden pa/ de kho na nyed zer rgyu dang da tha snyad sna tshogs yod pa red/ chos dbyings zer rgyu de yon tan gyi chos thams cad kyi dbyings la bshad pa 'dug ga rgyud bla ma las dbyings de bag yangs gu yang klod yang red/ don dag spros pa dang bral ba'i chos dbyings red/ chos kyi dbyings su g.yo ba dang 'gyur ba med pa/ da bsdus te gsungs pa red/ lta ba sgom pa nyams myong gsum/ lta ba snang ba thams cad chos skur thag ༵tā pa

sgom pa ma bcos gnyug ma rang babs su 'jog pa/ nyams myong 'char tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa gsung pa de nyams myong / de ni nyams myong de la zhen pa'i bcos thabs dang spyod pa dang 'bras bu rnam pa drug lta ba sgom pa nyams myong gsum/ bcos thabs spyod pa 'bras bu drug de rnam pa drug de la da lam cha tshang ba tshang gi yod red/ lam cha tshang de'i khongs su tshang gi yod red/ rnal 'byor nyams la shar nas blangs/ rnam 'byor mi la ras pa nga blo la shar nas blangasazer rgyu de mi la ras pa de ni dang po dka' ba chen po spyad/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi khang pa chen po bzhi brgyab dka' ba spyad/ de nas mar pa lo tsā mnyesate de ni dbang dang gdams ngag zab mo gnang ste ltag nya lung bstan phug tu mchod kong mar zhus gang ba dbu la bzhag ste zla ba bcu gcig bsgom pa nas bzung ste phyi'i rdzong drug nang gi rdzong drug gsang ba'i rjes drug yang rdzong gnyis dang nyi shu/ yongs su grags pa'i phug chen bzhi la sogs pa la bsgom ste de ni sgom byung gi shes rab brdol ba red/ slob sbyong de brag phug stong pa la bsdad nas sems la slob sbyong byed de de ni sgom byung gi shes rab brdol pa red/ mi la ras pa'i gsung mgur la'ang yod pa nga slob sbyong sems la byed pas snang ba dpe char shar te snang ba dang ma bral na dpe cha dang mi bral ba zhig yin gsungs pa red/ nges slob sbyong de rang gi sems la byed pa yin/slob sbyong sems la byed pa la brten nas snang ba thams cad nged kyi dpe cha yin/ de'i phyir na snang ba dang bral ma song na dpe cha dang mi bral ba zhig yin/dbe cha po ti kha shas brlag 'gro na de ni gang yang med pa de 'dra po ma yin pa/snang ba dang ma bral na dpe cha dang mi bral ba zhig yin gsungs pa red/ de 'drapo de la snang ba brda'i bla ma zer gyi red/ snang ba thams cad bla ma red/rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs/ da sgom byung gi shes rab brdol ba'i gsung mastarā zlod/ khyod kyang de ltar nyams su longs/ lo ston khyod kyang de ltar

nyams su longs/ de ltar nyams su blangs na de ni nor 'khrul yod ma red/'bras bu mngon du 'gyur gyi red gsung pa red 'dug 'di cug nyung nyung red don zab mo dang don rgya chen po yod 'dug de yang lo ston dge 'dun mkhas pa chen po red/ mkhas pa la gsungs pa'i gsung red de ni zab mo yang yod pa red/ de ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong de rigs bsdus na 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi da lta zhi lhag gi skabs su rigs bsdus yod red/rigs bsdus tshul de nyan thos theg pa nas mi sdug pa sgom pa dang dbugs 'gro 'ong la sems 'dzin pa nas bzung ste phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi skabs su ma bcos lhug pa rang babs su 'jog pa'i bar gang ga zhi gnas kyi khongs su bsdus kyi red/ ga re red zer na rnam rtog gi g.yeng ba zhi zhing rang babs su gnas pa'i cha yin pa'i phyir na gang ga zhi gnas su bsdus kyi red/ gnas pa'i khongs su bsdus kyi red de ni lhag mthong gi khongs su bsdus ya de chos mngon pa las rang mtshan dang sbyi mtshan phye yas dang / rang mtshan ga re red 'dug rang mtshan spyi mtshan phye na de ni phra ba yod red/ yang tshad ma'i skabs su mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum phye ba nas bzung ste de ni da lta dbu ma'i lugs la gcig tu bral la sogs pa'i rigs pas dpyad pa yod pa dang /phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi lugs la rnam rtog gi ngo bo la gcer gyis blta ba/gsal stong gi ngang la gcer gyis blta ba'i bar du rig pas dpyad pa yod pa/lta ba yod pa shes rab kyi lta tshul yod pa de tsho thams cad gang ga lhag mthong gi khongs su bsdus kyi red/ de yang gal chen po red/ des na da lta yi dam gyi lha sgom pa'i skabs su yang / lha'i zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs la sogs pa la dmigs pa de tsho dad pa'i sgo nas lha 'grub kyi red dmigs pa'i sgo nas zhi gnas 'grub kyi red pa/ da lta lha sku la dmigs pa'i cha shas kyi rten can rdzogs pa'i rten can zer dus sku'i cha shas re re la dmigs pa'i skabasdu 0sta cha

shas kyi rten can zer gyi red/ zhi gnas red de la sgom nas sku rdzogs par sgom pa'i skabs su rdzogs pa'i rten can zer zhi gnas red/ de ni lha de la dad pa yod na lha de'i byin rlabs zhugs kyi red/ yi dam gyi byin rlabs zhugs kyi red/ zhal gzigs yas dang de 'dra yod red pa/ de nang bzhin red/ de ni sngags skor yas la sogs pa thams cad rang babs su gnas pa'i cha de tsho gang ga zhig gnas red de ni gzugs snang stong / sgra grags stong sogs dpyad pa yod pa'i skabs de tsho lhag mthong la 'gro yi red/ mdor na mi la ras pas gcer gyis bltas pas ngo bo stong / spros bral nam mkha' lta bur gsung / cog gis bzhag pas gnas lugs rtogs/ chos kun stong pa'i ngo bo rtogs/ gsungs pa red/ gcer gyis blta ste gcer gyis blta zer rgyu de nga tsho'i mig gis gcer gyi blta/ a khos gcer gyis blta yi 'dug zer gyi red/ lta sa gcig dang blta dgos kyi 'dug pa de nang bzhin shes rab kyi mig gis kun rdzob la ma bltas par gnas lugs la blta ba de tsho gang ga da lta lhag mthong gi khongs su bsdus kyi red/ gang yin zer na shes rab kyi gnas lugs la blta ba'i phyir/ de ni dpyad pa med pa rang babs lhod kyis klod pa/phyi rol gyi g.yeng ba'i zhi zhing rang babs gnas pa'i 'jog tshul de gang ga zhi gnas red/ de nyan thos theg pa nas phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi bar du gang ga khyab kyi yod pa red 'dug go / de ni yang sgom brgyab pa'i skabs su grim lhod rem po de gal chen po red zer de khrid yig mang po la yod pa red pa/ yin na'ang grim lhod kyis rem pa'i grim tshod dang lhod tshod de shes dka' las khag po yod pa red/ 'o na ga 'dra zhig bzo dgos kyi red/ da dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog dang spros pa skye ba'i skabs su de ni rnam rtog de'i ngo bo la gcer gyis blta lhod lhod byed nas lhod kyis klod yas de gal chen po yin sa yod bsam pa yod1 spya8 las gzhan dag zhe drag bzo yas yod ma red/ gang yin zer na

gnas lugs kho rang bzo bcos las 'das pa red/ 'ju mi pham gyis gang la dmigs par byed pa lta ba'i dug gang zhig rtsol pas zin pa sgom pa'i skyon/gsungs pa red/ dmigs pa dang 'dzin stangs yod pa thams cad lta ba'i skyon red/ 'bad brtson bzo yas yod na sgom pa'i skyon red zer gyi yod red/yang las dang po pa'i skabs su de ni lta ba'i skabs su dmigs pa yod pa dang sgom pa'i skabs su 'dzin pa yod pa red yang de'i khyad par shes dgos kyi red/da lam bar ta bar ta nas de ni dgag sgrub kyi rnam rtog dang bcos ma'i rnam rtogag 'dra zhig yin na'ang ngo bo la gcer gyis blta lhod kyis klod yas de phyag chen rdzogs chen gyi sgom tshul red/ de ni sgom pa'i skabs su yang khams 'dusaphrer rgyu gcig yong ba red/ khams 'dus zer rgyu de sgom pa'i stobs kyisarlung dang thig le rtsa khyad par can la 'gro ba'i skabs su de ni mtshams mtshams sems 'khrug gi red de ni mtshams mtshams sems dga' po chags kyi red/ dbye ba chen po yong gi yod red/ de'i skabs su da lta nyams dang nyams kyi gegs sel zer rgyu 'dug na de tsho 'bad bcos gtong dgos kyi yod red/ mtshams mtshams 'di las 'phro khams 'dus pa zer rgyu de skye ba snga ma sgom brgyab pas las 'phros khams 'dus yong ba dang / de ni brtson 'grus chen po byed nas sgom mang po brgyab ste khams 'du ba dang / dad pa chen po skye ba'i skabs su yang khams 'dus yong gi red zer gyi 'dug ga da de 'dra'i skabs su bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mgur de tsho skad chen po brgyab nas sgrub khang la rang gis 'don de ni gtad tsa lus kyi g.yo ba yang bzo/ de chos drug gi skabs su 'phul 'khor de 'dra yod red/ de 'dra med pa'i skabs su yang gtad tsa g.yo 'gul bzo dgos kyi yod red 'dug stod nas na na stod nas g.yo 'gul bzo nas de ni g.yo 'gul rang gcig pus bzo chog gi red/ dge rganadang gang dgos kyi ma red/ lus gang nas bde po med na g.yo sdu ༵zo

dgos kyi red/ stod 'dra po na ba yin na de ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsol 'debs de tsho 'don na ngag gi sgra gdangs de'i phan po yod red/ de ni lus kyigayo ba gtad tsam bzo/ mtshams khang nang nas yang ga le ga le g.yo ba bzo/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro bzo/ de zhi ba'i lus sbyong de dgos kyi yod red/da lta gzhan gyi lugs srol la sgom brgyab dus mtshams mtshams nyob dus phar 'gro tshur 'gro bzo yas dngaka nyan thos kyi lugs srol la byi rmugs byung yong dus phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed nas sgom yas de 'dra yod red/ de 'dra yang bar ta bar ta la bzo na yag po red pa/ mtha' gcig tu de lugs srol red zer nas u tshugs brgyab nas phan gyi ma red/ sgom khri gcig la bsdad tshar dus rtsa nas lang yas med pa de 'dra bsdam dgos kyi ma red/ rang gi skabs subabs pa'i gegs sel gnyid khug pa dang bying rmugs de 'dra byung na phar 'grotshur 'gro bzo g.yo 'gul bzo chog gi red/ mi la ras pas da lta rnal 'byor bde ba bco brgyad kyi skabs su/ nyams shugs kyi 'phrul 'khor zhi 'dul gyi/ mchong rgyug gi gar stabs de bas bde/ gsungs pa red/ nyams shugs kyi 'phrul 'khor zer rgyu de rang bzhin gyi 'phrul 'khor rang bzhin gyi g.yo ba bzo dgos kyi red/ rang bzhin gyi g.yo ba ma bzo na mtshams mtshams rtsa 'gags yong ba red/ rtsa 'gags yong dus g.yo ba bzo na rtsa de rlung dang khragamog po 'gro na skyid po chags 'gro gi red/ rtsa de kha gdangs nas rlung dngatsāg ma 'gro na skyid po med pa chags yong ba red/ 'o de 'dra bzo na dga'agi ma red bas bsam pa yod/ yin na'ang da yang sgrig tshugs la'ang kun bzhin dgos kyi red 'dug ha ha/ sgrig tshugs de rang gi shag nang nas khosbyi nas 'grigs tshugs de yag po bzo dgos kyi red rang gi shag gi nang nas kho gegs sel dang de 'dra bzo na 'grig gi red bsam pa yod/ da phyi la sgri/ hā/sa 'dra po de gcig ma bzo na yang sgrig shig na yag po ma red pa/

rang gi sgom khang gi nang du gnyid khug na yar lang nas lus sbyong gtad tsam bzo/ rnam rtog mang po skye na lhod lhod byed nas bsdad de 'dra bzo na 'grig gi red bsam pa yod/ yin na'ang khyed rnam pa ga 'dra yag ga 'dug blta dgos kyi red/ dper na bying ba rmugs pa thib pa byung ba'i skabs su lus kyi mchongs rtsal mig nam mkha' la blta/ sems kyi gsal cha dang dwangs cha la ngar skye dgos red zer gyi 'dug pa/ rnam rtog mang po skye na gzugs po lhod shig shig bsdad mgo tad tsam gug gug bzo de 'dra byed na rnam rtog nyung du 'gro nas mthar mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas kyi yod red/ de 'dra yang gal chen po yin pa 'dug de ni chos drug de tsho'i skabs su de ni 'phrul 'khor yod red/ phyi rgyal de tshor sgrub khang ba tshos chos drug gi 'phrul 'khor la slebs tshar dus de nas gzugs po yag po chags song zer gyi 'dug pa/ de'i bar ta nas 'khum nas bsdad dus dka' las khag po 'dug zer/ ha ha/chos drug gi 'phrul 'khor la ma slebs kyi bar ta nas yar rang gi sgom khang nas lang lus sbyong tad tsam bzo de 'dra bzo na'ang 'brig gi red cibasam pa yod/ yin na'ang sgom pa'i skabs su nga sgom yag po brgyab dgos 'bras bu gcig sgrub khang 'di'i nang nas thob dgos bsam pa de 'dra'i 'bad brtson bzo dgos kyi ma red/ de 'dra bzo rgyu yod ma red/ gu yang bag yangs/lhod shig shig ngang la tad tsa tad tsa mnyam par bzhag yang mtshams mtshams la mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi mgur gal chen po de tsho klog de 'dra bzo dgos red/ de byang chub de ga le ga le bsgrub na 'grig gi red/ byang chub mgyogs po bsgrub dgos kyi 'dug bsam na yang byang chub bsgrub ma thub pa rnam rtog gis bsdam bzhag gi red/ ha ha/ ma red pas de nas de yang nas yang du gsung na yag po yod red/ la so/ / 111

mjug smon/de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam gyi/ /tshig don 'brel pa thang mar brdal ba las/ /byung ba'i rnam dkar 'bras bu ji snyed pa/ /lung rtogs rgyal bstan 'phel ba'i rgyu ru smon/ /lung rig gter mdzod khrod du sbyangs pa dang / /sgom zab gnad la myong ba rnyed pa'i nyams/ /zung sbrel gang yin sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam/ /rgyal tu rang gzhan kun gyi spyod gyur cig /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag skub brgyud kyi/ /ring lugs kun gsal khyon ltar nam du yang / /mi nyams pa gang mtha' klas yid can gyi/ /sman du gyur cing mya ngan 'da' gyur cig /112
